1. 基于图的恢复框架（graph-based recovery framework）：将恢复流程建模为一个图，每个节点承担精确角色——漂移分类（drift classification）、操作检测（operation detection）、风险评估（risk evaluation）或最终决策（final decision）。
2. 在主智能体外部部署一个小型语言模型（small LM）作为恢复模块，作为即插即用组件。
3. 该小模型通过强化学习训练，在每个节点上专门化，产生与该角色适配的结构化XML格式推理输出。
4. 训练奖励结合两部分：基于规则的结构奖励（schema与length）和LLM-as-judge的语义质量信号，对"如何回答"（格式与长度）和"回答内容"同时进行评分。
AI.result: 在公开的AppWorld基准测试上的实验表明：该方法通常能够利用关于疑似漂移起始点的信息，通过小型语言模型发出正确的恢复决策。此外，训练后的小型语言模型能够可靠地遵守规定的输出schema，并在其分配的节点角色下为每个字段生成语义上适当的内容。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了使用小型语言模型作为即插即用的恢复模块来检测和应对自主LLM智能体的运行时行为漂移的可行性，结合图结构化流程、节点角色专门化和强化学习（融合结构奖励与语义质量奖励），能够实现步骤级的漂移识别与恢复决策。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Production Scheduling in an Industry-Based Coating Scenario Using the Digital Model Playground
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Production scheduling in complex manufacturing environments is challenging when sequence-dependent setup times, stochastic disturbances, and due-date constraints must be addressed simultaneously. While reinforcement learning (RL) methods have shown promising results in research, most studies rely on simplified benchmark processes, limiting their industrial relevance. This paper demonstrates the applicability of RL-based scheduling in an industry-inspired coating process that reflects practical complexities such as sequence-dependent setup times, machine breakdowns, and variable utilization. The open-source Digital Model Playground (DMPG), a discrete event simulation framework, is used to model the scenario and to train RL agents. Two standard algorithms, Deep Q-Networks and Proximal Policy Optimization, are benchmarked against conventional dispatching rules to illustrate feasibility and to provide a transparent testbed for further research. Results indicate that RL-based scheduling achieves balanced improvements across key performance indicators, with PPO delivering the most robust performance. The main contribution of this work is to bridge the gap between academic research and industrial practice by validating RL-based scheduling in a realistic, shareable scenario and by providing a reusable open-source framework for future studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的生产调度方法，并将其应用于工业衍生的涂层工艺场景中。通过开源离散事件仿真框架Digital Model Playground（DMPG）建模，验证了PPO和DQN两种RL算法在具有序列相关设置时间、随机机器故障和可变利用率等复杂现实约束下的调度性能，并与传统调度规则（EDD、MST）进行对比。结果表明PPO在关键性能指标上表现最为均衡稳健，且RL方法能有效克服调度规则在效率与交期之间的经典权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有RL生产调度研究多基于简化的基准问题，缺乏工业实际场景的验证，且多数研究让RL智能体仅选择调度规则而非直接做出调度决策，限制了其工业相关性。本文旨在通过构建源自真实生产设施的涂层工艺场景，结合开源仿真框架，弥合学术研究与工业实践之间的差距。
AI.method: 基于Python开源离散事件仿真框架DMPG，模拟包含阴极电泳（CED）和粉末喷涂的两步涂层工艺，集成两台CED炉、三台研磨站、两台粉末喷涂站和两台固化炉及后续处理工位等并行机器。采用121维状态向量（含缓冲产品、前后站状态、粉末站当前颜色配置、系统利用率等），设计5个离散动作（4种颜色选择+空闲）。利用TF-Agents库分别训练DQN和PPO智能体，采用tanh归一化的加权多目标奖励函数（延迟权重5最高，设置时间0.6，加权偏差0.4），并在高性能集群上以60个worker并行收集经验。与EDD和不同缓冲阈值（0/5/10/20/30）的MST规则进行100次仿真对比，利用率因子在0.7-1.3之间变化。
AI.result: PPO在所有利用率水平下均保持最低设置时间（约31.71），并在设置时间、加权偏差（1144）和未完成产品数（53.95）三个指标上取得最佳平衡，综合表现最优；DQN虽在加权偏差上最低（940），但未完成产品数显著偏高（144.8），存在严重缺陷；MST规则随缓冲阈值增大，设置时间降低但偏差和未完成数急剧恶化（如MST-30偏差达6283，未完成180.2）。RL方法特别是PPO克服了传统调度规则在效率与交期之间的权衡矛盾。
AI.conclusion: RL调度在工业衍生的复杂涂层场景中具有可行性和实用性，PPO表现最为稳健，能够在多个性能指标间实现均衡优化。该工作通过开源DMPG框架提供了可复用的测试平台。未来工作包括：与人类决策进行实际生产环境对比验证、引入更先进的RL算法及元启发式等替代方法以拓展适用工业场景，并系统研究超参数优化和算法可扩展性。

title: Traj-LeWM: Path-Aware World-Model Planning via Latent Trajectory Cost
summary: LeWM is a lightweight visual world model that learns latent dynamics end-to-end from pixels and ranks candidate action sequences by the distance between their predicted endpoints and the goal. However, LeWM has two limitations. First, during training, it learns local next-step transitions without evaluating complete trajectories relative to the task goal. Second, during planning, it ranks candidates solely by predicted endpoint distance. Because model predictions may differ from actual execution outcomes, the candidate whose predicted endpoint is closest to the goal may not perform best when executed in the environment. The evolution of the complete predicted trajectory can therefore provide complementary information beyond endpoint distance. To address these limitations, we propose Traj-LeWM, which retains LeWM's local-dynamics objective and endpoint score while introducing a goal-conditioned latent trajectory cost (LTC) that aggregates trajectory-level information as a complementary signal. During training, LTC-based trajectory-preference supervision complements next-step prediction in shaping the shared representation. During planning, LTC is combined with endpoint distance to incorporate intermediate-path information into candidate ranking. With joint endpoint-plus-LTC scoring, Traj-LeWM outperforms LeWM on Push-T, OGBench-Cube, Reacher, and Two-Room by $3$, $14$, $7$, and $7$ percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments and ablations further verify the complementary roles of trajectory-level representation shaping and path-aware candidate ranking.

AI.tldr: Traj-LeWM 在 LeWM 轻量级视觉世界模型基础上引入目标条件潜变量轨迹代价（LTC），通过合成与闭环失败轨迹的偏好学习，将完整轨迹信息同时注入共享表征训练和 CEM 候选轨迹排序，在 Push-T、Cube、Reacher、Two-Room 四项任务及真实 Franka FR3 上均稳定超越 LeWM。
AI.motivation: LeWM 仅以端点距离对候选动作序列排序，且训练中只监督局部下一步转移，未对完整轨迹相对于任务目标的质量进行建模。这导致两点不足：(1) 共享编码器未被训练评估完整候选轨迹的优劣；(2) 规划时仅依赖预测端点，预测与执行可能不一致，端点相近的候选在实际执行中表现可能差异很大。作者希望通过引入轨迹级信号同时改进表征学习与候选排序。
AI.method: 方法核心是目标条件潜变量轨迹代价 LTC，输入为沿轨迹的潜变量、潜变量差分、目标差分与时间位置，输出标量代价。训练阶段：保留 LeWM 的下一步预测损失与 SIGReg，额外使用 (a) 合成负轨迹（目标失配 + 端点保持的潜变量抖动）与 (b) 闭环执行失败挖掘得到的轨迹对，通过 Bradley-Terry 形式的 pairwise 偏好损失监督 LTC 与共享编码器。规划阶段：采用 MPC + CEM，沿用 LeWM 的端点得分，叠加 LTC 得分，权重 λ 由端点与 LTC 的 IQR 比值自适应调节（任务特定 λ∈{0.5,0.8,0.6,0.5}）。LTC 仅增加约 0.82M 参数（ViT-12 + 6 层自回归预测器主干）。
AI.result: 仿真结果（三评估种子均值）：Push-T 99%（+3），OGBench-Cube 88%（+14），Reacher 93%（+7），Two-Room 94%（+7），平均超 LeWM 7.75 个百分点，并在表中于 Push-T、Cube、Reacher 三项达到最优。真实 Franka FR3 的 20 个配对任务中成功率从 50% 升至 70%，碰撞终止从 4 次降至 2 次。控制实验：仅用端点评分时端点 AUC 在 Cube/Two-Room 显著提升；端点匹配且仅扰动中间潜变量时 LTC 在 Push-T/Cube/Reacher 100%、Two-Room 96% 区分扰动前后轨迹；候选选择器一致性分析表明 LTC 与端点排序显著不同（LTC-vs-endpoint top-1 一致性仅 8.3%–25%），证实其提供互补信号。消融：仅训练偏好监督（端点评分）将平均成功率从 85.8% 提至 89.0%；仅 LTC 评分平均 80.3%（在 Reacher 达 94%）；联合评分达 93.5%。
AI.conclusion: Traj-LeWM 验证了轨迹级偏好监督可以同时改进共享编码器的表征质量与候选排序的路径感知能力。端点距离与 LTC 是互补而非可互换的规划信号：表征整形对 Cube、Two-Room 的端点判别更有效，LTC 单独评分在 Reacher 上最强，联合评分在四项任务均取得最佳平衡。该方法在参数增加极少的前提下兼容轻量级世界模型，并具备向真实机器人迁移的可行性。

title: QuaSAR: Quantization Compensation via Stable Activation-Aware Rank Truncation
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures
summary: Recent training-free post-training quantization methods restore model accuracy through closed-form residual compensation. To constrain additional model storage overhead, several existing methods gate layer selection by goodness-of-fit, retaining only those layers whose compensation yields a positive residual fit score and discarding the rest. In this paper, we show that, under the low-bit W4A4 setting, this gating mechanism fails to distinguish poorly predictable quantization error from numerical solver failure. Rank-deficient input activations yield severely ill-conditioned or numerically singular Gram matrices, causing the closed-form solver to become unstable and produce spuriously negative fit scores. Consequently, existing goodness-of-fit gates misclassify affected layers as uncompensable and discard them. Many of these discarded layers can nevertheless provide substantial error recovery when their compensation is computed using a numerically stable solver. To address this problem, we propose a parameter-free truncated pseudoinverse solver which removes collapsed directions prior to inversion. On ViT-B with the W4A4 setting, our training-free method achieves 81.42\% top-1 accuracy, outperforming prior post-training methods and fine-tuning-based baselines. Combined with joint low-rank and quantization compression, the proposed method reaches a deployable operating point of 80.26\% accuracy at 54.7 MB, providing a well-balanced trade-off between model size and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuaSAR，一种训练免费的W4A4后训练量化补偿方法。通过引入截断伪逆求解器，解决低秩激活在量化下导致Gram矩阵数值奇异的问题，避免有价值的补偿层被误判丢弃。在ViT-B/W4A4上达到81.42% Top-1准确率（无训练），并可压缩至80.26% @ 54.7MB。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费的PTQ残差补偿方法通过R²>0的门控机制筛选补偿层。但在W4A4低比特设置下，秩亏缺的激活导致Gram矩阵数值奇异，闭式求解器不稳定并产生虚假的负R²分数，使有价值的补偿层被误判为"不可补偿"并丢弃。本文揭示了这一被忽视的失败机制。
AI.method: 1）层级补偿：为Transformer块中每个线性层附加独立补偿器（提升+3.1%）；2）数值稳定求解：采用无参数的截断伪逆（truncated pseudoinverse），基于rcond阈值去除坍缩方向后取倒数，保留有效补偿子空间；3）双轴压缩：激活感知的低秩分解（基于白化Gram矩阵的截断SVD）+ 补偿因子通道对称量化（int8/int4）。
AI.result: 在ViT-B/W4A4/ImageNet上：无训练方式达到81.42%±0.06% Top-1，超越QwT（76.3%）、QwT*（78.5%，需微调）、QwT-v2（75.6%）和IGQ-ViT（79.3%）；压缩后达80.26%±0.11% @ 54.7MB。跨架构验证显示该数值脆弱性问题普遍存在（ViT-B、DeiT-T、Swin-T、ResNet-50）。消融证明增益来自数值稳定性而非正则化收缩（截断伪逆81.42% vs 岭回归81.64%）。
AI.conclusion: QuaSAR揭示了训练免费残差补偿中一个被忽视的数值崩溃问题——激活量化使Gram矩阵越过数值崩溃阈值，导致最有价值的补偿层被错误丢弃。截断伪逆求解器可挽救这些层。层级补偿框架在精度上达到新SOTA，并提供了精度与尺寸间良好平衡的可部署工作点。未来工作方向：CNN架构应用、更低比特（W3A3）联合稳定化、与其它W4A4量化器结合。

title: Towards Efficient Multimodal and Multilingual Opinion Extraction for STI: A QLoRA-Based Fine-Tuning Approach
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have reshaped semantic analysis. Opinion Extraction (OE) for Science and Technology Intelligence (STI) requires concise core opinions from large information streams. Off-the-shelf models struggle to filter noise from these streams and show limited structured-output reliability in zero-shot multilingual and multi-modal settings. To address information overload and extraction defocus, this study proposes a multimodal core-opinion extraction framework in which visual evidence serves as a contextual anchor for textual judgment. Using VideoLLaMA2 (VL2) and VideoLLaMA2.1 (VL2.1) as the base models, we apply Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) fine-tuning on a curated dataset of 2,194 multilingual and multimodal samples. Under the selected Image-Augmented setting, fine-tuned VL2.1 generates structured JSON core-opinion outputs, achieving 64.98% Precision, 42.15% Recall, 51.14% F1-score, and 74.00% sample-level accuracy. Relative to the zero-shot VL2.1 setting, it raises the F1-scores of Spanish and Russian from 4.83% and 0.45% to 46.05% and 51.93%, respectively. The framework further incorporates a Fuzzy Cumulative Prospect Theory-based post-extraction triage module for case-level value assessment, providing a case-level value signal for downstream STI screening.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对科技情报(SCI)分析中多语言、多模态意见提取的挑战,提出了一种基于QLoRA微调VideoLLaMA2系列模型的核心意见提取框架,并结合模糊累积前景理论(Fuzzy-CPT)实现案例级价值评估。
AI.motivation: 随着科技信息呈全球化、多模态和多语言传播,科技情报(STI)分析面临信息过载、提取失焦(extraction defocus)、语言漂移(language drift)和资源受限四大挑战。现成的多模态大语言模型在零样本多语言场景下的结构化输出可靠性有限,且难以从海量异构信息中精确过滤出与STI监测目标相关的核心意见。
AI.method: 方法包含四个核心组件:(1) 自建多语言多模态STI意见数据集——通过八步标准化流程构建,包含2,194个标注样本,涵盖英、中、俄、西四种语言及文本、图像、视频三种模态;(2) 基模型选择——选用VideoLLaMA2(VL2,Mistral-7B)和VideoLLaMA2.1(VL2.1,Qwen2-7B)作为7B级多模态基模型;(3) QLoRA参数高效微调——采用NF4 4-bit量化冻结骨干网络,以低秩矩阵(r=256, α=512)进行训练,迫使模型聚焦核心意见并以JSON格式输出;(4) 模糊累积前景理论(Fuzzy-CPT)后提取评估模块——从可信度、相关性、局部热度、一致性、时效性五个维度对案例进行价值评分,划分为5星至2星四个等级。评价指标采用基于相似度阈值(τ=0.5)的意见级Precision/Recall/F1及样本级准确率。
AI.result: 在200样本保留测试集(每语言50个)上,Image-Augmented设置下微调的VL2.1取得64.98% Precision、42.15% Recall、51.14% F1-score和74.00%样本级准确率。相对零样本VL2.1,西班牙语和俄语F1-score分别从4.83%、0.45%大幅提升至46.05%、51.93%。QLoRA微调相比最优提示工程基线(4-Shot),Precision从21.65%提升至64.98%,F1从33.71%提升至51.14%,但Recall有所下降,呈现精度导向的转变。模态消融显示Image-Augmented略优于Text-Centered和Full Modality。与外部多模态模型(DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3-Omni-Flash、Claude-Sonnet-4-6)相比,微调VL2.1的F1(51.14%)显著高于最强外部基线Claude-Sonnet-4.6(41.04%)。价值评估模块对289个预测意见案例进行分级,其中180例为3星参考级,66例为4星高价值,3例为5星优先。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种参数高效的多语言多模态核心意见提取框架,有效解决了零样本MLLM在STI场景下的语言漂移和提取失焦问题。QLoRA微调在低资源语言(西班牙语、俄语)上带来显著提升,Image-Augmented为最优视觉锚定策略。框架输出结构化JSON核心意见结合案例级价值评估信号,可直接对接下游STI监测数据库。局限在于多意见密集型输入下模型仍倾向于遗漏次级有效意见,Future work将扩展至主题级趋势综合和跨平台STI监测。

title: Removing Temporal Note Redundancy Improves Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Medicine
summary: Mechanical ventilation is a critical life-support intervention, requiring dynamic adjustments to ventilator settings as a patient's condition evolves. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising framework for optimizing these sequential decisions, standard approaches rely primarily on structured electronic health record (EHR) data, missing crucial clinical context recorded in free-text notes. Integrating longitudinal clinical notes into RL state spaces is challenging because notes are heavily inflated by temporal redundancy, such as copy-forward text, templating, and repetitive documentation, which dilutes time-local updates and degrades state representation quality. To address this, we propose a redundancy-aware multimodal state representation framework that explicitly removes duplicated note text over time before policy learning. We evaluate two computationally efficient temporal decomposition strategies for removing duplicated note text: (1) an embedding-space decomposition using singular value decomposition on local history subspaces, and (2) an interpretable sentence-level diff operation that filters out previously documented sentences before text encoding. Using real-world ICU data, we demonstrate that state representations constructed by stripping temporal note redundancy significantly outperform both structured-only and raw-note baselines across multiple off-policy evaluation methods (Model-Based Rollouts, Fitted Q-Evaluation, Weighted Importance Sampling, and Weighted Doubly Robust Evaluation). Our findings show that explicitly isolating new clinical information from repeated note text yields higher-quality state representations and directly improves RL performance for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机械通气场景中离线强化学习（RL）状态构建问题，提出冗余感知的多模态状态表示框架。核心观点是，临床纵向病程记录（clinical notes）因模板化、复制粘贴（copy-forward）等操作存在大量时间冗余，直接使用原始笔记嵌入会稀释新出现的关键临床信息并降低状态表示质量。为此，作者提出两种计算高效的时序分解方法：(1) 基于局部历史子空间SVD的嵌入空间分解；(2) 基于最长公共子序列的句子级diff分解。在MIMIC-III数据集上，通过模型回滚、FQE、WIS、WDR四种离策略评估（OPE）方法验证，表明剥离时间冗余后的状态表示显著优于仅结构化特征和原始笔记的基线。
AI.motivation: 机械通气管理需要根据病情演变动态调整参数，适合用序列决策建模。现有RL方法主要依赖结构化EHR变量，遗漏了病程记录中包含的丰富临床上下文。但纵向病程记录由于复制粘贴、模板化、复制转发（copy-forward）等现象含有极高的时间冗余（研究指出约42%的住院记录使用复制粘贴，19%的内容被复制），导致原始笔记嵌入混合了持久历史信息和新增临床更新，模糊了与决策相关的时局部变化。同时，对每条笔记反复调用大语言模型摘要去重计算代价过高。因此需要一种计算高效、能明确分离历史与新增信息的冗余感知状态表示方法。
AI.method:
方法框架：将机械通气建模为有限时域离线RL问题，沿用4小时间隔的结构化状态、动作离散化与奖励设计（基于SpO2改善与动作惩罚）。固定所有决策要素后，仅改变状态表示以隔离效果。  
1. 笔记编码：使用ClinicalBERT对每条笔记编码为 d_n 维向量。  
2. 嵌入空间时序分解（SVD）：对患者最近 k 条笔记嵌入构建中心化历史矩阵 H_t，做SVD取前 ℓ 个右奇异向量 V_{t,ℓ} 构成局部历史子空间；将当前嵌入投影到该子空间得到"历史分量" x^{svd,hist}，残差为"新增分量" x^{svd,new}，满足 x_t = x^{svd,hist} + x^{svd,new}。  
3. 句子级diff分解：在文本层面用最长公共子序列（LCS）diff算子将当前笔记句子与最近 k 条笔记句子比对，分出已出现句子集 S_t^{hist} 和新增句子集 S_t^{new}，分别拼接后用ClinicalBERT编码得到 x^{diff,hist} 和 x^{diff,new}。  
4. 压缩与融合：各分量经训练集PCA降维到 q=64 维，再与结构化变量拼接构成最终状态。  
5. 策略学习与评估：行为克隆（BC）估计行为策略；保守Q学习（CQL）学习目标策略；通过四种OPE（模型回滚MB、FQE、WIS、WDR）在MIMIC-III机械通气轨迹上进行配对bootstrap比较。
AI.result:
在MIMIC-III（157,924条笔记、10,125次ICU入住、147,997决策间隔）上：  
- 两种冗余感知表示均一致优于仅结构化基线：SVD表示在FQE/WIS/WDR/MB上分别提升+0.12/+0.40/+0.22/+0.73；句子级diff表示提升更大，分别为+0.27/+0.64/+0.41/+0.75，置信区间均不含零。  
- 两者同样优于原始笔记基线（SVD:+0.14~+0.46，diff:+0.28~+0.69）。  
- 原始笔记表示相比仅结构化基线在FQE/WIS/WDR上的置信区间均含零，仅MB有正向估计，表明增益并非来自简单添加笔记嵌入，而来自冗余分解。  
- 个案分析（ICU stay 246432，t=9）：新增信息主要涉及手术计划、输血、凝血异常、补钾等非通气相关内容时，原始笔记策略切换动作（412→512），而冗余感知策略保持与临床医生一致（412），说明分离稳定通气历史可避免无关文本干扰决策。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明在离线RL用于机械通气时，显式剥离纵向病程记录的时间冗余可显著提升状态表示质量与策略价值估计。两种分解方法——嵌入空间SVD与句子级diff——均计算高效且互补：前者建模连续表示中的低秩冗余结构，后者提供可解释的文本级分解。冗余感知多模态状态在四种OPE下稳定优于结构化与原始笔记基线，表明分离持久临床上下文与新增信息对序列决策至关重要。但作者也指出局限：基于回顾性数据的OPE并非临床获益的直接证据；分解可能未对应临床有意义更新；单中心MIMIC-III数据需多场景验证。未来工作将结合不确定性估计、可解释性方法与前瞻性评估以提升临床决策支持系统的可靠性。

title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs
summary: LLMs exhibit social biases that can produce inaccurate and discriminatory inferences, posing risks in high-stakes applications. While prior work has made progress in measuring and mitigating bias, it largely focuses on final outputs of models, with limited understanding of the mechanisms that produce biased outcomes. Recent advances in LLM reasoning offers a new lens for investigating bias, yet the link between reasoning and bias remains poorly understood. Existing approaches focus primarily on final answer correctness or explicitly biased language, overlooking different behaviours in reasoning that can drive biased outcomes. We introduce BiasTrace, an annotation scheme for labelling reasoning behaviours in model-generated traces and linking them to biased outcomes. BiasTrace captures bias-specific behaviours (e.g., unsupported demographic assumptions) as well as general reasoning patterns that may implicitly contribute to bias (e.g. overthinking). We apply BiasTrace to reasoning traces in bias-sensitive contexts, scaled using validated LLM-as-a-judge methods, producing a large annotated dataset. Our analysis shows that biased outputs often stem from subtle reasoning behaviours rather than explicitly biased language, and that reasoning-level annotations improve bias detection. We further show that BiasTrace behaviours can be exploited for inference-time mitigation. These findings underscore the importance of examining a broader range of reasoning patterns to better understand bias in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BiasTrace 标注方案，用于识别和标注 LLM 推理过程中的具体行为（如过度思考、群体假设等），并将其与偏见输出关联。核心发现是偏见输出往往源于微妙的推理行为而非显性的偏见语言，推理层面的标注可显著提升偏见检测能力，并支持推理时的偏见缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 偏见研究主要关注最终输出或显性偏见语言，对产生偏见结论的推理机制理解有限。Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理虽然为偏见研究提供了新视角，但推理过程与偏见之间的联系尚未被系统研究，存在关键空白：模型可能避免显性偏见语言却通过推理模式得出歧视性结论。
AI.method: 1. 提出 BiasTrace 标注方案，包含 4 类 6 个推理行为标签：偏见特定行为（群体假设、偏见承认）、元认知行为（元反思）、上下文外知识（人口统计学知识、主题知识）、不确定性下推理（过度思考）。2. 在 BBQ 偏见基准上通过人工标注（100 样本）和 LLM-as-a-Judge（DeepSeek-V3.2）进行验证与扩展，生成 250,976 条标注推理轨迹。3. 用逻辑回归分析推理行为与偏见输出的预测关系（RQ1）。4. 设计基于 BiasTrace 行为的评估提示词以改进偏见检测（RQ2）。5. 通过 Majority Voting 过滤偏见推理轨迹实现推理时缓解（实验覆盖 Qwen3-1.7B/4B 和 Llama-3.2-3B/8B）。6. 在 COMPAS 数据集上验证推理行为与群体公平性的关联。
AI.result: 1. 过度思考（Overthinking）是偏见输出最强的预测因子（OR=2.34，在引导式提示下 OR=10.03），且不能仅归因于推理长度增加。2. 群体假设本身不显著，但在模糊语境下显著（OR=4.88）。3. 引导式提示选择性抑制部分偏见路径（如群体假设）但放大其他路径（过度思考）。4. BiasTrace 评估提示词在偏见检测上相关性 r=0.08-0.41，显著优于基线（r=0.01-0.19），且在 GPT-OSS-120B 上具有跨模型泛化能力。5. 在 COMPAS 任务上，与样本公平性贡献的相关性达 r=0.38，Top-10%-20% 重叠率 52%-62%。6. Maj-BiasTrace 推理时缓解策略在所有 4 个模型上同时提升准确率并降低偏见率（如 Qwen3-1.7B：偏见率从 3.64% 降至 1.73%）。7. 偏见结果集中于特定推理模式组合（如过度思考+群体假设+人口知识，bias rate 达 0.30，lift>40）。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的偏见不能仅通过分析最终输出或显性偏见语言来理解，而应从更细致的推理过程入手。BiasTrace 作为细粒度标注方案，揭示了多种看似中性的推理模式（尤其是过度思考）可导致偏见输出，并将这些推理信号整合到评估提示词和推理时干预中，从而实现更鲁棒的偏见检测与缓解。未来方向包括将推理感知信号融入训练目标、构建更高效的标注模型，以及在不同模型、语言和自由形式任务中验证推理-偏见关系的普适性。

title: Can Language Models Understand mmWave Data? Benchmarking Large Language Models for mmWave Radar-Based Human Understanding
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Findings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning and generative capabilities, motivating their use as universal reasoning engines for perception. While modern approaches such as vision-language models (VLMs) have attempted to incorporate reasoning capabilities into visual sensing, the integration of LLMs with the millimeter-wave (mmWave) modality-despite its unique advantages under low light and occlusion-remains largely unexplored. The principal bottlenecks stem from the scarcity of radar language pairs, severe cross-dataset heterogeneity, and the absence of a foundational mmWave encoder. We address this gap through a minimal textualization interface that serializes each mmWave point cloud into concise natural language, allowing off-the-shelf LLMs to operate in a question answering (QA) setting. Building on this, we present mmWave-QA, the first benchmark for language-conditioned mmWave human perception. mmWave-QA aggregates heterogeneous public mmWave datasets and harmonizes them via calibration-aware preprocessing and global taxonomy alignment, while providing natural language QA. Spanning six scenarios and five QA tasks, the benchmark enables standardized evaluation across diverse mmWave hardware and experimental conditions, establishing a foundation for scalable research on mmWave-LLM integration. We further evaluate and analyze LLMs on our mmWave-QA, highlighting their zero-shot reasoning potential for radar perception, as well as their robustness under visual degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向毫米波雷达的问答基准 mmWave-QA，将 5D 毫米波点云文本化后输入现成大语言模型进行零样本推理，覆盖六种场景与五种 QA 任务，验证了 LLM 理解雷达数据的能力以及在视觉退化条件下 mmWave 相比 RGB 的鲁棒性优势。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达在低光照、遮挡等条件下具有独特优势，但缺乏与语言配对的数据集和基础编码器，导致 LLM 与 mmWave 模态的整合基本空白。现有方法多针对单一数据集训练，泛化能力差，亟需一个统一基准来推动可扩展的 mmWave-LLM 集成研究。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：整合 mmBody、MM-Fi、mRI 三个公开数据集，经校准感知预处理和全局分类对齐后统一为 139 个（精炼为 86 个）动作类别；2) 文本化接口：将每个 5D 点云 [x, y, z, Doppler, intensity] 序列序列化为简洁自然语言；3) 层次化任务分类：设计 ActRec、TrajCheck、ActOrder、ActNum、LimbFocus 五类 QA，覆盖空间、时序、关粒度等推理维度；4) 人工-LLM 协作生成 QA 对，并经过三轮质量审核；5) 评估策略：零样本、少样本、CoT、少样本 CoT 四种提示方式，在 GPT-4o/5、Gemini 2.5 flash/Pro 上对比 mmWave 与 RGB 模态。
AI.result: GPT-5 在少样本 CoT 设定下取得最佳整体准确率 38.37%，较 GPT-4o 和 Gemini 2.5-Pro 分别提升 1.39 和 1.86 个百分点；上肢动作识别最优，下肢与躯干因反射微弱和遮挡而较难；Phoenix 雷达硬件效果最佳。在正常与家具环境中 RGB 优于 mmWave，但在黑暗和遮挡场景下 mmWave 超越 RGB；帧数在 16 帧左右时大多数任务性能达到峰值。定性分析表明，在视觉退化条件下 VLM 易产生幻觉，而基于坐标与 Doppler 的 LLM 推理保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: mmWave-QA 作为首个语言条件的毫米波人类感知基准，验证了现成 LLM 在文本化雷达点云上的零样本推理潜力，并实证了 mmWave 相比 RGB 在视觉退化下的鲁棒性优势，为非视觉感知与语言智能融合的多模态推理研究奠定了基础。未来工作将聚焦开源 LLM 微调及与 RAG、智能体等推理框架的更广泛集成。

title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online Moe Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures
summary: Load imbalance poses a major bottleneck to the efficiency of expert parallelism in distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The most heavily loaded rank stalls global execution due to skewed routing distributions, directly increasing latency. While offline expert placement can alleviate persistent imbalance, practical multi-task serving workloads exhibit layer- and batch-dependent routing dynamics, making online load balancing indispensable. Existing approaches rely on routing statistics collected after each MoE router, requiring expert weight load or migration to begin only after routing decisions are available, consequently placing migration overhead on the inference critical path. In this work, we observe that online balancing can instead be largely overlapped with computation before target routing (e.g., attention), if routing distributions can be predicted accurately in advance. Therefore, we propose FreeBalance, a lossless online load-balancing framework that overlaps expert migration with preceding computation stages via residual workload prediction. FreeBalance leverages cross-layer similarities in hidden representations within the residual network to build a lightweight workload predictor. This enables proactive expert migration planning before routing decisions are available, creating substantial overlap between weight transfer and computation-heavy pre-routing stages. Furthermore, a cost model constrains the number of swaps to fully hide the synchronization overhead within the available window. Experiments across models and datasets show that FreeBalance reduces the max-to-mean rank load ratio by 32.8% and end-to-end prefill latency by 13.1%. Specifically, our method hides balancing overhead of an average of 5.1 experts per layer, which would otherwise account for about 8.5% of the critical-path latency.

AI.tldr: FreeBalance是一种针对分布式MoE推理的在线负载均衡框架，通过利用残差连接中跨层隐藏表示的相似性，在路由决策之前预测专家工作负载，从而将专家权重迁移与前置的注意力计算重叠，隐藏迁移开销。实验显示其可将最大-平均rank负载比降低32.8%，端到端prefill延迟降低13.1%。
AI.motivation: 分布式MoE推理采用专家并行(EP)时，由于路由分布偏斜导致rank间负载不均衡，最重的rank会阻塞全局执行。离线基于历史统计的专家放置无法适应多任务服务中层和批次相关的路由动态变化；而现有在线负载均衡方法必须等待当前层路由器完成后才能开始专家权重迁移，将迁移开销置于推理关键路径上，限制了其收益。
AI.method: FreeBalance提出四大阶段：(1)残差工作负载预测——利用前一层的隐藏状态h_{ℓ-1}再次调用冻结的目标路由器g_ℓ，得到早期路由logits以预测专家token计数；(2)预算受限的专家交换规划——基于成本模型(注意力时间减去安全裕度)限制交换数量，采用确定性贪心策略按收益-成本比选择配对交换，并保证所有rank得到一致计划；(3)权重迁移——与目标层的注意力计算并行执行；(4)无损MoE计算——实际路由仍由原路由器决定，仅物理放置改变，保证lossless推理。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Moonlight-16B-A3B上使用LongBench 19个子集及混合任务负载评测(8×A800, EP=8, batch=16, 8K tokens)：max-to-mean负载比从最高2.01降至1.35(降低32.8%)；Qwen3-30B平均prefill延迟降低13.1%；每层平均隐藏5.1个专家的迁移开销(约占关键路径8.5%)；隐藏状态余弦相似度0.71-0.93，路由logits相似度0.99，top-k命中率0.74-0.85；TTFT在1K-8K tokens范围降低11.0%-23.3%；约95%的层执行后实测负载比下降。
AI.conclusion: FreeBalance通过将负载均衡提前到路由决策之前并与注意力计算重叠，在不改变模型路由语义和输出的前提下，有效隐藏了在线重配置开销，自适应地应对工作负载动态，是首个实现pre-routing在线MoE负载均衡的lossless框架，比固定交换策略和反应式在线方法(如UltraEP、MoonEP)更优。

title: APTER: Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics
summary: As large language models enter professional domains, they must satisfy domain constraints, include critical evidence, and provide complete reasoning rather than merely produce fluent responses. Existing post-training methods often rely on holistic preferences or outcome-level verification, while recent rubric-based methods usually generate rubrics independently for each query. In specialized domains, such unconstrained rubrics may omit critical requirements and vary across samples, hindering the diagnosis and targeted repair of persistent capability deficiencies. We propose APTER (Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics), a framework that integrates structured domain knowledge into fine-grained evaluation, optimization, and diagnosis for specialized complex reasoning. First, expert-grounded rubric construction starts from an expert criteria framework built by domain experts, where each criterion represents a stable professional capability. For each query, APTER selects relevant criteria and instantiates them into query-level rubrics linked to their source criteria, turning reusable expert criteria into executable query-level supervision without reference answers. Second, adaptive post-training uses rubric verdicts as both optimization and criterion-level diagnostic signals. Aggregating low-scoring verdicts by criterion ID reveals persistent deficiencies and triggers targeted supervised fine-tuning updates during reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and medical question answering show consistent gains across both domains. Across three model generations, APTER improves the mathematics and medical averages over the corresponding base models by up to 15.86 and 8.04 points, respectively. Code and rubric datasets are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: APTER（Adaptive Post-Training with Expert-Grounded Rubrics）是一个面向专业领域（如数学推理、医学问答）的LLM后训练框架。其核心创新在于：(1) 构建由领域专家预先定义的可复用准则框架（带持久化ID），并通过路由机制将其实例化为查询级评分标准（rubrics），无需参考答案；(2) 在强化学习过程中，按准则ID聚合低分评判结果以诊断持续性能力缺陷，并自动触发有针对性的监督微调（Ada-IFT），实现"诊断-修复"闭环。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM进入医疗、数学等专业领域，仅凭流畅性和最终答案正确性已不足以评估质量——必须满足领域约束、包含关键证据、推理完整。现有两类后训练方法存在不足：(1) RLHF仅提供粗粒度的整体偏好信号，RLVR仅做结果级验证，均未显式编码"应检查哪些领域准则"以及"如何针对失败进行改进"；(2) 现有rubric-based方法为每个查询独立生成rubrics，可能遗漏领域关键要求，且跨样本粒度不一致，导致无法将"漏写禁忌症"与"遗漏安全约束"等失败归因到同一专家准则，阻碍系统性能力修复。
AI.method:
框架分为两大组件：
1. **专家锚定的rubric构建**：
   - 准则框架：领域专家构建 domain→sub-domain→capability→criterion 层级结构，每个叶子准则拥有持久ID、定义与示例（数学含103条，医学含50条）
   - 路由与实例化：给定查询q与框架C，路由函数P(q,C)选取相关准则子集C_q；生成器G(q,c_i)将每个准则实例化为可执行的二元rubric，并保留源准则ID
   - 多角色生成与精炼：Analyst分析查询需求→Consolidator合并→Auditor检查原子性/冗余/表面偏见/边界模糊→Refiner优化表述与权重
   - 专家在环校准：专家区分"模型回答缺陷/评判模型缺陷/rubric方向缺陷/准则缺陷"四类问题，并据此更新监督信号或修订框架
2. **自适应后训练**：
   - **Rubric RL**：对每个rollout按rubric收集二元评判矩阵，加权聚合为标量奖励
   - **Rubric-based SFT**：拒采样式选择高分候选作为监督数据；可选RiC-SFT在CoT中前置rubric作为引导
   - **Ada-IFT（默认配置）**：在RL过程中按准则ID聚合 step级失败率f_c^(t)，对超过阈值ρ_step的前K个准则递增持久计数器H_c；当H_c达到触发阈值τ_trig时，暂停RL，由前沿模型生成针对该准则的修复样本，经校验后执行针对性SFT更新，再恢复RL
AI.result:
在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B三代模型上验证：
- **数学推理**（AIME24/25、MATH500、OlympiadBench）：宏平均提升 6.13–15.86 分；Qwen3-8B在AIME24上提升达25.82分；强基座Qwen3.5-9B仍获15.50分AIME24提升
- **医学问答**（HealthBench、MedQA、MedMCQA）：宏平均提升 5.19–8.04 分；HealthBench单项提升 15.42–17.96 分（开放性临床问答收益最大），选择题类提升较小
- **消融实验**（Qwen3-8B）证实：SFT<RiC-SFT<Rubric RL<Ada-IFT；rubric奖励优于ORM结果奖励；查询级rubric优于通用rubric；专家锚定优于框架无关rubric；Refiner阶段带来4.00–4.96分提升
- **诊断动态**：Ada-IFT使三个随机选取准则的归一化失败率AUC相对下降19%–32%，证明修复具有持续性而非仅端点效应
- 案例分析显示rubric奖励能识别"答对但过程错"的奖励黑客、暴露特定准则的持续失败并触发修复、对严谨完整解答给满分
AI.conclusion: APTER通过将结构化领域知识（专家准则框架）整合到rubric构建、优化与能力诊断中，弥合了领域评估与针对性模型改进之间的鸿沟。其核心贡献——专家锚定的rubric构建与Ada-IFT自适应后训练——使后训练更具领域忠实性、可解释性和针对性。实验在可验证推理（数学）与专家约束的开放式任务（医学）上均表现一致提升，且跨三个Qwen模型代际保持鲁棒性。该工作表明：保留准则溯源的多级专家校准机制（涵盖回答/评判/rubric/准则四个层面）是构建可靠rubric-based监督的关键。

title: A Generalized Parallelogram Rule for Proportional Analogies on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Analogies are quaternary relations of the form "a is to b as c is to d", usually denoted a : b :: c : d. This notion is formalized in particular with the notion of proportional analogy, which imposes some constraints on the valid analogies. Whereas proportional analogies have been studied mostly in symbolic domains and in vector spaces, their use is limited in non-Euclidean spaces. In this paper, we introduce a proportional analogy relation in Riemannian domains, extending the parallelogram rule used for arithmetic analogies in Euclidean spaces. We illustrate the introduced analogy on various manifolds, such as the sphere, shape spaces and manifolds of probability distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于黎曼流形上测地线中点的内在比例类比关系，推广了欧氏空间中的平行四边形规则，并在球面、双曲空间、对称正定矩阵、形状空间和概率分布等多种几何域上给出了闭式解。
AI.motivation: 类比推理是人类认知的核心能力之一，也是验证机器学习方法的重要工具（如 word2vec 平行四边形规则）。然而，现有的比例类比研究主要集中在符号域和欧氏向量空间，在非欧空间（流形）上的应用受限。此前 Murena 等人的初步工作 [15] 存在两个缺陷：基于测地线射击和平行移动的直接推广不满足比例类比公理，且一般构造不保证连续性。
AI.method: 核心思想：将"平行边相等"的平行四边形刻画替换为"对角线共享中点"的等价刻画，并将其推广到流形上。具体方法：定义比例类比为 a:b::c:d 当且仅当存在 v∈T_a M, w∈T_b M 使得 c=exp_b(w), d=exp_a(v)，且 exp_a(v/2)=exp_b(w/2)（即测地线中点重合）。该构造完全内在，仅需指数映射和对数映射。进一步证明：(1) 满足比例类比公理；(2) 在黎曼等距变换下不变；(4) 在 Hadamard 流形和对称空间上具有鲁棒性。在 ℝ^n 上证明了当 n≥2 时任意四个不同点都可构造合适度量实现类比；在 ℝ 上则需满足区间嵌套条件。
AI.result: 主要理论结果包括：① 在测地凸流形上，新定义与基于对数映射的定义一致；② 在黎曼对称空间上，类比有简洁形式 d=s_m(a)，其中 m 是 b,c 的中点，s_m 是 m 点的测地线对称；③ 在球面 𝕊^n 上得到闭式解 d=⟨a,b+c⟩(b+c)/(1+⟨b,c⟩)-a；④ 在双曲空间 ℍ^n 上有唯一闭式解；⑤ 在 SPD 矩阵流形上解为 (B#C)A^(-1)(B#C)；⑥ 在 Aitchison 度量下的概率单纯形上有显式解。实验方面：使用 Morphomatics 库实现了 3D 三角网格的形变传递（狗→牛的姿态传递）；在 MovieLens 1M 数据集上进行了偏好传递任务，类比模型在 6 个实验设置中有 5 个优于 Fisher-Rao 度量，显著优于留一基线。
AI.conclusion: 该论文建立了一个统一的内在几何框架，将比例类比从符号域和欧氏向量空间扩展到一般的黎曼流形。基于测地线中点的构造满足比例类比的基本公理，并在多种重要几何域（球面、双曲空间、SPD 矩阵、形状空间、概率分布）上具有闭式表达。理论贡献包括：等距不变性、对称空间上的鲁棒性、ℝ^n 上可实现性的完整刻画。实际应用展示了在迁移学习（形变传递、偏好预测）和几何数据增强中的潜力。未来方向包括非黎曼几何扩展、高效数值求解器以及基于类比的学习方法。

title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables
summary: Autoformalization is commonly framed as translating natural-language mathematical statements into machine-verifiable formal languages such as Lean 4. However, faithful formalization requires more than translation. Models must map mathematical concepts to the complex hierarchy of types and definitions in formal libraries such as Mathlib, while ensuring that generated statements preserve the meaning of the source propositions. Existing approaches struggle because they rely heavily on the model's parametric memory for library-specific knowledge, while common data construction pipelines often resort to filtering single-pass outputs and lack mechanisms for feedback-driven revision. To address these challenges, we introduce MathForm, an autoformalization framework for constructing verified training data through Mathlib knowledge retrieval and verification-guided iterative refinement. Before generation, a retrieval planner gathers relevant definitions and existing formalizations from Mathlib to guide the formalization generator. Generated statements are then revised using compiler diagnostics and semantic-consistency feedback. Using this framework, we construct FormalVerse, a Lean 4 dataset containing approximately 367K verified examples across diverse mathematical domains and sources. We then train MathForm-8B through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Across six benchmarks, MathForm-8B achieves average Pass@8 rates of 88.06% under Syntax Check (SC) and 72.37% under Consistency Check (CC), outperforming multiple specialized 32B autoformalizers. On the challenging FATE-H and FATE-X subsets, it attains CC pass rates of 63% and 37%, exceeding the strongest specialized baselines in both cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MathForm 框架，通过结合 Mathlib 知识检索与编译/语义验证引导的迭代优化，构建了约 37 万条经过验证的 Lean 4 自动形式化数据集 FormalVerse，并训练出 8B 模型 MathForm-8B，在六个基准上以更小参数量超越多个 32B 专用自动形式化模型。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化方法存在两个核心问题：一是过度依赖模型参数记忆中存储的库特定知识，导致对 Mathlib 类型层次、定义、惯例等使用不当；二是数据构建普遍采用 Best-of-N 单次生成过滤策略，缺乏反馈驱动的修正机制。两类局限使得现有数据集与模型集中于竞赛式代数与数论，而抽象代数等需要深厚库知识的高抽象领域语料匮乏。可信的自动形式化应被视为一个由检索与反复验证驱动的知识落地过程，而非一次性的翻译加事后筛选。
AI.method: （1）数据构建流水线：问题收集与归一化 → 检索规划器（gpt-oss-120b）按需调用 LeanExplore 从 Mathlib 拉取 top-2 相关定义/定理/现有形式化 → 形式化生成器在检索上下文条件下产出 Lean 4 陈述 → 验证引导的迭代优化（格式检查 → Lean 4 编译检查 → QwQ-32B 语义一致性判断；最多三轮，失败时携带编译器诊断与语义反馈并按需触发新检索）→ 轨迹重构以剔除多轮交互噪声并生成纯净训练轨迹 → 13-gram 数据去污染。最终得到 FormalVerse（≈367K NL-FL 对，跨十类数学领域）。（2）模型训练：在 FormalVerse 上对 Qwen3-8B 做 SFT 得 MathForm-8B-SFT；选取数据构建中未通过的 3000 条困难样本，使用 DAPO 算法进行 RL，二元奖励同时要求 Lean 4 编译成功与 gpt-oss-20b 语义一致性判断通过。评估使用 Kimina Lean Server 编译后端与 gpt-oss-120b（高推理强度）作为语义裁判。
AI.result: 在六个基准（FormalMATH-Lite、ProverBench、CombiBench、FATE-M/H/X）的 Pass@8 评估中：MathForm-8B 取得平均 SC 88.06%、CC 72.37%，超过 ReForm-32B（81.61/68.41）等专用 32B 基线；在 FATE-H 和 FATE-X 高抽象子集上 CC 通过率达 63% 与 37%，均超越最强专用基线，且抽象程度越高优势越大。消融显示：相对单次生成，知识检索+验证引导的完整流水线在 FATE 系列上为 gpt-oss-120b 与 Qwen3-235B 分别带来 +22.34 与 +30.14 的 SC 提升，且完整流水线优于任一单独组件；迭代后两轮回收了约 31% 单次无法得到的样本。数据质量对比显示，在相同 100K 规模与训练配置下，FormalVerse 平均 CC 达 60.32%，超过 FineLeanCorpus（46.53）与 NuminaMath-LEAN（41.49），差距主要体现在语义保真度。RL 阶段相对 SFT 在 CC 上带来 +5.84 提升，且训练奖励曲线与 FATE-H 上的 Mean@3 趋势一致，验证二元奖励是有效学习信号。人类评估同样确认 MathForm-8B 在 FATE-M/H 上保持最优排序。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了将 Mathlib 知识检索与编译/语义验证引导的迭代优化相结合，能够突破单次生成的难度上限，构建出语义保真度更高、覆盖更广的高质量自动形式化训练数据；高质量数据可使紧凑 8B 模型在自动形式化任务上超越多个 32B 专用模型，并在高抽象的 FATE 系列上展现明显优势。未来工作将探索更大规模的测试时计算扩展，以进一步提升对复杂问题的形式化能力。

title: Attributing Preprocessing Invariance in Spectral Foundation Models
summary: Preprocessing invariance is an appealing goal for spectral foundation models: a frozen model should remain useful when laboratories preprocess spectra differently. It is usually measured by training a classifier under one preprocessing pipeline and testing it under another, with preserved accuracy read as evidence of learning. We revisit that reading, using a Raman foundation model as a case study. Such models normalize their inputs before any learned parameter is applied. If that normalization maps two differently preprocessed spectra to the same vector, the encoder receives identical inputs, so the invariance cannot be attributed to learning. For a normalization that uses each spectrum's own statistics, this happens exactly when one spectrum is a positive multiple of the other plus a constant. Several standard preprocessing operations take that form. The encoder should therefore be measured against the normalization alone, which has no learned parameters. On six Raman evaluation datasets, the model does not measurably outperform its own normalization. It improves on raw spectra, but so does the normalization alone. Training does improve the encoder over random initialization, and a controlled experiment shows that it learns to ignore a transformation only when that transformation reaches it. A numerical test settles which transformations a given normalization removes. Across released systems in five modalities, most normalizations already remove transformations of that form, and several of those systems claim that invariance as learned. Replicating the comparison on two of them shows no gain either.

AI.tldr: 该论文以拉曼光谱基础模型为案例研究，揭示了当前用于评估"预处理不变性"的跨预处理迁移网格方法存在系统性偏差：观测到的预处理不变性很大一部分并非来自编码器的学习，而是来自学习参数应用前的确定性归一化操作（如鲁棒正态变量归一化）。在6个拉曼数据集和3个已发布系统上的实验表明，经过训练的编码器相对于其自身归一化并未带来可测量的迁移增益。
AI.motivation: 光谱基础模型（如Raman）常被宣称具有"预处理不变性"——即在不同实验室采用不同预处理流程时仍能保持性能。标准评估方法是在一种预处理下训练分类器，在另一种下测试，将保留下来的准确率解读为模型"学会了"忽略预处理差异的证据。然而，这一推理存在问题：许多模型在编码器前对输入做了确定性归一化（用每个谱自身的均值和尺度统计量），这些归一化可能在任何学习参数介入之前就已经消除了部分差异。这种"将不变性错误归因于学习"的问题在EEG等其他模态中也有先例，但在光谱表征学习中尚无系统研究。
AI.method: 1) **理论分析（定理3.1）**：证明对于用单谱统计量（位置+尺度）做归一化的操作，两个谱映射到同一归一化向量的充要条件是它们之间仅相差一个正仿射变换 y=ax+b（a>0）。2) **数值测试**：无需闭式推导，通过计算归一化前后谱的最大偏差除以归一化表示的标准差，判断任意归一化是否移除某变换（阈值10⁻³）。3) **主比较**：在6个拉曼数据集（3291个光谱）上，将训练的RFM与仅使用其归一化（RNV）作对比，使用6种预处理流程（含3种in-family和3种out-of-family），用逻辑回归probe评估跨预处理迁移网格。4) **控制实验**：随机初始化编码器、PCA至匹配宽度（320维）、随机投影、训练中注入增益/偏移的位置（前/后归一化）干预。5) **复现验证**：在DSCF（光谱）和HuBERT-ECG两个已发布系统上重复主比较。6) **审计**：审查18个跨5种模态的已发布系统的预处理代码。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 在6个拉曼数据集上，RFM相对于其自身归一化在跨预处理迁移上无可测量增益（-1.5个百分点，95%区间[-4.6, +3.3]），归一化本身比RFM还高1.5点；归一化单独使用比原始谱高+8.9点。(2) RFM对导数类预处理最弱（-21.7点），所有6个数据集上均为负。(3) 训练确实提升了编码器，相对随机初始化+5.4点，但未超越学习自由的随机投影。(4) 训练机制：仅当变换在归一化之后注入（到达编码器）时才能学到不变性；注入在归一化之前则学不到。(5) 审计：18个系统中有12个的归一化移除了部分正仿射变化，其中4个系统宣称该不变性为"学习所得"。(6) DSCF和HuBERT-ECG复现：两者同样未相对其归一化带来可测量的鲁棒性增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨预处理迁移网格单独不能作为学习到预处理不变性的证据。论文提出四项可操作建议：(1) 识别学习参数应用前的确定性操作，测试它们是否已移除了被评估的变换；(2) 不将跨已移除变换的迁移视为学习证据，对近似移除的情形报告残差；(3) 报告仅使用归一化的基线作为零学习参数对照，使编码器的贡献可见；(4) 训练前运行同一数值测试，因被归一化移除的增广无法为编码器提供学习信号。论文同时指出局限：80%功效仅能检测≥8.1点的差异，更小效应不能排除；6个数据集的标签空间不相交，跨数据集迁移场景未被测试；结论主要在"数据集内跨预处理迁移"这一已测试场景下成立。

title: Polaris : Multi Agentic System for Conversational Enterprise Analytics
summary: In today's fast-paced environment, the ability to swiftly access, understand, and act on data is no longer optional; it is essential. Yet most organizations remain data-rich but insight-poor, constrained by the complexity of querying, interpreting, and explaining enterprise-scale information. We present Polaris, a supervisor-led multi-agent framework for conversational enterprise analytics that bridges this gap. Polaris introduces Dynamic Task Coordination (DTC), a decision-theoretic orchestration layer that models agent-task assignment as adaptive bipartite matching, enabling real-time coordination, recovery, and optimization across specialized agents for querying, visualization, and reasoning. By coupling DTC with reason-first, ReAct-style agents, Polaris transforms natural-language queries into coherent analytical workflows that not only retrieve and visualize data but also explain the underlying "why." Evaluation on structured enterprise datasets demonstrates high semantic fidelity and answer relevancy, underscoring the potential of multi-agent orchestration to deliver trustworthy, end-to-end business intelligence at scale.

AI.tldr: Polaris是一个面向对话式企业分析的多智能体框架，核心创新是动态任务协调（DTC），将智能体与任务的分配建模为自适应二部图匹配，结合ReAct风格的推理优先智能体，实现自然语言查询到端到端分析工作流的转换。在Airbnb数据集上的40个评估样本上取得了语义相似度0.85、上下文精确率0.99和答案相关性0.90的优异表现。
AI.motivation: 企业虽然拥有海量数据却难以获得洞察，原因在于查询、解释和说明企业级信息的复杂性。传统商业智能系统依赖领域专家掌握查询语言和统计分析，而现有基于LLM的单智能体方案在组合推理、多步协调和会话级一致性方面存在局限，多智能体系统在企业分析中的自适应协调能力也尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1. **动态任务协调（DTC）**：决策理论编排层，将智能体-任务分配建模为自适应二部图匹配 G=(A∪T, E)，效用函数 U(a,t|s) = α·sim(θ_a, τ_t) + β·q(a,t) - γ·c(a,t) 综合考量能力匹配、经验可靠性和成本，通过最大化总效用求解最优匹配 M*。2. **监督者智能体**：解析意图、维护上下文、近似求解匹配问题、执行恢复协议。3. **查询专家（Query Expert）**：通过模式推理、语义注释、规范化、NL-to-SQL++翻译和自适应恢复实现自然语言到结构化查询的转换。4. **图表专家（Charting Expert）**：基于规则启发式和ReAct框架动态生成可视化代码，使用Python REPL实现自修正。5. **推理专家（Reasoning Expert）**：挖掘潜在模式、识别因果关系并生成解释性叙述。6. **报告专家（Report Expert）**：汇总查询结果、可视化和元数据生成结构化报告。所有智能体采用reason-first ReAct风格，交织思维链推理与具体动作。
AI.result: 在Airbnb纽约房源数据集上构建了40个查询-答案对的金标准数据集进行评估，使用GPT-4o作为底层模型。结果显示：语义相似度平均0.85，上下文精确率0.99，答案相关性0.90。在阈值评估中，语义相似度（阈值0.70）和上下文精确率（阈值0.90）的达标率均为100%，答案相关性（阈值0.70）达标率为92.5%。结果表明NL2SQL++模块能可靠捕获用户意图，回答具有高语义保真度和上下文精确率。
AI.conclusion: Polaris将编排形式化为自适应二部图匹配，并与reason-first智能体耦合，实现了具有强语义基础的多步分析工作流。评估结果证明原则化的编排是实现可靠、可审计、高效企业分析的有效路径。论文还提出了未来工作方向：学习效用模型与长期智能体记忆的个性化编排、全局数据目录集成、可编辑计划和沙盒预演工作流。

title: Grounding Without Corrective Control: Truth-Tracking Profiles for Large Language Models
comment: 24 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. A six-page methodological supplement, reproducible R script, and constructed data are included as ancillary files
summary: Recent work suggests that some large language model representations have content or reference. Grounding can secure either without supplying live routes for correction. This paper asks what follows from that gap. An output is answerable when discrepancies can affect what a target- and task-specific arrangement produces, accepts, or withdraws. The arrangement has corrective control only when live, sufficiently independent routes can detect and repair fresh discrepancies. A route profile records which routes constrain the arrangement and how they are related. Those profiles support analysis of truth-tracking: patterned support for representational success. Language models are the pressure case; text-only arrangements provide a task-relative limiting case. Text-trained models inherit patterns of testimony, coherence, and prior correction. Where target-sensitive correction survives training, these can supply derivative answerability (inherited constraint); live answerability is the relation supplied by a current route for fresh discrepancies. Fluent failures should follow when a task requires independently informative access to the facts. Self-consistency, retrieval, tools, code execution, multimodal input, and feedback should help selectively. Route-by-task interactions test the distinctions. The decomposition's empirical burden is to predict held-out route--task combinations or improve intervention choice without conceptual refitting. Surface improvement and truth-tracking improvement can come apart.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"路线轮廓(corrective control)"框架，用以分析大语言模型(LLM)系统能否对其输出进行实时检测与修正。作者区分了"派生应答性"(derivative answerability，即训练中继承的、来自源实践的纠错效应)与"实时应答性"(live answerability，即当前路线对新鲜差异的反应能力)，论证了符号接地(grounding)并不蕴含纠错控制(corrective control)。
AI.motivation: 当代关于LLM是否能"接地"(grounding)的争论通常聚焦于表征是否具有内容(content)或指称(reference)。然而，即便LLM的表征能够满足接地的要求，其所部署的安排(arrangement)仍可能缺乏从检测到的差异(relevant discrepancy)到目标导向(target-improving)修订的实时路径。本文旨在揭示这一断裂，说明"内容/指称的成立"与"实时纠错能力的成立"是两项独立的成就，并分析LLM在何种任务上会出现"流畅失败"(fluent failures)。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析与经验预测相结合的跨学科方法。在概念层面，作者引入"安排"(arrangement，由LLM、提示、记录、工具、传感器、检查器、审阅者等组成)作为分析单元，定义"路线轮廓"(route profile)记录哪些认知路线(感知、记录、连贯性、测量、干预、检查修订等)约束该安排及其相互关系；并提出"纠错控制"(corrective control)的五项架构特征：目标访问(target access)、可检测性(detectability)、检查路线独立性(checking-route independence)、可归因性(attribution)、有效吸收(effective uptake)。在经验层面，作者提出"路径-任务交互"(route-by-task interactions)的对照实验设计（如临床记录依赖问题与测量依赖问题的双重分离），并设置信息覆盖率(input coverage)与条件覆盖率(conditional coverage)作为竞争性解释项，进行保留预测(held-out prediction)的对比检验。
AI.result: 该分解框架预测：(1) 纯文本LLM安排在文本密集、稳定的领域表现较强，但在近期、模糊、感知或测量依赖的事实上脆弱；(2) 检索增强主要改善记录访问相关的任务；(3) 工具使用与代码执行在结果能指导修订时提供最强的修正回路；(4) RLHF/指令调优可改善对话适配性，但若真实目标与评分者目标错位(如谄媚)，可能强化错误目标的跟踪；(5) 多模态输入仅在感知层面引入改善，对校准测量与干预任务无通用增益。框架区别于单纯的信息覆盖率解释，强调"路线身份与耦合"是预测干预选择与迁移效应的结构性变量。当输入覆盖、条件覆盖等竞争模型在保留预测上同样有效且无需概念重构时，该分解的解释力则被削弱。
AI.conclusion: 本文论证：符号接地与实时纠错控制是可分离的。LLM的安排可通过训练继承"派生应答性"，但只有具备"目标访问+检查路线独立性+可检测性+可归因性+有效吸收"五项特征齐备的实时路线，才能对新鲜差异进行目标导向的修订。该框架不追求为LLM指派固定类别，而是比较不同安排在特定任务上的可投影性(projectibility)；其经验负担在于能否在保留的路径-任务组合上超越预先设定的竞争模型，并指导无概念重构的干预选择。"表面改进"与"真实追踪改进"应当可以分离，这是评估LLM认识论架构的核心标准。

title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments
summary: Time series analysis in high-stakes domains relies on recurring data releases, where new observations can alter the evidence base and the validity of later conclusions. Existing time series QA benchmarks mostly rely on fixed snapshots, leaving temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use unevaluated. We introduce TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for agentic time series analysis in evolving environments. It tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs from Feb 2023 to May 2026 and spanning monthly, weekly, daily, and irregular release cadences. At each period, large language model (LLM) agents receive time series data and source reports, while the withheld target release provides ground truth. TimeSage-EV evaluates state identification, data summarization, and outlook reasoning. Experiments with frontier LLM agents and TimeSage-1.0, a novel self-evolving agent with a reusable analytical skill library, reveal significant performance gaps across model tiers and recurring failures in temporal validity, exogenous context use, and adaptation. We release TimeSage-EV as a research resource with monthly updates, code, a leaderboard, and failure-mode analyses.

AI.tldr: TimeSage-EV 是首个面向"演化环境中的智能体时间序列分析"的实时基准测试,涵盖60个真实机构场景、6个领域、1,485个场景-周期QA对,严格隔离时间截止信息,并通过四维评估协议评估LLM智能体在状态识别、变化检测和前瞻推理上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列QA基准多为固定快照,缺乏对时间有效性和截止信息感知的评估;而智能体基准不针对时间序列的周期性发布场景。该工作旨在填补"周期性时间序列分析智能体在动态证据环境中表现"这一交叉空白。
AI.method: (1) 形式化演化环境中的智能体任务:固定任务契约 + 累积变化的证据状态 + 严格时间截止;(2) 基准构建流程:源注册→属性过滤→执行验证→证据收集→问题生成→真值提取→自动审计;(3) 4轴评估协议(关键点准确率/覆盖率/忠实度/质量),结合规则评分与LLM评判;(4) 6个前沿LLM基线 + 自进化智能体TimeSage-1.0(带可复用技能库)。
AI.result: GPT-5.4以86.0总分领先,Qwen-3.5-397B(84.2)和Sonnet-4.6(82.4)次之;简单任务近乎饱和(>92),困难任务最高仅72.7;归因(46.7)与预测(43.0)是共同短板;GPT-5.4同时具有4×的效率优势;记忆仅在强模型上有益;TimeSage-1.0的技能复用使token成本降至0.82×,中等困难任务提升最显著。
AI.conclusion: TimeSage-EV 揭示了当前LLM智能体在长程记忆管理、时间有效性和报告合成方面的系统性失败模式,既是诊断基准也是推动稳健分析智能体发展的研究资源,并以月度更新方式保持实时性。

title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
summary: We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this knowledge-reasoning-separation architecture, Mobius achieves better knowledge compression and reasoning efficiency. Built upon Mobius-v0 architecture: 1) Our 7B model trained-from-scratch achieves similar downstream score as a 7B Transformer baseline with 62.6% of baseline's training data. 2) Our Intern-S2-Mobius, continually-pretrained from Qwen3.5-35B, achieves similar downstream score while delivering nearly 4x end-to-end inference speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Mobius-v0的新型基础模型架构，其核心创新在于将知识存储（FFN）与推理计算（Self-Attention）解耦，构建全局共享的知识向量库（Memory）和多个可迭代的推理器（Reasoners）。该架构天然支持"反向残差连接"和"动态潜在推理"，在保持推理能力的同时显著提升效率。基于该架构的7B从头训练模型以62.6%数据达到基线Transformer同等性能，而Intern-S2-Mobius-35B（基于Qwen3.5-35B继续预训练）在推理任务上平均得分（67.88 vs 65.05）相当的情况下实现近4倍端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型发展面临瓶颈：1）Transformer架构中知识与推理紧耦合，导致Scaling Law边际效益递减；3）长CoT推理产生冗余、冗长的输出；5）降低注意力复杂度的线性注意力方法以牺牲模型能力为代价。该论文认为需要"提升架构复杂度"以突破模型智能上限，从而降低端到端开销。
AI.method: Mobius-v0架构核心设计包括三大要素：（1）**Memory（FFN）**：全局共享的知识向量库，存储所有知识；（2）**Reasoners（Self-Attn）**：多个推理器模块，通过隐藏状态查询Memory并迭代优化；（3）**Backward Residual Connection**：通过共享存储机制，使深层和浅层信息可双向流动。训练策略采用：(a) 从头训练7B MoE模型（7B-A1B），1TB tokens；(b) 从Qwen3.5-35B-A3B继续预训练1TB tokens，再进行SFT和RL。大规模场景采用类MoE的块划分+稀疏激活。
AI.result: **训练效率**：Mobius 7B在1TB tokens训练下，MMLU分数全程高于Transformer基线，达到基线1TB分数仅需0.626×数据（1.6倍数据效率）。**推理性能**：Intern-S2-Mobius-35B相比Qwen3.5-35B在通用任务平均得分67.88 vs 65.05（MMLU Pro 89.05、IMO Bench 81.25、AIME 2026 95.31、HMMT 2026 85.51等均更优），科学任务平均52.14 vs 18.20（Biology-Instructions 51.40 vs 3.77、MolecularIQ 59.29 vs 29.13）。**推理效率**：在多个基准上请求吞吐量显著提升，端到端推理速度近4倍加速，主要源于CoT长度大幅缩短（案例：线性代数题516 tokens vs 2364 tokens；生物题472 tokens vs 1649 tokens）。
AI.conclusion: Mobius架构通过解耦知识与推理，证实了"知识-推理分离"架构的有效性，在数据效率、推理性能和端到端效率三方面均显著优于标准Transformer。其"反向残差连接"和"动态潜在推理"两大特性为更高效的推理提供了新路径。文章还展望了该架构在自演化（self-evolving）、世界模型、科学发现和硬件-软件协同设计四个方向上的潜力，认为知识-推理解耦是这些方向的关键前提。论文同时坦承Mobius缩短CoT的精确机制仍待探索，模型已在HuggingFace开源。

title: Sensor-Driven Mission Synthesis for UAV/UGV Swarms: A TB-CSPN Coordination Architecture with Hardware-Enforced Safety
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: This paper presents a coordination architecture for heterogeneous UAV/UGV swarms that synthesises mission actions from uncertain, multi-modal sensor evidence while preserving hardware-enforced safety at the actuation boundary. The approach combines radar, RF, acoustic, and visual observations with Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB-CSPN) orchestration to support incremental mission formation under partial and evolving information. Consultant agents transform sensor outputs into temporally bounded semantic tokens, while supervisor agents provide authorisation and policy-governed release of mission transitions. This separation between interpretation, coordination, and execution yields auditable decision paths, constrains non-determinism within the coordination layer through guards and synchronisation, and enables bounded-time integration of heterogeneous evidence. To improve resilience in contested environments, including cyber compromise, spoofing, jamming, and communication loss, the digital coordination layer is complemented by independent analogue safety envelopes that clamp or veto unsafe actuator commands issued to individual vehicles. A coastal-surveillance case study illustrates how the proposed architecture enables dependable, governed, and physically safe swarm coordination under operational uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向异构UAV/UGV蜂群的传感器驱动协同架构，通过Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB-CSPN)将多模态传感器证据合成为任务动作，并在执行边界以硬件模拟安全包络保证物理安全。架构将语义解释、协调和执行分离，使决策路径可审计、约束非确定性在时间窗口内，并在受对抗环境中保持韧性。
AI.motivation: 在电子战、欺骗、网络入侵、通信拒止等受对抗环境中，纯数字自主系统由于软件和网络本身属于攻击面而变得脆弱。蜂群决策依赖于分布式、异构、不确定且异步到达的多模态传感器证据（雷达、射频、声学、视觉），需要在不完整和矛盾信息下做出时间受限的判断，同时保证物理执行的安全性。亟需一种将高层语义协调与底层不可妥协的硬件安全分离的架构。
AI.method: 提出"Guarded Swarms"混合架构，分数字与模拟两层。数字层采用TB-CSPN编排，包含咨询代理（将传感器观测转化为带时间戳和TTL的语义令牌）、TB-CSPN协调层（时间窗同步、守卫条件、约束非确定性）、监督代理（授权令牌实现规则治理）。令牌模型包括ObsToken、InterpToken、MissionToken和TaskToken四类。模拟层为每个执行器配备独立的Analogue Safety Board，包括推力钳位、姿态触发、接近防撞、电源保护、射频保护音、硬急停等并行OR式抑制逻辑。中间件集成通过ROS 2/DDS、MAVLink、uXRCE-DDS、ASTERIX等协议适配器实现协议-语义转换。
AI.result: 通过海岸监视案例研究验证架构：两架UAV和一辆UGV协同，基于异步雷达、RF、声学和电光传感器证据增量形成任务。令牌从CandidateTarget逐步演化为ConfirmedThreat，最终生成InterceptMission令牌。三个反事实轨迹（过期EO确认、授权被拒、解释冲突）证明架构的结构性保证可以阻止不一致或未授权的任务形成，无需集中仲裁器。展现了约束非确定性、时间一致性和治理机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于架构层面：将传感器证据进入协调层时携带显式语义，在形式约束下演化，并通过治理任务令牌和硬件强制安全包络才得以执行。三项明确承诺：(1)在agentic AI中选择形式化协调而非LLM中介的灵活性；(2)将人类授权作为协调层内的结构性令牌而非外部否决；(3)声明贡献为架构性而非特定实例的性能保证。未来工作将进行大规模仿真、硬件在环实验及令牌生命周期与协调不变量的形式化分析。

title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: The anchoring effect is a cognitive bias in which an initial reference value shifts a later judgment toward itself. This effect is well established in human judgment and decision-making, and recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behavior. However, existing work on anchoring in LLMs typically evaluates only a narrow set of anchor pathways and rarely distinguishes irrelevant from plausible anchors. We introduce AnchorBench, a benchmark for the anchoring effect in LLMs that evaluates multiple anchor pathways under an explicit anchor relevance axis. Across fourteen models, including ten open-weight models and four frontier API models, and a large set of controlled prompts, we find that (1) anchoring is strongly pathway-dependent, (2) plausible anchors usually induce larger shifts than irrelevant ones when introduced through stronger pathways, (3) anchor influence generally weakens as the anchor moves farther from the evidence-supported answer, most clearly on External and RAG, and (4) high task accuracy on the anchor-free control condition (Acc$_{10}$: answers within 10 points of gold) does not guarantee robustness: even frontier API models above 95% control accuracy remain susceptible to plausible anchors.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍AnchorBench,一个用于评估大语言模型(LLM)中锚定效应(anchoring effect)的控制性诊断基准。该基准通过五类锚定传递路径(External、History、ICL、RAG、Tool)和显式的锚定相关性轴(控制/无关/合理),在14个模型上发现:(1)锚定效应高度依赖于传递路径;(2)在强路径下合理锚定比无关锚定引起更大偏移;(3)锚定影响力随锚定值与证据支持答案的距离增大而减弱;(4)高任务准确率并不保证鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLMs正被用于医学问答和时间序列预测等需要定量判断的决策支持任务。在这些高风险场景中,即使平均准确率很高,模型仍可能受到上下文中参考值(如先前猜测、检索文档或工具输出)的影响而出现偏差。锚定效应作为Tversky & Kahneman(1974)提出的经典认知偏差,已被证明存在于LLMs中,但现有研究存在两个关键缺口:(1)通常仅测试一两种锚定路径,缺乏多路径横向比较;(2)很少明确区分无关锚定与合理锚定。这限制了LLM作为决策辅助工具的可靠性评估。
AI.method: AnchorBench采用合成确定性聚合任务作为诊断框架,每项包含结构化数值证据,金标准答案为可见评分的均值。核心设计因素有二:锚定路径(5种:External/History/ICL/RAG/Tool)和锚定相关性(控制/无关/合理,合理与无关共享相同数值锚定值,仅句式不同)。评估14个模型(10个开源权重:涵盖Llama、Qwen、Gemma、OLMo四家族;4个前沿API模型),每模型每路径1800条受控提示,共14,400条提示。提出三个核心指标:UAI(统一锚定影响力)衡量偏移比例、TAR(向锚比率)衡量方向性、Disc_Δ衡量合理与无关锚定响应差异。所有模型使用贪心解码,通过确定性层次解析提取答案。
AI.result: 主要发现:(1)锚定效应强烈依赖于路径——External和RAG显示最广泛的正向效应,ICL(metadata)接近零,History和Tool因格式混淆需谨慎解读;(2)在69个模型-路径单元中,55个(80%)显示合理锚定比无关锚定引起更大偏移,排除ICL后升至87%;(3)在External和RAG上,UAI_pls随锚定偏移δ∈{15,25,40}单调递减(开权重模型均值:0.32→0.26→0.18),表明模型对远离证据的锚定偏移较小;(4)任务准确率与鲁棒性仅弱相关(r=-0.24),即使控制准确率>95%的前沿API模型仍受合理锚定影响(External上Disc_Δ为0.05-0.16)。误差分析显示合理锚定使MAE增加0.6-3.6,有害偏移(37.3%)多于有益偏移(24.1%)。理性贝叶斯参考框架下,55个非ICL合理单元中16个UAI_pls置信区间完全超过0.167上限,5个隐含权重w_imp>5(单一锚定值权重超过全部5个证据评分)。缓解策略测试显示"忽略"指令可减少30-75%判别度,但CoT效果模型依赖。
AI.conclusion: AnchorBench证明LLM的锚定效应并非统一现象,而是强烈依赖于锚定到达模型的传递路径。External和RAG路径效应最显著,合理锚定影响大于无关锚定,且影响力随锚定与证据的距离增大而衰减。高任务准确率不能保证鲁棒性——即使是前沿模型在合理锚定下仍会偏移,且当证据不完整时效应持续存在。因此,平均任务表现不足以证明LLM判断的可靠性,鲁棒性评估必须测试数值上下文到达模型的实际路径。代码与数据已开源。

title: Program-space Diffusion for Morphology-to-Transcriptomics Prediction
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables genome-wide gene expression profiling while preserving tissue architecture, but its cost and limited scalability remain major bottlenecks. This has motivated models that predict spatial expression directly from routine histology. Despite promising results, most existing approaches operate at the gene level without leveraging established transcriptomic modeling practices and rely on heterogeneous gene selection strategies, which complicates fair comparison across methods. We propose to reformulate morphology-to-transcriptomics prediction as conditional generation in transcriptional program space, thereby exploiting coordinated transcriptional variation instead of predicting genes independently. Using consensus non-negative matrix factorization (cNMF), we extract a low-dimensional set of transcriptional programs capturing coordinated expression variation in the training data, and train a conditional diffusion model to generate program activations from histology. This formulation exploits coordinated transcriptional variation and substantially lowers the dimensionality of the conditional generative task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于转录程序空间的条件扩散模型,将组织病理形态学(H&E图像)到空间转录组学的预测任务从基因空间重构到程序空间,通过共识非负矩阵分解(cNMF)提取低维转录程序,并在HER2+乳腺癌队列上验证了该方法在预测性能和计算可扩展性方面的优势。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学虽然能够保留组织结构进行全基因组表达谱分析,但成本高、扩展性差。现有的形态学-转录组学预测方法主要存在两个局限:一是直接预测基因级别的表达,无法利用基因间的协同转录变化;二是依赖对数变换等标准化方法,无法充分考虑测序深度等技术偏差;三是基因空间扩散模型的计算成本随基因数量增加而急剧上升。这些问题限制了方法的公平比较和实际应用。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心组件:(1) 基于Pearson残差的方差稳定化标准化,通过负二项分布模型显式考虑测序深度和均值-方差关系;(2) 共识非负矩阵分解(cNMF),在训练折内通过20次独立NMF运行并聚类生成K=20个共识转录程序作为固定基底W*,然后通过非负最小二乘(NNLS)将表达投影到程序激活空间H;(3) 条件DDPM扩散模型,在低维程序空间(R^K, K≪G)而非基因空间(R^G)中学习反向去噪过程,以组织学patch为条件生成程序激活,最终通过固定基底重构基因表达。
AI.result: 在HER2+乳腺癌数据集(8名患者,35张切片)患者留出交叉验证下:(1) 标准化对预测性能具有显著影响,Pearson残差标准化下Top-M PCC低于对数标准化但更稳健;(2) 在匹配标准化下,程序空间扩散模型在Top-M PCC上一致优于STEM基因空间基线(例如Top-50: 37.1% vs 34.8%);(3) 增大基因面板(G=300→800→2000)显著提升单切片预测质量;(4) 计算效率显著提升:程序空间采样速度达213-227 it/s(约4.3-4.4秒/1000步),几乎与基因数量无关,而基因空间在G=2000时仅1.7 it/s(约36分钟/1000步)。cNMF Oracle显示模型-上界差距仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 标准化是报告准确性的首要决定因素;更大的基因面板能改善单切片预测质量,但基因空间扩散在推理时计算代价过高。相比之下,cNMF程序空间的扩散在受控标准化下达到了相当或更好的Top-M性能,同时使扩散采样几乎独立于预测基因数量。转录程序空间为形态学-转录组学预测提供了比单个基因更具结构化和计算可扩展性的生成目标。但研究仅限于单一HER2+队列,未来工作需要在更广泛的队列中评估、进行面板特定的K选择,并通过超越PCC的生物学效用下游任务进行验证。

title: Clearing the Fog: Towards Installing and Refining Proactive Exploration Capabilities in LLM Agents
summary: We study proactive exploration in LLM agents, i.e., the ability to explore an environment to acquire information that improves future decision-making. In this regard, we first identify two fundamental bottlenecks that hinder this capability and then propose \ours, a novel method designed to instill and refine proactive exploration. Specifically, \ours\ consists of two components: (1) Exploratory Data Construction, which synthesizes exploration-rich trajectories to mitigate the hindsight bias of standard demonstrations; and (2) RL Optimization with Contrastive Signal Guidance, which leverages contrastive trajectory pairs to distinguish productive exploration from redundant wandering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of \ours\ and provide insights into the characteristics of proactive exploration. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体在多轮交互任务中缺乏主动探索能力的问题，提出SaFaRi方法，通过树形结构上下文建模的探索性数据构建与对比信号引导的强化学习优化两个模块，系统性地在智能体中植入并精炼主动探索能力。实验在WebShop、InterCode-SQL和ScienceWorld三个基准上，任务性能平均提升约10%-15%，探索效率提升约8%-18%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SFT-RL范式的LLM智能体在多轮交互任务中存在严重的主动探索能力缺失问题：表现为行为模式僵化、极少执行探索性动作、过早陷入次优解。论文将这一缺陷归因于SFT-RL流程中的两个瓶颈：(1) SFT数据中的后视偏差——专家轨迹天然剥离了关键的探索步骤，使智能体仅被训练为反应式执行；(2) RL阶段的探索崩塌——经SFT训练的智能体缺乏探索倾向，在RL rollout中难以采样到此类行为，导致无法发现其长期收益。这两个瓶颈相互叠加，使得现有方法在需要长视野战略探索的复杂任务中性能严重退化。
AI.method: SaFaRi（instill and reFine proactive exploration）包含两个协同设计的组件：(1) 探索性数据构建：采用教师-学生框架，使用GPT-4o作为教师模型，通过树形结构上下文建模（Tree-Structured Context Modeling）显式地支持自主回溯与认知笔记记录，从教师中蒸馏出富含探索的多分支轨迹树，再通过长度惩罚奖励（r_final = r(h) - n·γ）进行数据筛选，最后在筛选后的高质量成功轨迹上对学生智能体进行短期SFT；(2) 对比信号引导的RL优化：在同一交互状态下，将学生生成的候选动作与教师参考动作配对构建对比偏好对，通过前向评估器π_MC进行蒙特卡洛rollout估计各分支的未来回报，并使用边际阈值τ_m过滤噪声对，最终采用带SFT正则项的DPO损失（L = L_DPO + L_SFT）显式校准智能体在"策略性探索"与"直接执行"之间的决策边界。
AI.result: 在WebShop、InterCode-SQL和ScienceWorld三个基准上，使用Llama-3-8B和Mistral-7B作为主干，SaFaRi在任务性能（TP）上平均提升约10%-15%，在探索分数（ES）上提升约8%-18%，均显著优于SFT-Only、ETO、IPR和STeCa等基线。值得注意的是，8B参数的SaFaRi模型性能可与经过树形结构增强的GPT-4o教师相媲美甚至超越。探索效率分析（EE-WE-Eff）表明，SaFaRi能在RL迭代过程中逐步抑制浪费性探索、提升有效探索，实现EE与WE差距持续扩大；任务难度分层分析显示，探索收益随任务难度递增——在Hard子集上奖励从0.23提升至0.45。消融实验验证了树形结构、认知笔记、数据筛选和RL阶段各自的贡献，其中树形结构+笔记带来+16.63% TP与+12.83% ES的显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 论文论证了主动探索是下一代LLM智能体在复杂开放世界环境中进行鲁棒决策的基础性能力，超越了对当前可用观察做出反应的传统范式。SaFaRi通过结构化数据蒸馏与对比强化学习的结合，有效缓解了SFT数据中的后视偏差与RL阶段的探索崩塌两大瓶颈。然而仍存在两点局限：(1) 探索效率指标Eff(τ)与终端任务奖励耦合，可能在成功轨迹中虚高有效探索分数，需要未来发展因果性更严格的度量；(2) 当前方法仍依赖于教师LLM蒸馏的SFT数据，探索行为隐式受限于教师先验知识，从零开始实现完全自主的主动探索仍是重要未来方向。

title: ScienceFlow: A long-horizon agent for ML research, scientific discovery and beyond
summary: Enabling LLM agents to sustain productive, stable, and goal-aligned research over extended horizons is a central challenge for autonomous machine learning and scientific discovery, as progress hinges on continuously managing evolving state, exploration decisions, and computational resources. Pioneering autoresearch agents, despite great success, still lack mechanisms for continuity, recovery from dead ends, and value-driven compute allocation, which inherently undermines overall search efficiency, wastes computational resources, and lowers the chance of ultimate success. To bridge this gap, we introduce ScienceFlow, an end-to-end autoresearch agent framework that organizes long-horizon research work into research segments grounded in executable workspaces. It represents research progress as recoverable executable states, enabling efficient exploration, revision, and execution. Transitions between research segments are governed by Executable-State Transition through Re-Anchoring (ESTRA), which selects either the live state or an archived state as the next anchor and determines whether to continue or redirect the research trajectory. An evidence-aware execution controller allocates resources to physical jobs based on resource availability, remaining budget, and validated progress. We evaluate ScienceFlow on tasks spanning machine learning, scientific modeling, and mathematical optimization. Results on diverse long-horizon benchmarks demonstrate its ability to sustain effective research processes, highlighted by a SOTA 70.22 percent Any-Medal score on the full MLE-bench within a 24-hour budget, outperforming prior reported results by 4.92 percentage points. The efficacy of ScienceFlow further demonstrates that efficient state management, adaptive exploration, and objective-aligned execution are critical for scaling autonomous research beyond short-horizon interactions.

AI.tldr: ScienceFlow是一个面向长视野自主研究的端到端LLM智能体框架，通过"可恢复可执行工作空间"组织研究段，使用ESTRA（重锚定的可执行状态转移）机制管理状态转换，并配备证据感知的执行控制器进行资源分配。在MLE-bench全量75任务上取得70.22%的Any-Medal SOTA成绩，并在数学优化与科学建模任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的自主研究（autoresearch）智能体在长视野研究中缺乏连续性、失败恢复能力和价值驱动的计算资源分配机制，导致搜索效率低下、算力浪费，且最终成功率受限。核心瓶颈在于随着研究深入，智能体的上下文会从简单的交互日志膨胀为包含代码、数据集、缓存工件、模型检查点、求解器状态等的丰富可执行工作空间，而文本摘要无法忠实地重建可恢复的可执行状态。
AI.method: ScienceFlow提出三大核心机制：1）可恢复可执行状态表示——将研究状态定义为(工作空间快照, 结构化研究记忆, 验证证据, 资源记录)的四元组并归档；2）ESTRA（重锚定的可执行状态转移）——在研究段边界选择当前状态或归档状态作为下一锚点，并决定延续或重定向研究方向，配套Add/Fold/Unfold/Assemble四种记忆操作实现跨段持久记忆；3）证据感知执行控制器——独立于研究路线选择，通过Admit（RUN_NOW/OBSERVE_THEN_RUN/PENDING/REPLAN）和Review（CONTINUE/TIMEBOX/STOP_AND_REPLAN）两步控制，分配GPU/CPU/存储等物理资源。多worker在隔离工作空间中独立探索，仅在研究段边界交换紧凑的验证证据摘要。
AI.result: 1）MLE-bench：在75任务全量基准上取得70.22±1.18%的Any-Medal率（领先最强基线4.92个百分点），Medium层级74.56%（领先10.52个百分点），三独立运行分别在54/53/51任务上获奖牌；消融实验显示移除ESTRA降至66.67%，移除执行控制降至69.70%；2）数学优化：Circle Packing达2.6359830849（与最强基线基本持平），Ratio Minimization达3.590157365310611（匹配MLEvolve），Uncertainty Inequality将Hermite构造上界降低2.5%至0.343293122432；3）组合调度：KTTSP-hard排名第三（393.229天），十天内将目标从1928.39天降至393.229天（降低79.6%）；4）SciModelingBench：组均衡得分54.41（领先Pi 3.02分），在12任务中5项第一、6项第二。
AI.conclusion: ScienceFlow通过将"可恢复可执行研究状态"作为持久化、轨迹适应与执行控制的统一对象，成功实现了长视野自主研究中状态管理、探索适应与目标对齐执行的联合优化。该系统在机器学习工程、数学优化与科学建模三大领域的多种长视野基准测试中均展现出强大且一致的性能，证明了高效状态管理、自适应探索与目标对齐执行对于将自主研究扩展到短视野交互之外至关重要。其核心贡献不在于单独的机制创新，而在于将现有记忆、检查点、轨迹修订与资源调度机制统一于"可恢复可执行状态"这一共同对象，实现了科学决策权与系统执行权的清晰分离。

title: Disentangled Shared Representations Improve Morpho-Transcriptomic Integration
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables the simultaneous profiling of gene expression and tissue morphology, creating an opportunity to learn multimodal representations capturing shared morpho-transcriptomic structure. However, standard multimodal models often compress modalities into a common latent space without explicitly separating shared and modality-specific sources of variation, which may limit downstream utility. We investigate whether explicit disentanglement of shared and private latent components improves multimodal representation learning for paired Hematoxylin \& Eosin (H\&E) and ST data. We compare VAE-based and contrastive approaches, each in standard and disentangled variants, across two cancer cohorts under matched experimental conditions. Representations are evaluated using cross-modal reconstruction, downstream probing and cross-modal probe transfer. The experiments suggest two main trends. First, contrastive objectives yield higher downstream probing performance than VAE-based models. Second, disentangled variants improve the selected reconstruction and probing metrics, although the gains depend on the model family, task, direction, and disentanglement strength. Overall, our results suggest that explicitly factorizing shared and modality-specific information can improve multimodal representation learning for spatial transcriptomics and provides a useful evaluation framework for future foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在配对的H&E组织形态学与空间转录组（ST）数据上，显式解耦共享与模态私有潜在成分是否能改善多模态表示学习。作者比较了VAE类（MMVAE、MMVAE+、MMVAE+sg）与对比学习类（CLIP、disSSL）的标准版与解耦变体，在结直肠癌（Colon）和胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）两个队列上进行交叉模态重建、下游探针及跨模态探针迁移评估。结果显示：对比学习在下游探针任务上优于VAE类；解耦变体在所选指标上有所改善，但增益取决于模型家族、任务方向及解耦强度β。
AI.motivation: 标准多模态模型将不同模态压缩到同一共享潜在空间，但未显式分离共享信息与模态私有信息。由于H&E与基因表达之间真正的共享信号量未知，且两种模态均含有大量模态特异性信息，这种未分离的表示可能限制了模型的下游可用性。本文旨在探究显式解耦共享与私有潜在成分能否提升配对形态-转录组数据的联合表示学习质量，并为未来的基础模型提供统一评估框架。
AI.method: 方法包含五类多模态表示学习模型：①VAE类——MMVAE（标准共享潜在）、MMVAE+（引入私有潜在变量）、MMVAE+sg（使用stop-gradient阻止私有信息泄漏到共享空间）；②对比学习类——CLIP（对称InfoNCE损失）、disSSL（在CLIP基础上加入KL散度惩罚项减少共享空间中的模态特异性信息，β控制解耦强度）。此外引入PCA与单模态VAE作为基线。所有模型训练32维共享潜在表示，采用leave-one-slide-out交叉验证，在Colon（7个样本，62,730 spots）和GBM（10个样本，35,002 spots）两个Visium ST队列上进行评估。评估方式包括：交叉模态重建（HE→G用top-50 PCC；G→HE用余弦相似度）、下游探针（组织类型和组织生态位分类的线性探针AUC）以及跨模态探针迁移。
AI.result: 主要结果呈现两大趋势：1）交叉模态重建方面，VAE家族中MMVAE+与MMVAE+sg平均性能优于MMVAE（仅部分配置统计显著）；对比学习中disSSL在HE→G方向上较大基因面板时超过CLIP，但G→HE方向改善不一致，过强解耦会损害重建性能。2）下游探针方面，对比学习模型在组织生态位和组织类型分类上均取得更高AUC，优于VAE类；MMVAE+与MMVAE+sg在跨模态探针上较MMVAE有改善，但迁移探针表现任务依赖性强；disSSL在多数探针设置下与CLIP持平或略优，但增益受β、面板大小和任务影响，最优β值因任务而异，过强解耦并非一致有益。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出三点结论：①解耦VAE变体改善了平均交叉模态重建性能，但统计显著增益仅限于部分配置；②对比学习模型在结直肠癌分类任务的线性探针AUC上优于VAE类模型；③disSSL相对CLIP的改善具有任务、面板大小和解耦强度依赖性，并非普遍适用。研究强调了综合使用交叉模态重建、跨模态探针和迁移探针三种评估标准的必要性，因为每种标准捕获了H&E-ST表示的不同方面。本文为未来空间转录组基础模型提供了有价值的评估框架，并证实显式因子化共享与模态特异性信息可改善多模态表示学习。

title: Designing Sustainable Federated Learning as a Service using Neural Architecture Search
summary: The sustainability constraints of FLaaS consumers pose significant challenges to maintaining carbon-feasible federated training in FLaaS environments. These constraints often lead to infeasible consumer participation and unstable federated training under hard carbon constraints. We propose a Sustainable Federated Learning as a Service (SFLaaS), a carbon- constrained Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for heteroge- neous sustainable constraints. We introduce a requirement-driven search space that transforms consumer sustainability profiles into a feasible architecture region before federated execution. We develop a consumer-level carbon feasibility estimation mechanism to evaluate candidate architectures under dynamic carbon conditions. We propose a sustainable con- sumer scheduling strategy that adaptively selects feasible consumers and allocates local workloads to preserve consumer participation and statistical data coverage. An evolutionary search strategy jointly optimised for predictive performance, consumer feasibility, and participation coverage under hard carbon constraints. Experiments on real-world datasets and a simulated environment demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFLaaS-NAS框架，将碳约束神经架构搜索(NAS)引入联邦学习即服务(FLaaS)中，通过需求驱动的可行搜索空间、消费者级碳可行性估计、可持续消费者调度以及进化搜索策略，在硬性碳预算约束下同时优化模型性能、消费者可行性和参与覆盖率。
AI.motivation: FLaaS中的消费者(参与方)受限于异构的可持续性约束(碳预算、硬件效率、时变电网碳强度等)，导致：1)传统架构对低资源消费者不可行；2)随训练进行碳预算耗尽，消费者动态掉线；3)同区域消费者同时遭遇高碳排放期，造成相关性掉线，降低数据多样性和模型泛化能力。现有Green FL和Green NAS方法未考虑硬性碳预算和消费者级可持续约束。
AI.method: SFLaaS-NAS框架包含四个核心组件：(1)需求驱动的搜索空间——用{d,w,k,o,s,p}绿色旋钮参数化架构，聚合消费者约束构建统一可持续性画像R*，通过碳成本约束预筛可行架构集A_feasible；(2)消费者级碳可行性估计——基于计算/通信碳成本模型Carbon_i^t(α,E_i^t)评估个体消费者在候选架构下是否满足剩余碳预算b_i(t)，得到可行性指示ϕ_i和可行消费者集C_t^α；(3)可持续消费者调度——综合碳可用性(CAM)、数据贡献(DCM)和碳效率计算(CCM)三维度评分Q_i^t，通过TopK选择S_t^α并自适应分配本地epoch；(4)进化搜索策略——以预测效用、参与效用、碳效用加权构成的适应度函数Fitness(α)进行迭代优化，丢弃违反碳约束的后代，确保收敛到局部可持续架构α*。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、WISDM、MedMNIST、ImageNet-100四个数据集(N=20消费者，T=20轮，非IID Dirichlet分割)上的实验表明：SFLaaS-NAS在保持最高准确率的同时实现~90%的参与率和仅1-2%的碳违规率，显著优于Accuracy-Driven NAS、Efficiency-Aware NAS、Federated NAS和Global Carbon-Aware NAS四个基线。消融实验显示可行性过滤使参与率从82.1%提升至94.8%，违规率从11.4%降至1.2%；动态调度使最终可行消费者维持在19/20；进化搜索在14代内从0.64收敛至0.88适应度；在N=100、20%碳预算的严苛条件下仍保持>60%参与率；在相关性碳峰值期间维持>75%参与率；固定权重配置下仍达85.1%准确率、87.4%参与率和4.1%违规率，证明收益来源于方法本身而非超参调优。
AI.conclusion: SFLaaS-NAS通过整合可行性感知搜索空间、消费者级碳估计和动态碳感知调度，在异构消费者环境中成功实现了高参与率和近零碳违规的可持续联邦学习服务。未来工作将探索轻量级可持续NAS搜索策略以及多提供商分布式FLaaS环境下的扩展。当前主要局限在于进化搜索阶段带来额外计算开销。

title: Wrong but Useful: Trajectory Value Beyond Answer Correctness in Multi-Agent Messages
comment: 24 pages, 9 figures. Includes an appendix and an ancillary reproducibility artifact
summary: Multi-agent reasoning systems often use agreement, confidence, or automated scores to decide which messages should shape a final answer. Such filtering assumes that a message likely to be correct is also worth keeping. Yet a wrong answer can contain a useful decomposition, constraint, or scientific principle. We test this distinction with Diverse Hypothesis Deliberation (DHD), a controlled measurement protocol that caches five independently generated messages and replays the same downstream solver, called the integrator, with each message available or hidden. The replay comparison measures a message's trajectory value: whether making the message available helps or harms subsequent reasoning. Across five mathematics and science benchmarks and two openly available model families, gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it, wrong-helpful messages appear in every benchmark-model combination. Among wrong-answer messages that change final correctness, more than four in ten changes are helpful in each model. Controlled repeats show that the number of repeatable message effects is unlikely to arise from replay variation alone (p=0.0002). A focused intervention on repeatable wrong-helpful messages finds that the complete message works best, while retaining its reasoning preserves more success than retaining only its answer; the source of the complete-message advantage remains open. Within the same problem, repeated trajectory-value evidence also identifies a better keep-or-remove choice than answer correctness alone. Answer correctness is therefore informative but does not determine trajectory value. DHD measures this missing property and produces reusable labels for learning when agents should listen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"轨迹价值"(trajectory value)概念,区分于"答案正确性"(proposal correctness),通过DHD协议证明:错误消息中超过四成的正确性翻转方向是有帮助的,表明多智能体系统中不应仅基于答案正确性来决定消息去留。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体推理系统使用一致性、置信度或自动评分来筛选消息,隐含假设是"可能正确的消息值得保留"。但一个错误答案可能包含有用的分解思路、约束条件或科学原理;反之,正确答案也可能伴随误导性推理。作者质疑:答案正确性是否决定了消息对下游推理的帮助程度?
AI.method: 提出DHD(Diverse Hypothesis Deliberation)受控测量协议:(1)招募员分配5个问题特定角色,5个独立生成器各产出1条结构化消息并缓存;(2)整合器在消息可用或隐藏两种条件下分别运行,通过配对回放比较测量"轨迹价值";(3)包含两种回放机制——池内留一法(LOO)回放和单消息回放;(4)在5个数学/科学基准(Omni-MATH-2、JEEBench、SciBench、LAB-Bench、MaScQA)和2个模型家族(gpt-oss-120b和gemma-4-31B-it)上测试,并通过控制重复回放验证统计显著性。
AI.result: (1)错误但有用(wrong-helpful)消息在所有10个基准-模型组合中出现;(2)在改变最终正确性的错误答案消息中,OSS有41.9%、Gemma有45.3%的翻转是有帮助方向;(3)控制重复回放显示该模式超出普通回放变异(p=0.0002);(4)组件掩蔽诊断表明推理内容比附带的错误答案贡献更多价值;(5)同题重复证据在保留/移除选择上优于仅用答案正确性(OSS增益1.68分 vs 0.94分,Gemma增益2.61分 vs 1.00分);(6)多个基准案例展示了wrong-helpful和correct-harmful的实际机制。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性是有用的信息,但不能决定消息的轨迹价值。DHD测量协议提供了可重用的上下文索引标签,可用于训练智能体学习"何时应该倾听"其他智能体的消息,即使这些消息附带了错误的最终答案。该工作重新定义了多智能体消息选择问题,将正确性与信息价值解耦。

title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures
summary: Many real-world tasks require LLM agents to interact with their environments over long execution horizons. Errors that occur early in execution may propagate through both the agent context and environment state, and their effects may be difficult to reverse through subsequent actions. Existing methods mainly seek to reduce such errors through plan refinement and safety checks but provide little support after errors occur. To enable recovery during long-horizon execution, we present AgentRewind, a runtime recovery framework that records aligned checkpoints of the agent context and controlled environment, allowing agents to return to an earlier state and resume execution with information from previous attempts. We also construct MettleBench, a benchmark for evaluating task completion and partial progress on long-horizon engineering assignments containing a series of related requirements. Experiments across tasks, multiple models, execution strategies, and agent harnesses show that AgentRewind improves task success rate and average checklist progress over the compared baselines.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces AgentRewind, a runtime recovery framework for LLM agents operating over long execution horizons. It enables agents to revert to earlier aligned checkpoints (combining agent context and controlled environment state) and resume execution, addressing the limitations of existing methods that focus on error prevention but lack post-error recovery support. The authors also propose MettleBench, a benchmark for long-horizon engineering tasks with partial progress evaluation.
AI.motivation: LLM agents executing long-horizon tasks face compounding errors: early mistakes propagate through both the agent's context and the environment state, and are often irreversible through later actions. Prior work focuses on plan refinement and safety checks for prevention, but provides insufficient mechanisms for recovery after errors occur. The paper aims to fill this gap by enabling agents to "rewind" to a prior good state and resume with accumulated knowledge from failed attempts.
AI.method: 1) AgentRewind framework: records aligned checkpoints of (a) agent context and (b) controlled environment state during execution. When an error or failure is detected, the agent can roll back to a prior checkpoint and resume, incorporating lessons learned from the unsuccessful attempt. 2) MettleBench benchmark: a suite of long-horizon engineering tasks each consisting of a series of related requirements, enabling evaluation of both full task completion and partial (checklist-based) progress. 3) Experimental evaluation across multiple dimensions: diverse tasks, multiple LLM models, varied execution strategies, and different agent harnesses.
AI.result: Across the evaluated settings, AgentRewind improves both task success rate and average checklist (partial progress) progress compared to the baselines. The gains are consistent across different LLMs, execution strategies, and agent harnesses, indicating the framework generalizes across these dimensions.
AI.conclusion: Runtime recovery via aligned context–environment checkpoints is a practical and effective mechanism for improving long-horizon LLM agent reliability. AgentRewind complements existing prevention-oriented methods by adding a recovery capability, and MettleBench provides a useful testbed for measuring both binary success and partial progress on multi-step engineering tasks.

title: Tripwire: Triggering Aligned Refusal via Statistically Certified Safety Neurons
summary: Neuron- and path-level interventions offer the finest-grained route to defending large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks, yet existing methods fall short of this promise, i.e., they often compromise model utility significantly. Specifically, one line of work suppresses toxic neurons to erase harmful semantics, but since such semantics are distributed across the network, blocking every pathway forces a large intervention footprint. An alternative line of research focus on identify safety neurons using external classifiers. While promising, the existing approaches suffer from compromising neurons that are important for the model utility as well. Moreover, both approaches remain always on and thus perturb every benign request even when no attack is present. To address these limitations, we present \ours{}, a training-free defense that first identifies safety-specific neurons through per-neuron hypothesis tests under false-discovery-rate control together with a utility-specificity filter. Based on this identification, a trigger-style clamp holds the selected neurons at their harmful-conditional mean activations, injecting an internal harmful-input signal that triggers the refusal behavior learned during alignment. The clamp is then realized by two provably equivalent deployment modes, namely a detector-gated inference-time intervention and an offline bias-patch weight edit. Extensive experiments across four safety-aligned LLMs and four representative attacks demonstrate that \ours{} reduces the average attack success rate to at most 2.0\% while incurring a utility drop of only 0.5\% to 5.3\% on MT-Bench, the smallest among all defenses. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TripWire是一种针对大语言模型越狱攻击的免训练神经元级防御框架。它通过统计学漏斗（方向过滤+Welch t检验+BH-FDR控制+效用特异性过滤）精确识别安全特异性神经元，然后以"触发式钳制"将这些神经元的激活值锁定在有害条件均值上，以此激活对齐阶段习得的拒绝行为。该方法支持两种部署模式（检测器门控的推理时干预与离线偏置补丁权重编辑），在四个安全对齐LLM上对四种代表性越狱攻击将平均攻击成功率降至2.0%以下，同时MT-Bench效用损失仅为0.5%-5.3%，是所有基线防御中最小的。
AI.motivation: 现有神经元级防御未能实现细粒度保护的承诺，原因有三：（1）擦除式方法（如TraceRouter、DELMAN）需抑制分布于网络各处的有害语义路径，干预足迹大、难以穷尽；（2）基于分类器属性（如NeuroStrike）的探针权重在p≫n时不可识别，无法区分安全神经元与一般重要神经元；（3）始终开启的干预对良性请求也会产生扰动。这些问题导致明显的安全-效用权衡。
AI.method: TripWire包含三个核心组件：（1）统计严格的识别漏斗——对每个神经元依次进行方向过滤（μ_h>μ_s）、显著性过滤（Welch t检验+BH-FDR控制α=0.05）和效用特异性过滤（剔除ρ>0.5的"通用重要"神经元），再以AUROC排序选取top-N；（2）触发式钳制——将选中的安全神经元激活值钳制在其有害条件均值ā^h上，向模型注入"当前输入有害"的内部信号，触发对齐时习得的拒绝行为；（3）两种等价部署模式——推理时通过轻量检测器门控干预，推理时/编辑时通过偏置补丁（将权重行置零、注入ā^h作为偏置）实现永久化修改，命题1证明二者数学等价。
AI.result: 在Llama-2-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-32B四个模型上对GCG、AmpleGCG、AutoDAN、Jailbreak-R1四种攻击进行评估：top-2500预算下TripWire将平均ASR降至0.3%-2.0%（RepE为8.3%-12.6%，TraceRouter/DELMAN/LED为2.2%-4.9%），MT-Bench效用损失仅0.5%-5.3%（TraceRouter最高达20%，RepE达45%），推理开销最多1.15×。消融实验表明TripWire识别漏斗相比探针方法以3-5倍少的神经元达到相似ASR，且效用损失显著更低；安全神经元集中分布于中上层（Llama系第8-16层，Qwen系第15-21层）。
AI.conclusion: 论文诊断了现有神经元级防御实用性差的根本原因（路径擦除代价大、探针属性不可识别、始终开启干扰良性请求），并证明这些并非细粒度干预本身的固有缺陷。TripWire通过统计可认证的安全神经元识别与触发式钳制的组合，在无需训练的前提下实现了实用且代价低廉的神经元级安全防御，验证了"精确识别+触发式干预"是解决LLM越狱防御安全-效用权衡的有效路径。

title: LLMs Don't Pay for the Jump
comment: 14 pages
summary: Zahavy [2026] argues that Large Language Models, despite their capabilities in induction and deduction, cannot perform the abductive "Jump" that produced Einstein's equivalence principle, and attributes this limitation to the absence of embodied simulation. Zheng-Xin [2026] and Farmer [2026] question whether embodiment is necessary for abduction, pointing to alternative routes to General Relativity and forms of abduction that require no sensorimotor grounding. Max Planck resolved the blackbody radiation problem in 1900. Planck's move to E = h{\nu} required no embodied simulation. It was motivated by a mathematical consequence of classical theory, an infinite predicted energy for a finite measured quantity, that could not be physically accepted. We show that neither induction nor deduction could have produced the postulate and argue that its adoption required a coupling between epistemic error and physical cost. We formalize this distinction through thermodynamic coupling and show that fixed-weight transformer inference lacks such coupling, regardless of model scale. This is consistent with empirical results showing that output entropy remains nearly unchanged across tasks with sharply increasing causal difficulty, even as accuracy falls from 100% to 17%. We therefore argue that the missing ingredient in machine abduction may lie deeper than embodiment: a system must have some physical mechanism through which epistemic error becomes costly enough to force revision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，大语言模型缺乏"热力学耦合"——即认识错误无法转化为物理代价以迫使规则修正的机制——因此无法进行真正的溯因跳跃。论文以普朗克提出E=hν为例（此过程无需具身模拟），证明归纳与演绎均无法产生该公理，并形式化证明固定权重Transformer推理在认识误差与计算代价之间是解耦的。
AI.motivation: 学界就LLM能否进行溯因推理存在争论：Zahavy认为缺失具身模拟是关键，Zheng-Xin与Farmer则质疑具身的必要性。论文旨在超越具身/非具身的二元争论，从更深层追问：任何有界预测系统在何种物理条件下才会将某一认识错误视为"不可承受"从而触发规则修正？
AI.method: 1) 以普朗克1900年黑体辐射危机为案例研究；2) 采用皮尔士三分类框架（演绎、归纳、溯因）分析E=hν的逻辑地位；3) 形式化定义"热力学耦合"（∂E_cost/∂ε > 0）与"解耦"（∂E_cost/∂ε = 0），区分描述性不确定性与调节性不确定性；4) 证明定理1（Softmax解耦定理）：固定θ、τ时token级Shannon熵仅由(θ, τ, ctx_t)决定，与认识误差ε无关；5) 综合文献中的经验证据（熵平坦性与准确率剧降并存）；6) 与Friston自由能原理类比作为生物学对照；7) 提出"代价耦合溯因"判据并给出两条可证伪预测。
AI.result: 定理1形式化证明固定权重Transformer推理是热力学解耦的。经验结果与此一致：跨Llama 3B–70B及GPT-4o-mini，输出熵在任务因果难度剧增时仅变化0.011–0.028 nats（p≥0.568），而准确率从100%骤降至17%。这表明LLM的置信度与正确性之间缺乏对应耦合，溯因假设生成能力随世界模型复杂度提升而显著退化（InAbHyD基准结果亦佐证）。
AI.conclusion: 机器溯因所缺失的关键要素不在于具身，而在于热力学耦合——认识错误必须具有局部且递增的物理代价，才能迫使系统放弃现行规则。现有LLM推理无论规模如何，在认识误差与计算代价之间均无此耦合。可能的工程路径包括神经形态硬件与"内在代价"机制，使得预测误差在推理阶段持续驱动权重更新并消耗能量。该判据提出两项可检验预测：耦合架构在因果需求增加时其内部代价信号应跟踪准确率；在复杂世界模型中假设质量退化应小于解耦系统。

title: The Past and Future of AI Scientists
summary: We present a survey of the past and future of AI Scientists: machines capable of automating science. AI Scientists can originate hypotheses, deduce their consequences, design and execute experiments, interpret their results, and revise their beliefs. Such systems are integrated scientific agents, connected to the literature, formal knowledge, mathematical models, simulations, data-analysis systems and physical laboratories. Adam was the first machine to make novel scientific discoveries through cycles of hypothesis formation and physical experimentation. Eve established the architecture of the modern self-driving laboratory. Foundation models, autonomous agents and laboratory robotics now make it possible to build systems far more general than either Adam or Eve. The central problem is no longer whether individual components of science can be automated. They can. The problem is integration. AI Scientists must combine neural learning with logic, probability, mathematics, causal reasoning, simulation, experimental design, robotics and formal scientific records.
