AI.result: 主要发现：（1）小模型（1.5B/3B/4B）在两种训练时长下均偏好高似然数据；（2）大模型（7B/8B）在1个epoch内高似然占优，但经5个epoch训练后低似然在多数任务上反超，形成"Fast-Fit/Slow-Gain"模式；（3）学习动态分析显示1.5B模型难以向教师分布靠近，7B模型在两种数据下均能有效对齐教师；（4）理论证明低容量学生仅能从其可行子空间内的数据张成中获益，解释了为何低似然数据小模型无法吸收而大模型可以。Llama家族的实验也验证了跨模型族的普适性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究推翻了"高似然数据普遍最优"的固有假设，证明有效的推理数据选择必须同时考虑模型容量和计算预算。提出了三种容量依赖的学习机制：低容量（Fast-Fit/No Catch-up）、中等容量（Fast-Fit/Unstable Slow-Gain）、高容量（Fast-Fit/Sustained Slow-Gain Reversal）。理论容量受限蒸馏框架为数据难度、数据覆盖与学生容量的联合作用提供了数学解释，对推理数据工程的实践具有重要指导意义。

title: Building AI-Intensive Software with AI: Early Results and a Cautionary Tale on Measuring Development Cost
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, Accepted for publication at the International Workshop on Intelligent Software Engineering (ISE 2026) @ CBSoft 2026
summary: Empirical reports on the true cost of AI-intensive software development remain scarce, and the few that exist are easy to get wrong in ways that never surface in the final number. We report early results from an ongoing case study: a six-person student team built a full conversational onboarding assistant -- RAG-based code chat, guided tours, dependency graphs, technical-debt analysis -- over one academic term using pervasive AI assistance. We instrumented development with a three-layer cost model (real AI spend, self-reported human effort, human counterfactual) and initially reported a 19.4x cost ratio. A follow-up pass revealed two independent errors -- inferring per-token cost under a flat-rate subscription, and pricing the counterfactual with the wrong regional labor rates -- that together had inflated the ratio by roughly 2x; the corrected figure is ~9.9x. We present this correction as an early, generalizable finding in its own right: both errors are easy to make, invisible in the final number, and plausibly common in similar reports. We outline next steps toward a more robust, replicable costing methodology for AI-intensive development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在 AI 密集型软件开发中，如何可靠地衡量实际成本。研究以一个六人学生团队在一个学期内、使用 AI 构建代码库导览助手为案例，建立“真实 AI 支出—自报人工投入—无 AI 反事实成本”三层模型。修正两项测量错误后，项目总成本约为 304 美元（AI 工具 69 美元、人工 235 美元），而估计无 AI 的专业开发成本约为 3,005 美元，对应约 9.9 倍的成本比。论文的核心贡献不是证明 AI 带来固定的生产率提升，而是指出成本评估本身容易因计费模式、地区工资基准和反事实假设而产生系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有关于生成式 AI 辅助软件工程的研究多聚焦于编码任务、基准测试或局部能力，难以回答“真实开发一个完整 AI 密集型系统究竟需要多少成本”这一实践问题。AI 工具的订阅制、按量计费、人工审查与返工，以及不同地区的劳动力价格，使成本核算复杂且容易产生不易察觉的错误。论文希望以一个完整的对话式代码导览系统为案例，测量 AI 辅助开发的实际投入，并与无 AI 的专业开发反事实成本进行比较，同时反思成本比是否具有可复现性。
AI.method: 研究采用持续性案例研究。六名学生在约一个学期内使用一个前沿模型进行前期设计研究，并使用一个中级 AI 编码代理完成实现、测试和文档，构建了包含 RAG 代码聊天、引导式导览、依赖图和技术债分析等 25 项以上功能的对话式开发导览助手。方法采用三层成本模型：① 根据供应商账单记录真实 AI 支出，包括每月 19 美元、共三个月的 GitHub Copilot Business 订阅，以及仓库分析服务和嵌入生成费用；② 团队成员自行记录的 35.2 小时人工投入，并按中级地区时薪 6.67 美元估值；③ 按任务复杂度匹配专业资历，估计无 AI 完成各任务所需的 329 小时，再按初级、中级、高级地区时薪 3.86/6.67/10.88 美元计算反事实成本。研究还记录了各活动的 AI 依赖程度，并比较最初与修正后的成本结果。
AI.result: 真实 AI 工具支出为 69 美元，人工投入按统一中级时薪估值约 235 美元，项目总成本约 304 美元；估计无 AI 场景需要 329 小时、约 3,005 美元，因此修正后的成本比约为 9.9 倍。最初报告的 19.4 倍被证明存在两项独立错误：其一，将按月订阅的编码代理错误地按令牌和公开单价估值，虚构了 22.74 美元的问题界定阶段费用；其二，使用偏向大城市的全国工资调查价格，约比项目所在地区高 85%，使反事实成本从正确的 3,005 美元虚高到 5,678 美元。AI 辅助程度因任务而异：代码编写和测试生成约 95%，调试约 80%，文档约 85%，需求分析约 70%，提示设计约 40%，架构决策约 20%。系统交付了约 21,000 行生产代码、约 2,000 行测试代码和 201 个自动化测试。研究发现长会话静默丢失上下文以及缺少书面规格会导致返工；显式规格、持续状态记录和版本化提示可缓解这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为，9.9 倍应被视为单个案例中的数量级信号，而不是经过控制实验验证的普遍生产率基准。它说明 AI 可能显著降低小团队完成实现性工作所需的人力，但并没有取代架构、需求判断、提示设计、审查和安全等高价值工作。更重要的结论是：在比较 AI 与无 AI 成本前，应先确认工具究竟是订阅制、按量计费还是混合制，依据账单而不是模型单价或令牌数重建成本，并明确地区工资口径、资历假设和反事实工时。成本测量必须记录可审计的数据和假设，区分可验证的账单与时间日志数据与估计值；后续研究应通过更多项目、受控基线和跨项目复现来验证该方法。

title: Does ISO-Grounded NFR Specification Improve LLM Code Generation? A Comparison of Rich and Structured Interventions against a Natural-Language Baseline
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, Accepted for publication at the 20th Brazilian Symposium on Software Components, Architectures, and Reuse (SBCARS 2026)
summary: In LLM-based code generation, Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) are often specified as terse one-line phrases. We ask whether grounding those specifications in ISO/IEC 25010 Quality Model, either as rich natural-language prose (NL-rich) or as structured JSON (Structured), improves code generated on HumanEval/HumanEval-ET compared to a RobuNFR-style one-line baseline (NL-simple). We evaluate four NFRs (performance, error handling, code smell, readability) with ten prompt variations per condition under a fixed model snapshot and paired non-parametric analysis. Primary finding: ISO-grounded enrichment improves static quality proxies (unreadability density falls across all four NFRs (e.g., Performance 0.88 -> 0.69 for NL-rich)) and reduces sensitivity to prompt wording, but does not reliably improve functional correctness; for error handling, extended-test pass rate decreases, suggesting tension between defensive coding patterns and exact-output benchmarks. Secondary finding: when ISO content is held constant, NL-rich and Structured differ negligibly in correctness (|delta| <= 0.023), indicating that semantic content matters more than JSON-vs-prose format. Practitioners should invest in standard-grounded NFR content rather than serialization form. A fully traceable replication package is provided.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在LLM代码生成中,基于ISO/IEC 25010:2023标准的非功能需求(NFR)规范(以丰富自然语言或结构化JSON形式)是否优于RobuNFR式的一行短语基线。在HumanEval/HumanEval-ET上对四个NFR(性能、错误处理、代码异味、可读性)进行评估,使用gpt-5.4-2026-03-05模型,每个条件10种提示变体。主要发现:ISO标准化内容改善了静态质量代理指标(不可读密度)和鲁棒性,但未能可靠提升功能正确性,且在错误处理上可能损害扩展测试通过率。当ISO内容相同时,JSON与散文形式在正确性上差异可忽略。
AI.motivation: 在LLM代码生成中,NFR通常以模糊的简短短语表达,但实践中可能使用ISO/IEC 25010等产品质量模型进行结构化或丰富表达。现有研究(RobuNFR)已证明添加NFR会降低Pass@1并增加对提示措辞的敏感性,但尚不清楚:(1)对NFR规范进行ISO标准化的"内容充实"是否能改善生成代码;(2)当内容固定时,表示形式(JSON vs 自然语言散文)是否重要。
AI.method: 采用受控对照实验设计,比较三种条件:(1)NL-simple基线(RobuNFR式一行NFR);(2)NL-rich干预(ISO/IEC 25010:2023内容写为丰富自然语言段落);(3)Structured干预(相同ISO内容序列化为JSON)。所有条件下NL-rich与Structured共享相同的ISO标准化内容,仅表示形式不同。使用gpt-5.4-2026-03-05模型,温度0,HumanEval/HumanEval-ET(n=164),每种条件10种提示变体。四个研究问题对应主对比(干预vs基线)和次要对比(形式)。统计方法采用逐题配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Cliff's δ效应量,以及Holm-Bonferroni校正。评估指标包括Pass@1、ET-Pass@1、按每十行代码归一化的Pylint静态分析密度(异常、代码异味、不可读)、执行时间。还进行了快照稳定性检查以缓解非并发采集的内部效度威胁。
AI.result: RQ1(正确性):两种干预均未可靠提升Pass@1/ET-Pass@1(|δ|≤0.033)。错误处理例外:NL-rich ET-Pass@1从81.0降至76.0(p_Holm=0.001),Structured降至78.4(p_Holm=0.048),表明防御性编码模式与HumanEval精确输出基准存在冲突。RQ2(质量):所有四个NFR的不可读密度均显著下降(如Performance NL-rich 0.88→0.69,下降22%);代码异味密度在针对该属性的NFR下下降(0.019→0.011);错误处理的异常密度上升(0.99→1.18)。RQ3(鲁棒性):每题不可读度STDEV在所有干预-基线对比中显著降低(p_Holm<0.05);Pass@1 STDEV在描述层面下降但经校正后未达显著。干预提示更短且词汇多样性更低(Jaccard 0.10-0.13 vs 0.44-0.59)但仍表现出更低的静态质量敏感性。RQ4(形式):NL-rich vs Structured在正确性上差异可忽略(|δ|≤0.023,最小p_Holm=0.080),在质量密度上也仅略有差异。
AI.conclusion: ISO标准化内容充实改善了静态分析质量代理指标和鲁棒性,但未能可靠提升功能正确性;在错误处理情况下可能降低扩展测试通过率。当ISO内容固定时,散文与JSON形式在实证上可互换。实践上应优先投资于基于标准的内容(充实程度),而非序列化形式;工具集成可自由选择JSON或散文而无需担心正确性惩罚。研究强调了HumanEval基准对系统级ISO/IEC 25010特征(如错误处理与精确输出测试的固有冲突)的有限可观测性,提示需要在架构规模基准上进一步验证充实效益。未来工作包括MBPP复制、多模型测试、HumanEval-NFR扩展以及需求歧义性的直接测量。

title: Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models
comment: Published in COLM 2026
summary: Which reasoning behaviors are associated with correct answers in reasoning models, and does reasoning-oriented training amplify those behaviors? This distinction is important because reasoning-oriented training can make traces look more deliberative without amplifying the behaviors most tied to model correctness. We quantify this mismatch with Behavioral Lift, a metric that measures how much correctness changes when a behavior is present versus absent in a model's reasoning trace. Across 15 models and 6 benchmarks spanning text-only and vision-language reasoning, we annotate 15,282 traces with a taxonomy whose core behaviors are defined for both LLM and VLM traces. We find evidence for an Amplification-Lift Gap, in which thinking models strongly amplify self-correction, hypothesis testing, and uncertainty acknowledgment, while the highest-lift behaviors are confidence calibration, knowledge alignment, and self-awareness. Confidence calibration is among the strongest positive signals of correctness in both modalities, yet is barely amplified; uncertainty acknowledgment is amplified by 3--7$\times$, yet is weakly or negatively associated with correctness. We find that reasoning-oriented training does not preferentially amplify the highest-Lift behaviors, motivating process-level objectives that reward calibrated and grounded reasoning rather than surface form alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析了15个推理模型在6个基准测试上的15,282条推理轨迹,发现思维型训练放大的行为(如自我修正、假设检验、犹豫表达)并非与正确性最相关的行为,从而揭示了一个"放大-提升差距"(Amplification-Lift Gap)。最高的Behavioral Lift行为(置信校准、知识对齐、自我意识)几乎未被放大,提示过程级训练目标应奖励校准且有依据的推理。
AI.motivation: 近期推理导向的post-training(如o1、R1)使模型生成的推理轨迹更长、更具"深思熟虑"外观,但这种表面化的审慎并不一定指向正确推理的核心行为。准确率无法区分"行为出现频率"与"行为与成功推理的关联强度"。因此需要区分:哪些行为被放大、哪些行为真正预测正确性,以及二者是否一致——这关系到如何设计有效的过程监督与训练目标。
AI.method: 1. 提出跨模态行为分类法:9个高层行为(计划、目标追踪、假设检验、自我修正、不确定性表达、置信校准、自我意识、证据引用、知识对齐),外加失败模式、推理质量、推理类型、视觉基础等标签,适用于LLM与VLM。2. 定义两个度量:(a) Behavioral Lift = P(correct|behavior=true) − P(correct|behavior=false);(b) Recovery Rate = 在出现至少一个失败模式下仍得到正确答案的概率。3. 评测15个模型(Qwen3、OLMo-3、Nemotron、DeepSeek-R1-Distill等)跨6个基准(VisualPuzzles、MathVista、MMMU、LogiQA2、MATH-500、MMLU-Pro),共15,282条轨迹,使用GPT-4o作为LLM-as-judge标注。4. 通过三judge交叉验证(DeepSeek-V3、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemini-3-Flash)、人工核查、within-question对照(同题8次采样)、线性探针、噪声注入敏感性与prompting实验等多种鲁棒性检验。
AI.result: 核心发现是"放大-提升差距"(Amplification-Lift Gap):思维模型显著放大自我修正、假设检验与不确定性表达(分别约21–55% vs. 3–15%、22–52% vs. 4–18%、25–85% vs. 4–28%),但这些被放大行为的Lift最低甚至为负——不确定性表达在VLM/LLM上Lift分别为−16.1%和−13.9%,假设检验仅+1.0%。最高Lift行为是置信校准(VLM +72.2%,LLM +79.6%)、知识对齐、自我意识,然而思维模型对它们的放大几乎为零。Recovery Rate分析显示:在需要逐步计算的任务上(VisualPuzzles、MATH-500、MMLU-Pro),思维模型的恢复率是指导模型的2–3倍;但在以模式匹配为主的LogiQA2上指导模型反而更优。该差距在OLMo-3 SFT阶段已出现,且在2B到32B规模上持续存在。Prompting实验进一步验证:鼓励高Lift行为(置信校准等)在MATH-500上提升+5.8pp准确率,鼓励低Lift行为(普遍表达犹豫)在所有基准上降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 被放大的审慎行为(自我修正、假设检验、犹豫表达)并不能可靠预测正确性;真正可靠的信号是置信校准、知识对齐与自我意识。当前以最终答案为奖励的推理训练使轨迹更长更犹豫,却未集中强化与正确性最相关的行为。模型在需要扩展计算与从失败中恢复的任务上受益最明显,而在快速模式识别任务上可能受损。未来应设计奖励校准、证据基础与知识对齐的过程级目标,而不是奖励表面的审慎形式。Behavioral Lift可作为审计过程目标是否对齐正确性的工具。局限包括:仅分析可见trace、自动化评判的潜在偏差、Lift仅描述性而非因果。

title: CutClean: Neural Network Pruning for Privacy-Preserving Inference
summary: Neural networks are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications with growing privacy leakage concerns. We show that this privacy leakage can occur even in the absence of representation imbalances that lead to traditional dataset biases. This poses significant privacy risks when deploying models that process sensitive attributes. In this context, we propose CutClean, a privacy-aware pruning method that allows to reduce privacy information flow through the network, while increasing its sparsity. Our approach employs auxiliary linear privacy heads placed at each network's block to quantify information leakage, and further applies increasing levels of sparsity to remove the private attribute leakage, measured in terms of the accuracy of the privacy head attached to the last block. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach effectively minimizes private information flow while achieving high sparsity rates and preserving classification target accuracy.

AI.tldr: CutClean是一种隐私感知的结构化剪枝框架，通过在网络各块附加隐私头来量化信息泄漏，结合互信息正则化训练和L1范数结构化剪枝，在显著降低敏感属性泄漏的同时实现高稀疏率并保持分类精度。
AI.motivation: 神经网络即使在未显式使用敏感属性训练的情况下，其内部表征仍可能编码隐私信息，且这种泄漏可独立于数据集偏差存在。现有隐私保护方法多依赖对抗性微调或数据集平衡，存在训练不稳定、需修改损失函数等问题。剪枝虽被广泛用于模型压缩，但其在隐私保护方面的潜力尚未被系统探索，亟需一种模型中心的后置隐私干预方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 在网络每个块输出端附加辅助线性隐私头$g_i^p$，用于量化各深度处的隐私信息流动；(2) 在线批互信息(MI)感知训练——交替优化隐私头（交叉�损失）与骨干网络（最小化表征与隐私标签间的互信息可微代理$\mathcal{I}_z$），避免直接对抗优化导致的退化解；(3) 基于归一化L1范数的结构化剪枝，以全局稀疏度$s$移除整个通道，通过网格搜索在隐私头精度阈值$P^{\text{threshold}}$约束下选择可接受的最优剪枝模型，并进行微调。优化目标为$\mathcal{J}=\mathcal{L}_y+\gamma\sum_i\mathcal{I}_z(\hat{z}_i)$。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上均有效：Celeb-A"blonde"属性——隐私头精度降低24.86%，稀疏度60%，目标精度损失<1.5%；Celeb-A"heavy make-up"——隐私头精度降低15.91%，稀疏度30%；Corrupted-CIFAR10——隐私头精度降至13.33%（接近随机猜测），目标精度保持81.36%；Waterbirds——隐私头精度降低24.4%，目标精度仅降2.21%。ViT-B16上同样验证有效（稀疏度50%，隐私降低25.11%）。消融实验表明剪枝后微调对维持目标性能至关重要。
AI.conclusion: CutClean是首个将结构化剪枝定位为隐私保护机制（而非压缩或鲁棒性工具）的框架，证明了隐私泄漏减少与高效模型部署之间存在意想不到的兼容性。该方法无需对抗极小极大优化，具有更好的训练稳定性与部署适用性，并在CNN（ResNet18）与Transformer（ViT-B16）架构上均表现一致，为现有训练阶段的去偏与隐私保护方法提供了互补的后置解决方案。

title: Do AI chatbots find what experts would? Effects of model, user role, and sample size on study retrieval for medical questions
summary: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used to answer clinical questions with citations to relevant clinical studies. Prior research has largely focused on citation fabrication, leaving a gap in evaluating the quality of retrieved studies and the factors driving their selection. In this study, we evaluated three general-purpose LLM chatbots: Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and ChatGPT GPT-5.5. We prompted the models with clinical questions adapted from 20 review questions in Issues 6 and 7 of the 2026 Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, simulating patient, clinician, and evidence-synthesis researcher roles. Each chatbot was queried under each user role with four independent repetitions, yielding 720 responses. Each chatbot was asked to support its answers with primary clinical citations, which we benchmarked against the included and excluded study sets of the Cochrane reviews. On average, a chatbot response retrieved 39.2% $\pm$ 29.8% of Cochrane included studies, while citing 5.0% $\pm$ 9.4% of excluded studies. Recall of Cochrane included studies varied significantly by model and user role. ChatGPT achieved higher recall than Claude or Gemini (63.1% $\pm$ 29.5% vs. 37.0% $\pm$ 23.8% vs. 17.3% $\pm$ 13.1%; $p=2.0\times10^{-5}$). The researcher role yielded higher recall than the clinician or patient roles (42.8% $\pm$ 30.8% vs. 38.6% $\pm$ 28.9% vs. 36.1% $\pm$ 29.3%; $p=2.0\times10^{-5}$). Controlling for publication year, citations per year, and open-access status, sample size was the only independently significant predictor of retrieval (odds ratio 1.80 per 1-unit increase in log sample size, 95% CI 1.37-2.36, $p=2.34\times10^{-5}$). These findings suggest that while LLM chatbots can retrieve some studies identified by expert reviewers, their performance varies by model and user role, and they exhibit a bias toward clinical trials with larger sample sizes.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了三个通用大语言模型聊天机器人（Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、ChatGPT GPT-5.5）在回答临床医学问题时检索相关临床研究的能力，将其引用与Cochrane系统综述的纳入研究集进行对比，发现聊天机器人平均仅能检索39.2%的专家纳入研究，且表现出对大样本临床试验的检索偏差。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM聊天机器人越来越多地被用于回答临床问题并附带文献引用，先前研究主要关注引用伪造（fabrication）问题，但对于检索到的研究质量以及驱动研究选择的因素评估不足。此外，不同用户角色（患者、临床医生、证据综合研究者）是否会影响聊天机器人检索研究的选择，这一问题尚未得到探讨。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：从2026年Cochrane系统综述数据库第6期和第7期中选取20个干预性系统综述，涵盖多种临床领域。2. 实验设计：采用3×3×4×20的因子设计——3个聊天机器人 × 3种用户角色（患者、临床医生、证据综合研究者）× 4次重复 × 20个综述问题，共产生720个响应。3. 提示设计：三种角色提示保持一致性，并明确指示聊天机器人引用原始研究而非二次文献。4. 评估方法：将聊天机器人引用的临床研究对照纳入研究和排除研究集进行基准测试，通过block permutation test评估组间差异，并通过逻辑回归控制出版年份、年引用量和开放获取状态后分析样本量对检索的独立预测作用。
AI.result: 1. 整体表现：平均每个响应检索了39.2%±29.8%的Cochrane纳入研究，同时引用了5.0%±9.4%的排除研究。2. 模型差异显著：ChatGPT的纳入研究召回率最高（63.1%±29.5%），显著优于Claude（37.0%±23.8%）和Gemini（17.3%±13.1%）（p=2.0×10⁻⁵）。3. 角色效应显著：证据综合研究者角色召回率最高（42.8%±30.8%），高于临床医生（38.6%±28.9%）和患者角色（36.1%±29.3%）（p=2.0×10⁻⁵）。4. 偏差发现：在控制出版年份、年引用量和开放获取状态后，样本量是唯一具有独立显著预测作用的因素（每增加1单位对数样本量的OR=1.80，95% CI 1.37-2.36，p=2.34×10⁻⁵），表明聊天机器人对大样本临床试验存在检索偏差。
AI.conclusion: LLM聊天机器人虽然能够检索到部分专家评审者纳入的研究，但其表现因模型和用户角色而存在显著差异，且系统性地偏向于检索大样本临床试验。这表明基于聊天机器人的证据检索具有不完整性、上下文依赖性和偏差性，对依赖聊天机器人获取医学信息的患者、临床医生、LLM开发者、医学AI研究者和政策制定者都具有重要启示意义。

title: PPAPlace: Differentiable Cross-Stage Objectives for Chip Placement Optimization
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, accepted at ICCAD 2026
summary: Macro placement significantly affects a chip's post-route performance, power, and area (PPA). Most placement methods optimize half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) as the primary objective. However, recent benchmarking shows a near-zero correlation between HPWL and post-route timing metrics such as the worst negative slack (WNS) and total negative slack (TNS). As a result, all six evaluated artificial intelligence (AI) placers degraded PPA relative to the hierarchical baseline. Recent efforts have tried to train cross-stage predictors to close this gap. However, existing methods focus on macro-only representations and use pre-route metrics as training labels. A label fidelity study of ten circuits at four design flow stages reveals that HPWL and pre-route timing poorly reflect final post-route timing rankings. In contrast, post-global-routing achieves the best balance between final timing fidelity and label generation cost-effectiveness. Based on this finding, PPAPlace is a timing-driven differentiable surrogate predicting post-route PPA from macro and standard-cell placements. The surrogate is a dual-stream predictor that combines graph attention over the chip netlist with spatial convolution over the placement grid. It is trained on post-global-routing labels. The predicted WNS and TNS gradients flow end-to-end back to cell coordinates. PPAPlace exploits these gradients in two ways: as a co-objective injected into an analytical placer's optimization loop (PPAPlace-CoOpt), and as a post-placement refinement step that adjusts macro positions via projected gradient descent (PPAPlace-Refine). On five ChiPBench test circuits excluded from training, PPAPlace improves average WNS and TNS by 22\% and 51\% over the hierarchical baseline while preserving power and routability, using the same predictor without test-circuit retraining. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PPAPlace提出了一种面向芯片布局（PPA, Performance-Power-Area）的可微分代理模型，通过post-global-routing阶段标签训练，结合图注意力网络与空间卷积的双流架构，将预测的WNS/TNS梯度端到端回传至单元坐标。在5个ChiPBench测试电路上，平均WNS和TNS分别比Hier-RTLMP基线改善22%和51%，同时保持功耗与可布线性不变。
AI.motivation: 现有布局方法主要优化半周长线长(HPWL)，但ChiPBench基准测试表明HPWL与后路由时序指标(WNS/TNS)的相关性接近零(-0.08)，导致全部六种AI布局器的PPA均劣于分层基线。先前的跨阶段预测方法存在两个未经验证的假设：(1)使用pre-route STA标签，未确认其是否能忠实保留后路由PPA排序；(2)仅用宏模块位置表示布局，丢弃了标准单元密度与布线拥塞等关键信息。
AI.method: (1) 标签保真度研究：对10个电路在4个设计阶段(HPWL、Pre-CTS STA、Post-CTS、Post-GRT)与Post-DRT真值进行Spearman相关分析，发现Post-GRT在10个电路上均达到ρ≥0.78，平均标签时间仅0.20小时(对比Post-DRT为3.7小时)；(2) 混合尺寸布局表示：64×64空间网格含5通道(单元密度、Pin密度、宏占用、RUDY拥塞、网包围盒密度)，图表示中宏为节点并附带位置/尺寸/引脚数/网度/平均网跨距等特征；(3) 双流预测器：3层CNN处理空间网格生成256维嵌入，4层GAT(128维，4头注意力)处理网表图，拼接后经2层MLP输出[WNS, TNS, Power, Area]；(4) 训练目标为MSE损失与对电路内样本对的排序损失(λ_r=0.5)；(5) 全可微分特征提取(Gaussian splatting、log-sum-exp平滑)使梯度端到端回流；(6) 两种部署模式：PPAPlace-CoOpt将代理作为共目标注入到DREAMPlace解析优化循环(W=200步预热后线性增加λ_p至0.01)；PPAPlace-Refine对已收敛布局进行30步投影梯度下降(T=30, α=0.001)。
AI.result: 在5个ChiPBench留出测试电路(swerv_wrapper、ariane133、black_parrot、bp_be、ariane136)上：(1) 主结果：PPAPlace-CoOpt+Refine达到平均WNS=0.78×、TNS=0.49×基线(改善22%/51%)，优于Re²MaP(0.89×/0.61×)与所有先前方法；在6/10电路-指标对中取得最优，功耗保持0.99-1.02×基线，拥塞变化极小；(2) 梯度质量：与真实post-GRT梯度的余弦相似度对WNS/TNS分别为0.53/0.46，所有电路均为正值，gradcheck数值误差<10⁻⁶；(3) 泛化能力：留出DREAMPlace放置的Spearman ρ=0.77、Kendall τ=0.58、Top-5精度68%(随机1%)；跨布局器(RTLMP)ρ=0.61；零样本迁移到IBM 45nm Superblue16/18上ρ=0.68/0.62；(4) 消融实验：宏-only+pre-route STA的τ仅0.08，GAT+CNN+Post-GRT组合达0.31(约4×提升)，双流架构优于单一CNN(0.22)或GAT(0.18)；(5) 在线开销：CoOpt在DREAMPlace基础上增加不到2.5×布局时间。
AI.conclusion: PPAPlace证明基于post-GRT标签训练的可微分代理能够提供任何解析代理都无法实现的基于梯度的PPA反馈。CoOpt与Refine互补——前者重塑全局拓扑但需集成到可微分布局器，后者仅需合法布局即可局部精炼因此可应用于商业工具。主要局限包括：训练限于Nangate45库、约20步后精炼出现分布外退化、跨布局器迁移(ρ=0.61)落后于同布局器精度(0.77)，未来可通过分布感知停止准则、信任域约束与域自适应等技术进一步提升鲁棒性。

title: AdsWorldEngine: A Self-Evolving Conversational Advertising Agent through Orchestrator and Tool Coevolution
summary: Conversational advertising aims to deliver useful ads within multi-turn assistant interactions. Unlike conventional query-based advertising, where the user's intent is often expressed in a short standalone query, conversational ads must infer latent commercial intent from the current user query, the assistant response, and dialogue history while also deciding whether an ad would be helpful rather than intrusive. We propose AdsWorldEngine, an agentic framework for conversational advertising. AdsWorldEngine uses an Opportunity Gate to determine whether ads should be shown, an Orchestrator to generate commercial intents, call advertising tools, and construct a top-3 ad slate, and an Evaluator to score delivered ads for offline optimization. The central contribution is an iterative actor-tool training procedure: we first train the Orchestrator with supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, then use high- and low-reward rollouts to construct preference data to train tools. This creates a self-improving loop in which the system learns not only how to use advertising tools, but also how to improve them from rewarded behavior. To support subjective production decisions, we introduce label grounded judgment modeling, which trains judgment models from human labels collected under explicit guidelines. It enriches labels with thinking traces, filters inconsistent rationales through reflection, and further optimizes binary judgments with a cost sensitive GRPO variant that preserves asymmetric reward gaps. Offline, AdsWorldEngine improves diversity by 60% and relevance by 80% over the current production ad delivery system. In an online A/B test, it increases RPM by 22% and ads coverage by 74%.

AI.tldr: AdsWorldEngine 是面向对话式广告投放的智能体框架,采用"机会门 + 编排器 + 工具集 + 评估器"四组件架构,通过监督微调 + GRPO 训练编排器,再利用高/低奖励轨迹构建偏好数据迭代优化下游检索/相关性/排序工具,实现 Orchestrator 与工具的协同进化;同时提出"标签锚定判断建模 + 代价敏感 GRPO"以处理生产环境中不对称错误的判断任务。
AI.motivation: 传统搜索广告依赖简短独立查询的显式意图,而对话式广告需从多轮对话、助手回复和用户上下文中推断隐式商业意图,并判断是否值得展示广告而非造成打扰。现有研究多针对单组件(生成、插入位置、定价等),未能端到端优化"何时投 + 投什么"的完整投放链路;此外,生产环境中的判断(触发、相关性)具有不对称代价(误触发伤害用户体验 > 漏放机会),而现有 LLM-as-a-Judge 与 SFT 无法精确控制该决策边界。
AI.method: 1) 框架:Opportunity Gate 结合规则与学习模型决定是否投放;Orchestrator(actor)完成状态消解、约束抽取、意图生成、工具调用与三选一 slate 构造;Tool Set 包含检索/相关性/排序等工具;Evaluator 提供离线相关性 + 多样性打分。2) Orchestrator 训练:SFT 教授轨迹格式 → GRPO 以 Evaluator 奖励对齐中间决策与最终 slate 质量。3) 迭代 Actor-Tool 优化:固定工具用 GRPO 更新 Orchestrator → 用更新后的 Orchestrator 采样,对比高/低奖励 slate 构造 (intent, a⁺, a⁻) 偏好对,以 DPO 式损失训练下游相关性工具;交替进行 T 轮。4) 标签锚定判断建模:为带标签样本生成符合生产准则的思考链,经反思过滤不一致推理,SFT + 代价敏感 GRPO(用非对称奖励矩阵,且不除以组内标准差以保留原始奖励差距)训练触发/相关性判断模型。5) 附录补充 On-Policy Distillation 以恢复通用能力。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking 基座,机会门相对 GPT-5 提示基线 FPR 降低 39.07% 且 TPR 不变,平衡准确率 +2.51%;对话-广告相关性模型 FPR 降低 12.71%、平衡准确率 +7.51%。经三轮 Orchestrator-Tool 协同迭代后,相对现役投放系统多样性 +62.87%、相关性 +82.26%。在线 20 天 A/B 试验(Microsoft Copilot 全球站点):RPM +22%,广告覆盖率 +74%。广义域 OPD 在触发模型上 7 项基准平均 +3.45 pp、相关性模型平均 +2.46 pp,且不损失专项能力。
AI.conclusion: AdsWorldEngine 验证了将对话广告视为端到端 Agent 投放问题、并通过 Orchestrator-Tool 协同进化 + 标签锚定判断建模进行联合优化的有效性,生产环境同时获得离线质量提升与在线收益增长,为构建在生产约束下多组件协同进化的复合语言模型系统提供了可行路径。

title: ASSERT: A Measurement Pipeline for GenAI Audits
summary: Audits of generative AI (GenAI) systems often summarize behavior as a reported rate: how often the audited system complies with policy. Researchers and stakeholders use that rate to compare systems, track regressions, and gate deployment. A reported rate reflects both the system under audit and the measurement choices behind it, so a change in the rate can leave it unclear whether the system or those choices moved. We introduce ASSERT, a specification-driven measurement pipeline for GenAI audits that ties each reported rate to a written specification of the measurement choices used to produce it. ASSERT helps draft a behavioral rubric and test cases, then runs the audit against a GenAI system and returns a reported rate. In a case study on conversational deception, we observe that the reported rate moves substantially with the dialogue setup, the simulated user, the judge, and the evidence bar for non-compliance. These measurement choices substantially change the reported rate and can reorder GenAI system rankings. Because each reported rate is tied to an explicit specification, differences across audits are easier to attribute and interpret.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASSERT管道，一个用于GenAI审计的规范化测量流程。核心论点是：GenAI审计报告的合规率不仅反映被审计系统，还反映了背后的测量选择（任务定义、模拟用户、评判模型、证据标准等）。论文通过会话欺骗（conversational deception）的案例研究证明，合理的测量选择变化可使报告率波动超过15个百分点，并可能改变系统排名。
AI.motivation: GenAI安全审计中常以"合规率"作为系统比较、回归追踪和部署决策的依据，但报告率同时受系统行为和测量选择（测试设计、模拟用户、评判模型、证据标准）影响。当这些选择隐含不透明时，报告率的变化无法区分是系统变了还是测量方式变了，导致比较、复现和解读困难。论文旨在将测量选择显式化、规范文档化，使报告率与具体测量规范绑定。
AI.method: 1）设计规范化测量管道ASSERT：(a)系统化阶段——将模糊背景概念（如欺骗）细化为具体的行为模式和概念规范；(b)行为评分标准——将概念规范转化为评判者可执行的评分规则；(c)测试用例生成——基于测试设计（行为×交互条件）用LLM生成具体场景；(d)滚动协议——模拟用户与目标系统多轮对话生成transcript；(e)评判与估计——LLM裁判评分并聚合成报告率。2）采用multiverse analysis范式：在固定被审计系统（GPT-5.5）下，系统性地替换模拟用户、评判模型、证据标准等，观察报告率的变化。3）案例研究对象为会话欺骗（conversational misrepresentation），构造10条评分标准（6条非许可、4条许可），与4种交互条件交叉，每格5个场景，共120条transcript。4）进一步对3个其他安全概念（残障表征、危机响应、敏感属性推断）做敏感性分析。
AI.result: 1）基线报告率约82%，固定规范下的随机重跑范围约82-87%（噪声下限）。2）替换模拟用户：报告率从82%（Grok-4.3）升至>90%（GPT-5.5）。3）替换评判模型：相同transcript下报告率从80%（Opus-4.7）到95%（Grok-4.3），跨度15点；GPT-5.5与Opus-4.7即使整体率差仅2点，也在26/120条上判定不一致。4）证据标准变化：在GPT-5.5评判下，宽松标准约80%、严格标准>90%，条件间范围73-90% vs 87-97%。5）系统排名不稳定：跨3评判×3被审计系统=9格矩阵，无单一排名在所有评判下保持；最强失败标准跟踪的是评判者而非被审计系统（选择效应主导，归因效应较弱，Jaccard≈0.7）。6）跨概念敏感性：评判替换是最一致的大幅变化来源，但主导轴因概念而异（欺骗看评判者、危机响应看诱发模式、ISA相对稳定）。
AI.conclusion: 1）单一报告率作为系统安全/性能证据不可靠，除非差异大于合理替代规范所诱发的偏移。2）评判者选择尤其关键，应明确披露并测试合理替代；规范报告率小于替代间偏移的系统排名不应被视为决定性。3）静态benchmark与生成式审计管道都只实例化一种合理操作化，固定规范下的置信区间未涵盖规范不确定性。4）测量规范应与模型卡片、数据表、benchmark卡并列作为可审查产物；通过显式化测量选择，可定位报告率差异的来源、提升可复现性和可解释性。5）局限：报告率仅对设计诱发的transcript分布有效，外推到部署流量等目标需桥接论证；准则级误差独立性假设简化了聚合误报率；生成-评判-模拟用户均依赖LLM，误差可能跨阶段相关。

title: Federated Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework, Empirical Analysis, and Future Directions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become core components of cloud-based intelligent services in academia and industry, yet their training and deployment are hindered by high computational costs, data centralization, and privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) offers a decentralized training paradigm that enables clients to collaboratively train a learning model without sharing raw data, making it a promising solution for privacy-preserving LLM training and reasoning. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of federated prompt learning (FPL) to review recent advances in integrating the federated learning paradigm and large language models, answering the following research questions: RQ1: The fundamental motivations, characteristics, and enabling technologies of FPL, and how it differs from conventional FL and full-model federated fine-tuning; RQ2: The trade-offs FPL approaches exhibit in performance, communication efficiency, computational overhead, scalability, personalization, and heterogeneity handling; RQ3: The remaining security, privacy, robustness, and system challenges, along with key future research directions. To this end, we systematically examine existing FPL methods across the full model lifecycle: pre-training, fine-tuning, and practical applications, while discussing security, privacy, and robustness issues and summarizing existing defense mechanisms. Finally, we highlight open challenges and future directions, aiming to help readers understand how the insights drive research in FPL.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于联邦提示学习（FPL）的综合性综述论文，旨在系统地回顾联邦学习（FL）与大语言模型（LLM）集成的最新进展，聚焦于提示学习（prompt learning）作为联邦环境下LLM适配的核心接口。文章围绕三个研究问题展开：FPL的基本动机与使能技术、与传统FL及全模型联邦微调的差异；FPL方法在性能、通信、计算、可扩展性、个性化和异构性方面的权衡；以及安全性、隐私、鲁棒性和系统层面的挑战与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 1. LLMs面临集中式训练的数据中心化、隐私、高计算成本等根本性限制；2. 传统FL直接应用于LLMs时，传输全模型参数带来极高的通信与存储开销；3. 现有综述多聚焦于通用FL、FedLLM架构或LLM安全，未将提示/适配器方法作为一等公民的分布式优化范式进行系统化分析；4. 缺乏贯穿LLM完整生命周期（训练→个性化→推理→部署→应用→保护）的统一框架。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述与基于分类学的比较分析相结合的方法：从Web of Science、Google Scholar、dblp等数据库检索相关文献，按发表周期、文献类型、研究相关性和方法完整性设定纳入/排除标准，最终保留52篇高质量研究进行系统编码（研究目标、核心方法、模型架构、数据集、评估指标、实证结果、局限性）。基于技术机制将方法组织为结构化分类学，并从性能、效率、通信成本、计算开销、隐私保护、可扩展性和应用场景进行比较分析。论文还将现有研究沿LLM生命周期分为三类互动关系：(i) FL服务于LLM训练与适配；(ii) LLM增强FL；(iii) FL与LLM的协同整合。
AI.result: 1. 形式化定义了FPL范式：冻结骨干网络+协作优化轻量级提示/适配器模块；2. 总结FPL的典型训练流程（服务器分发→客户端本地优化→仅传输轻量更新→服务器聚合）；3. 系统分析了代表性方法：FedPepTAO（分层重要性选择，最高减少97.59%训练时间，准确率提升60.8%）、FLoSS（仅通信阶段稀疏化）、FedHDS（分层数据选择）、FedDQC（基于IRA质量度量的课程学习）、DualFPT（共享+个性化双提示分解）、FlexLoRA（异构LoRA秩）、FAH-QLoRA（量化+动态秩分配）、FedMRG（医疗报告生成）、eFedLLM（分布式推理，内存与带宽降低60%）、SplitLoRA（拆分学习+LoRA）等；4. 揭示了FPL相比传统FL的优势：通信与计算开销降低数个数量级、支持客户端个性化、缓解数据异构下的负迁移问题；5. 系统梳理了FPL的安全/隐私/鲁棒性威胁（梯度反演、成员推断、后门攻击、投毒攻击）和防御机制。
AI.conclusion: 1. FPL已成为将LLM适配与联邦学习结合的主导范式，通过仅联邦化轻量级模块（而非完整基础模型）实现了可扩展、高效且隐私保护的大模型协作；2. FPL在性能、通信效率、计算开销、可扩展性、个性化与异构性处理之间存在显著权衡，不存在单一通用最优框架；3. 仍面临关键挑战：提示对齐与负迁移、安全/隐私/鲁棒性威胁、数据质量异构性、系统层面的部署复杂性；4. 未来研究方向包括：自适应个性化、隐私保护聚合、异构资源调度、多模态扩展、绿色联邦LLM、对抗防御机制、与基础模型预训练协同设计等。

title: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model
comment: Technical review and engineering monograph, 314 pages, 30 figures. Includes an evidence audit, a companion research artifact with 206 reliability records, and runnable protocols for evaluating and operating AI coding agents. August 2026. Source, companion, and reusable protocols: this https URL
summary: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case records through a structured multivocal review, targeted update audits, software-engineering coverage analysis, and distributed-systems evidence synthesis. Across this evidence, many apparent model failures originate elsewhere in the system, while improvements at one layer often fail to propagate to end-to-end outcomes. Evaluation and operation are treated as a dependency chain in which weaknesses in task construction, execution environments, retrieval, state management, verification, or observability can invalidate downstream conclusions. The monograph contributes a versioned catalog of 206 reliability records: 193 gated practices, including 56 developed in depth, plus 13 research leads; an evidence ledger; a framework for dependency and repair asymmetry across the agent lifecycle; measurements and failure cases from operated agent systems; runnable evaluation and reliability protocols; and five reusable agent skills with evidence maps. Together, these provide a system-level methodology for distinguishing model capability from infrastructure effects, designing defensible evaluations, and building systems that recover safely when components fail. The review is structured rather than exhaustive, evidence strength varies by topic, and results depend on workload and configuration. The methods record which search lanes were executed, which remain unexecuted, and limits on evidence-grading claims.

AI.tldr: 该专著系统探讨AI编码智能体的可靠性问题,提出将智能体视为"系统"而非仅"模型"进行评估与操作的框架,通过多声文献综述整合大量证据,产出一套可版本化管理的可靠性实践目录、评估协议与可复用智能体技能,以区分模型能力与基础设施效应。
AI.motivation: 当前AI编码智能体的可靠性普遍以模型视角进行评估,但实际部署为复杂系统,其可靠性受执行环境、检索、状态管理、权限、审查接口、资源分配等多层因素影响。许多看似"模型失败"的问题实则源于系统其他层面,且单层优化常常无法传导至端到端结果。因此亟需一个系统级的评估与运营方法论,以区分模型能力与基础设施效应,设计可防御的评估,并构建能在组件失效时安全恢复的系统。
AI.method: 采用结构化多声文献综述(multivocal review),整合164篇学术文献、100份实践者记录、29项基准测试记录和17份作者系统案例记录,辅以定向更新审计、软件工程覆盖分析与分布式系统证据综合。方法论明确记录已执行与未执行的检索通道,并对证据分级声明设定限制,体现"结构化而非穷尽"的研究态度。整体将评估与运营视为一条依赖链,关注任务构建、执行环境、检索、状态管理、验证、可观测性等环节如何使下游结论失效。
AI.result: 产出五项核心成果:(1)版本化的206条可靠性记录目录,其中193条为受门控(gated)的实践、56条深入展开、13条为研究线索;(2)配套的证据台账(evidence ledger);(3)贯穿智能体生命周期的依赖与修复不对称性框架;(4)基于运营系统的实测数据与失效案例;(5)可运行的评估与可靠性协议,以及五个带证据映射的可复用智能体技能。
AI.conclusion: 该专著提供了一种系统级方法论,用于在AI编码智能体的整个生命周期中区分模型能力与基础设施效应,设计可防御的评估体系,并构建能在组件失效时安全恢复的系统。其贡献在于将可靠性工程从模型层面提升到系统层面,但作者也明确指出:综述是结构化而非穷尽性的,证据强度因主题而异,结果依赖具体工作负载与配置,因此方法论中对证据检索与分级的局限性保持透明记录。

title: Engineering Signals of Human-AI Collaboration in the Agentic Coding Era: A Longitudinal Analysis of 33,228 Pull Requests from vLLM and SGLang with Implications for Biomedical AI Agents and Bioinformatics Pipeline Developmen
comment: 24 pages, 9 Figures
summary: The rapid adoption of AI coding assistants and autonomous agentic development systems has coincided with major changes in the pace and structure of open-source software engineering. Yet empirical longitudinal evidence of these changes at the team level remains limited. We present a descriptive longitudinal analysis of seven engineering metrics: pull request (PR) throughput, cycle time, contributor diversity, PR comment density, merge rate, new-author participation, and PR size. Metrics were computed from all merged PRs in two high-velocity AI infrastructure repositories, vLLM (February 2023-June 2026; 18,290 PRs) and SGLang (January 2024-June 2026; 14,938 PRs). We segment development into four eras aligned with major changes in AI-assisted software development and examine human- and bot-authored activities. Both projects show substantial increases in development velocity and AI-developer collaboration signals. PR throughput increased 21x in vLLM and 17.9x in SGLang, while bot-authored PRs accounted for less than 0.2% of this growth, indicating that the increase was overwhelmingly human-driven. In the latest era, median cycle time was 1.04 days for vLLM and 0.62 days for SGLang, while P90 cycle times reached 16.8 and 14.3 days, respectively. Monthly unique authors increased steadily in both projects, suggesting broader contributor participation. PR comment density increased 4.2x in vLLM and 3.8x in SGLang, with bot comments contributing an estimated 15-20% of the increase. In contrast, PR size remained relatively stable across eras. Overall, AI-assisted development is associated with higher throughput, broader contributor participation, and increased AI-developer collaboration signals in high-velocity open-source software development.

AI.tldr: 本文对两个高速度AI基础设施开源项目（vLLM和SGLang）进行了描述性纵向分析，考察七个工程指标在AI辅助开发兴起后的变化，发现PR吞吐量大幅增加、贡献者更广泛、PR评论密度上升，但PR规模保持稳定，且增长主要来自人类开发者而非机器人。
AI.motivation: AI编程助手和自主代理开发系统的快速普及正在改变开源软件工程的速度和结构，但团队层面的纵向经验证据仍然有限。本文旨在通过分析高活跃度AI基础设施项目，提供AI辅助开发对开源协作影响的实证数据。
AI.method: 对vLLM（2023.2-2026.6，18,290个PR）和SGLang（2024.1-2026.6，14,938个PR）两个项目的所有已合并PR进行纵向分析，提取七个指标：PR吞吐量、周期时间、贡献者多样性、PR评论密度、合并率、新作者参与度、PR规模。将开发过程划分为四个时代，并区分人类与机器人作者的活动。
AI.result: vLLM的PR吞吐量增长21倍，SGLang增长17.9倍，但机器人PR贡献不足增长的0.2%，表明增长主要由人类驱动。最新时代vLLM中位周期时间为1.04天、SGLang为0.62天；P90分别为16.8天和14.3天。每月独立作者数稳步增长。PR评论密度在vLLM增长4.2倍、SGLang增长3.8倍，机器人评论约占增长的15-20%。PR规模在各时代保持相对稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在高速开源软件开发中，AI辅助开发与更高的吞吐量、更广泛的贡献者参与以及更强的AI-人类协作信号相关联。研究表明，AI工具并未取代人类开发者，而是放大了人类协作活动并增强了协作质量。

title: Hybrid Quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Privacy-Aware Federated Biosignal Learning
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings are sensitive biomedical data, limiting the ability of hospitals and wearable devices to share raw signals for centralized model training. Federated learning addresses this practical privacy constraint by enabling collaborative model training while keeping raw biosignal data at their respective sources. However, federated ECG classification remains challenging due to limited client-side samples, imbalanced arrhythmia labels, and non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data across clients. These constraints require classifiers that are both communication-efficient and robust to cross-client distribution shifts. In this work, we evaluate a hybrid quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network (HQKAN) against a multilayer perceptron (MLP) for five-class arrhythmia classification on the MIT-BIH dataset and three-class classification on the INCART dataset under federated averaging (FedAvg). Across multiple client configurations, HQKAN improves most aggregate and minority-class metrics while using 37.35% fewer trainable parameters and reducing communication cost by 24.89% on MIT-BIH; on INCART, it achieves corresponding reductions of 44.81% and 36.41%. These results indicate that HQKAN offers a compact, communication-efficient and robust alternative to the MLP baseline for privacy-aware federated learning on biosignal data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合量子启发的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（HQKAN），用于隐私保护的联邦心电图（ECG）心律失常分类。该模型在MIT-BIH（五分类）和INCART（三分类）数据集上，在联邦平均（FedAvg）框架下，相比多层感知机（MLP）基线，以更少的可训练参数和更低的通信开销实现了更好的整体性能与少数类性能。
AI.motivation: 心电图等生物医学信号具有高度隐私敏感性，跨机构共享原始数据进行集中训练受到限制。联邦学习虽能保护数据本地性，但ECG分类仍面临客户端样本有限、类别不平衡（MIT-BIH中N:F类比例约113:1）以及客户端间数据非独立同分布（non-IID）等挑战。这些限制要求分类器既通信高效，又对跨客户端分布偏移具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心部分：（1）数据集与预处理：使用MIT-BIH（187维单导联波形，5类AAMI心拍）和INCART（300维，3类）数据集；MIT-BIH训练/验证集按80/20分层划分，测试集独立保留；采用[0,1]归一化。（2）联邦设置：基于FLamby构建联邦优化流水线，仅使用FedAvg聚合；客户端数K∈{8,16,32}，每轮R=30轮，每客户端E=5个本地epoch；采用IID（轮询分配）和non-IID（Dirichlet分布，α=0.3主实验，扫参α∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1,1000}）两种分区；损失为逆类频加权交叉熵，优化器为AdamW（lr=10⁻³，weight decay=10⁻⁴，batch size=128）。（3）分类器架构：MLP基线（MIT-BIH：18,485参数；INCART：27,443参数）vs. HQKAN（全连接编码器+解码器+QKAN潜在特征处理器，MIT-BIH：11,581参数；INCART：15,147参数）；使用FlashQKAN框架结合cuTe DSL加速。评估指标包括macro-F1、Cohen's κ、Brier分数、AUROC、AUPRC及类级PPV/Sen/Spe（一对其余），异质性以Hellinger距离量化。
AI.result: MIT-BIH上，HQKAN相比MLP的可训练参数减少37.35%，通信成本降低24.89%；INCART上分别减少44.81%和36.41%。在所有客户端配置（8/16/32）及IID/non-IID分区下，HQKAN在macro-F1、Cohen's κ和Brier分数上均优于MLP基线。例如32客户端non-IID时，MIT-BIH上macro-F1：HQKAN 0.761 vs MLP 0.698；INCART上：0.850 vs 0.838。少数类（特别是MIT-BIH的F类和INCART的S类）也获得了更优的PPV和敏感性。在所有Dirichlet浓度下，HQKAN的AUROC和AUPRC均高于MLP，且在更大Hellinger距离时优势更明显，体现出对标签分布偏移的更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: HQKAN是一种紧凑、通信高效且对客户端异质性鲁棒的分类器，适用于隐私保护的生物信号联邦学习。其在MIT-BIH和INCART两个ECG基准上，以显著更少的参数和通信开销，在各种联邦配置下均优于MLP基线。结论表明，对客户端异质性的鲁棒性不必以模型或通信效率为代价。

title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate language generation by predicting multiple masks in a single forward pass. However, existing dLLMs can suffer from unreliable predictions in early denoising stages under aggressive parallelism strategies, leading to errors that can propagate to later stages. To tackle this issue, we present Consistency Forcing (CForce) for dLLMs, a distillation method to force the mask predictions of early stages to align with those of later stages. CForce trains the model on pre-collected self-rollout trajectories, thereby improving training-inference alignment. We introduce Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence as a distillation objective to conjoin the merits of forward and reverse KL. We further provide a theoretical analysis for the consistency objective to explain why CForce can approximately minimize the prediction error of early stages. Critically, the same formulation applies to both mask-to-token decoding and edit-capable decoding; in the edit-capable case, later token-to-token refinements provide additional supervision for earlier masked-state predictions. Experiments on non-edit and edit-capable LLaDA models show improved speed-quality trade-offs, especially under high-parallelism decoding budgets. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Consistency Forcing（CForce），通过让扩散语言模型的早期低上下文预测对齐同一模型在更晚、上下文更充分状态下的预测，提升高并行阈值解码的可靠性。方法在离线自生成轨迹上使用停止梯度的自蒸馏目标，并结合置信度自适应 KL（CAD）、揭示边界交叉熵锚点、由易到难的课程学习；在支持 token-to-token 编辑的 dLLM 中，还利用后续 T2T 修正监督早期 M2T 草稿。LLaDA2.1-mini 上，平均 TPF 从 6.94 提升至 9.08，同时平均得分从 85.57 提升至 86.41；LLaDA2.0-mini 上则以一定得分下降换取显著更高的并行度。总体上，CForce 对高并行、尤其是编辑能力解码更有效，但非编辑场景呈现明确的速度—质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过一次前向计算揭示多个遮罩位置来加速生成，但较低阈值或较高 TPF 预算会使早期低上下文状态的预测不可靠，错误在后续解码中传播。现有加速或蒸馏方法通常改变解码与缓存，或依赖教师生成、具有不同信息条件的轨迹，不能充分匹配学生模型真实阈值解码路径。编辑型 dLLM 的后续状态还能通过 token-to-token 修订纠正已提交 token，因此可为早期 mask-to-token 预测提供更及时、更有信息的监督。
AI.method: CForce 首先从预训练冷启动模型收集真实阈值解码的自生成轨迹，并按累计新揭示的 M2T token 数 S（默认 S=8）采样阶段边界，而不是按每个原生解码步采样，以控制存储和训练成本。对相邻阶段，早期状态作为学生输入，后期状态由同一模型在 stop-gradient 下产生目标分布：仍被遮罩的位置使用 CAD 目标，即 D_KL(p_tar||p_stu)+c_j D_KL(p_stu||p_tar)，其中 c_j 是后期目标的最大概率，以自适应平衡保守的前向 KL 与高置信时的逆向 KL；刚揭示的位置使用对真实 token 的 CE 锚点。训练逐步把后期状态中从 10% 增至 100% 的新揭示位置暴露给学生。对于编辑型模型，后续阶段发生的 T2T 变更也被纳入 CAD 域，并将 CE 扩展到所有学生阶段仍遮罩的位置。总损失为 CAD 加 λ_CE CE，论文给出基于 Pinsker 不等式和 TV 距离的误差上界，说明前向 KL 对应相邻阶段分布漂移，CE 对应揭示边界 token 误差。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、MBPP 和 HumanEval 上，LLaDA2.1-mini 采用质量模式（τ=0.7、τ_edit=0.5）时，平均 Score 从 85.57 提升到 86.41，平均 TPF 从 6.94 提升到 9.08；平均吞吐从 1051.94 TPS 提升到 1292.19 TPS（+22.84%），且代码任务上的收益更明显。LLaDA2.0-mini 采用 τ=0.9 时，TPF 从 3.60 提升到 6.42、吞吐从 600.73 TPS 提升到 857.96 TPS，但平均 Score 从 84.32 降至 80.88，体现非编辑设置下的速度—质量权衡；固定 TPF=8 时 CForce 仍取得最高平均得分。消融显示 S=8、课程学习、同一模型停止梯度目标、CAD 和 λ_CE=0.1 是较稳健的组合：CAD 相比前向 KL 将 TPF 从 5.07 提至 6.42，同时避免逆向 KL 的得分塌缩（65.57）；去掉课程或改用冻结教师目标都会降低得分和 TPF。论文的证据主要来自 LLaDA 系列、四个任务和指定阈值，训练使用 64 张 H800，尚缺少更广泛模型、任务和统计显著性验证。
AI.conclusion: CForce 的核心价值在于把 dLLM 加速目标从单纯减少去噪步数，转向提高早期状态在高并行阈值解码下的可靠性；同一套相邻阶段一致性思想可同时适配 M2T 和支持 T2T 编辑的模型。实验支持其在高并行预算下改善速度—质量前沿，且编辑型模型受益最大；但离线缓存轨迹会随学生更新逐渐偏离其真实推理轨迹，可能限制最终对齐程度，且非编辑模型的结果并非无条件提升质量。后续应研究在线轨迹收集、策略更新，以及在更大模型和更广泛任务上的有效性、鲁棒性和成本收益。

title: EchoRec: Multi-Item Prediction-Empowered Generative Recommendation via Cycle-Consistent Preference Alignment
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, Under Review
summary: Generative recommendation autoregressively generates the semantic IDs of the target item, unifying preference modeling and index retrieval within the shared token space. Recent attempts have introduced Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) into this field, yet they primarily inherit its efficiency merit, leaving its potential as dense supervision unexplored. Unlocking this potential hinges on whether future behaviors qualify as informative supervision. Our analysis reveals that future behaviors carry a semantic echo of the current one far above that of random pairs, which nevertheless decays along horizons under intent transitions, making them informative yet order-dependent signals. Motivated by this, we propose EchoRec, which empowers MTP with cycle-consistent holistic preference alignment across multi-horizon for generative recommendation. It comprises two synergistic modules. Horizon-aware Preference Generation (HPG) sequentially chains lightweight auxiliary branches upon the base recommender, where each branch conditions on its predecessor to respect preference evolution. Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment (VHA) further consolidates them into the holistic preference and echoes it back through cycle-consistent projectors to suppress spurious alignment, with theoretical guarantees that exclude the rank-collapse form of spurious alignment under an invertible transport, enabling the holistic preference to be retained in the decoding representation. All auxiliary components serve as disposable scaffolding discarded at inference, introducing negligible online serving overhead. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the superiority of our EchoRec, together with its naturally acquired multi-item generation ability. Our code and datasets will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: EchoRec是一个用于生成式推荐（Generative Recommendation）的框架，通过多令牌预测（Multi-Token Prediction, MTP）将未来行为作为时序依赖的密集监督信号，并采用循环一致的整体偏好对齐（Cycle-Consistent Holistic Preference Alignment）机制来确保解码表示真正内化整体偏好。它由两个协同模块组成：Horizon-aware Preference Generation（HPG）和Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment（VHA），在推理时丢弃所有辅助组件，几乎不增加在线服务开销。
AI.motivation: 现有将MTP引入生成式推荐的工作主要继承其效率优势，但忽略了其作为密集监督的潜力。论文通过动机分析发现：(1) 未来行为在语义ID（SID）层面与当前行为存在显著的"语义回声"（lift达到2.89×–21.02×），但随预测距离增加而衰减；(2) 并行MTP结构会导致多horizon预测同质化（inter-horizon Jaccard相似度62.73% vs. 53.21%），无法有效建模意图转移。核心挑战在于：(1) 如何将未来行为作为跨horizon的时序依赖监督；(2) 如何保证未来信号被解码表示真正内化而非被投影器"吸收"。
AI.method: EchoRec包含两个核心模块：1) Horizon-aware Preference Generation (HPG)：在基础推荐器（如RPG或SETRec）之上，顺序链式地附加轻量级辅助分支（MTP-1、MTP-2），每个分支条件依赖于前一个分支的表示来建模相邻horizon间的意图转移，复用共享的输出头和解码图。2) Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment (VHA)：将多horizon表示聚合成整体偏好表示z_f，然后通过前向投影器将解码表示z_n^0对齐到z_f。为解决单向对齐的"伪对齐"（spurious alignment）问题，引入反向投影器并施加循环一致性约束（L_cyc），通过Lemma 1（刻画循环一致性的往返几何特性）和Theorem 2（在可逆传输下排除rank-collapse形式的伪对齐）提供理论保证。所有辅助组件在推理时被丢弃，仅MTP-0参与在线服务。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews '23的Game、Baby、Arts三个数据集上，EchoRec显著优于6个基线（EAGER、TIGER、LETTER、ETEGRec、SETRec、RPG）：以RPG为骨干时，NDCG@10在三个数据集上分别提升11.35%、21.40%、18.29%；以SETRec为骨干时也获得一致提升（6.40%–17.68%），验证了框架的可插拔性。消融实验验证了HPG和VHA各自的贡献，且循环一致性约束进一步抑制了单向对齐的伪对齐问题。鲁棒性分析显示EchoRec在不同噪声比例（η=5%–80%）下均优于RPG，在η=20%时Baby的HR@10相对改进达54.89%。效率分析表明训练延迟适度增加（如Baby从11.25ms增至32.81ms），但推理延迟和内存与基础推荐器几乎相同（推理时仅使用MTP-0）。HPG还自然赋予了模型多物品生成能力，inter-horizon重叠度低于RPG-Seq.，证明各horizon预测具有差异化。
AI.conclusion: EchoRec成功解锁了MTP作为密集监督信号的潜力，通过将偏好建模视为声学回声过程——前向传播偏好跨horizon，回环验证其内化——显著提升了生成式推荐性能。其可插拔设计（兼容RPG和SETRec两种差异显著的骨干）和可忽略的推理开销使其具有实际部署价值。未来工作方向包括自适应horizon选择（根据语义回声衰减调整监督强度）以及网状预测架构（同时捕捉tokens和items间的细粒度相关性演化）。

title: HAM-RAG: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG for Structure-Faithful Interleaved Generation
summary: Existing multimodal RAG methods often flatten structured documents into isolated text and image units, weakening the source organization and local text-image logic needed for faithful evidence selection and placement. We propose HAM-RAG, a Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG framework for structure-faithful interleaved generation. HAM-RAG uses document hierarchy as a grounding signal across retrieval and generation, contextualizing textual and visual evidence and preserving source position and local text-image relations in the prompt. We further introduce HAM-Bench, covering Wukong, Wiki, arXiv, and Recipe across game walkthroughs, web pages, scientific papers, and step-wise recipe documents. Across multiple backbones, HAM-RAG improves the main multimodal average by 17.3% over the strongest non-hierarchical baseline. On Wukong, HAM-RAG improves Img-CBS by 24.2% over the strongest non-hierarchical baseline, demonstrating substantially better local text-image alignment. The main experiments and ablation study together demonstrate that document hierarchy is a key grounding signal for faithful image selection, placement, and local text-image alignment. These findings highlight the value of hierarchy-aware grounding for reliable multimodal assistants that generate answers faithful to the source organization, procedural structure, and local text-image evidence of structured documents, such as technical manuals, maintenance guides, and industrial SOPs. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAM-RAG（层次感知多模态RAG）框架，将文档层级结构作为文本与视觉证据的跨检索-生成统一接地信号，用于在结构化文档上实现忠实于源组织与局部图文逻辑的图文交错生成；同时构建了涵盖游戏攻略、网页、学术论文与步骤式食谱的基准HAM-Bench。
AI.motivation: 现有多种模态RAG方法将结构化文档扁平化为独立的文本和图像单元，削弱了源文档的层级组织与局部图文关联，导致检索到的图像虽与查询主题相关，但可能来自错误的章节/步骤，造成图文放置失准和"图文错位"问题，难以满足技术手册、维护指南、工业SOP等对程序结构忠实性要求高的场景。
AI.method: HAM-RAG将每篇文档解析为层次树，叶节点为可检索的文本/图像单元，每条证据对象包含原始内容、模态、根到叶路径、祖先标题与节上下文、附近图文上下文及局部关系；离线阶段将层级上下文序列化进文本表示和图像的上下文感知视觉描述并联合嵌入索引；在线阶段在共享预算下分别检索文本与图像证据，将层级信息、源标识、文档位置与图文局部关系组装进结构化提示，引导生成器实现忠实于源组织与局部上下文的图文交错生成。
AI.result: 在HAM-Bench的四个子集（Wukong/Wiki/arXiv/Recipe）上，HAM-RAG在9个匹配骨干上的多模态平均指标较最强非层级基线相对提升17.3%；在Wukong上Img-CBS（图像上下文BERTScore，衡量局部图文对齐）提升24.2%；检索阶段TCR@15与图像召回在多数子集上更优；消融实验表明文本与图像两侧的层级感知表示对性能具有互补贡献；系统在57,123次生成中仅失败2次（0.067%失败率），平均成本约3.578美分/题。
AI.conclusion: 文档层级结构应被视为多模态RAG的一类一等接地信号，能显著增强图像选择、放置及局部图文对齐的忠实性；HAM-RAG与HAM-Bench共同验证了层次感知建模在跨域结构化文档中的一致有效性，为工业SOP、维护指南等需要严格遵循程序结构与局部图文证据的应用场景提供了可靠的层次感知多模态助手基础。

title: Rethinking Automated Program Repair: The Impact of Bug Complexity, Fault Localization, and LLM Cost-efficiency
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at ESEM 2026
summary: Background: Software bugs remain a critical challenge in development, necessitating effective Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based APR systems have shown promise, prior studies primarily focus on overall repair effectiveness. The effects of bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and repair cost-effectiveness remain insufficiently explored. Aims: This study presents a comprehensive empirical analysis of LLM-based APR, focusing on how repair performance is shaped by bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and costs. Method: We evaluate two APR techniques (ChatRepair and CodeCorrector) using three LLMs (DeepSeek, GPT, and Llama), and examine their performance across diverse levels of bug complexity and localization strategies through a multi-dimensional empirical framework and statistical analysis. Results: Although structurally complex bugs and imprecise fault localization make repair more challenging, LLM-based APR techniques still achieve competitive repair effectiveness. Imprecise fault localization can substantially enlarge the performance gap between APR techniques. Furthermore, higher-cost LLMs and stronger reasoning settings do not consistently yield better cost-efficiency, revealing a nontrivial trade-off between repair effectiveness and computational cost. Conclusions: Over 50% of moderately complex bugs can be repaired by low-cost LLM-based APR techniques. The repair effectiveness gap between APR techniques becomes larger as fault localization becomes less precise. GPT-5 repairs 7 and 39 more complex bugs than DeepSeek-V4-pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, respectively; whereas the total repair cost of DeepSeek-V3.2 shows the best cost-efficiency performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文对基于大语言模型(LLM)的自动化程序修复(APR)技术进行了全面的实证分析，评估了ChatRepair和CodeCorrector两种APR技术在多种LLM（DeepSeek、GPT、Llama）上的表现，重点考察了缺陷复杂度、缺陷定位(FL)策略、推理设置和成本效率对修复效果的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-based APR研究主要集中在整体修复效果上，而对缺陷复杂度、缺陷定位精度、推理设置以及修复成本效益的影响缺乏系统性分析。此外，现有基准数据集（如QuixBugs）难度不足，且存在数据泄露问题，无法充分评估现代LLM-based APR方法的有效性。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个来自AtCoder竞赛平台的C++程序数据集（640个bugs），使用Git、srcML和GumTreeDiff工具从hunk-line和AST操作两个维度对缺陷复杂度进行分类。采用三阶段实验设计：（1）使用低成本LLM在完整数据集上进行行级FL评估；（2）评估不同FL策略（行级、hunk级、无FL）的影响；（3）使用高级LLM和推理设置在筛选后的211个中等复杂度bugs上进行评估。提出标准化成本指标（Repaired Bugs/$和Attempts/$），并使用卡方检验和逻辑回归进行统计分析。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：（1）SHSL和单操作类型缺陷最易修复（修复率78.5%和75.2%），而四操作类型缺陷最具挑战性，但中等复杂度缺陷的修复率仍超过50%；（2）FL精度降低时，APR技术间的性能差距显著扩大（如ChatRepair与CodeCorrector在无FL时差距达93个bugs）；（3）随着缺陷复杂度增加，FL精度对修复效果的影响减小，说明复杂缺陷更依赖程序结构理解；（4）GPT-5在非推理模式下修复175个bugs最佳，但推理模式仅额外修复3个；而DeepSeek-V3.2和V4-pro从推理模式中获益显著（分别多修复64和81个）；（5）DeepSeek-V3.2总成本仅为GPT-5的约4.6%，DeepSeek-V4-pro的约7.7%，具有最佳成本效率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明低成本LLM-based APR技术能有效修复超过50%的中等复杂度bugs；APR技术的稳定性对实际部署至关重要，因为FL不精确时性能差距会扩大；高级LLM和推理设置并不一定能带来成比例的修复效果提升，存在显著的性能-成本权衡；为LLM选择和APR部署提供了实用指导，强调需平衡修复效果与计算成本。

title: MACS: A Hybrid Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Conversational E-Commerce Recommendation
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Will be presenting at Stanford Trust&Safety Conference, already presented at Stanford Market AI Conference
summary: Conversational recommendation for e-commerce is increasingly mediated by large language models (LLMs), yet many real-world deployments operate under a stricter requirement: recommendations must be drawn only from a merchant's fixed catalog, without web search or unsupported product claims. In this setting, the main challenge is reliability under hard constraints: the system must satisfy user requirements, remain grounded in available inventory, and preserve preferences across multiple conversational turns. We present MACS (Multi-Agent Commerce System), a hybrid multi-agent framework for reliable conversational recommendation in fixed-catalog settings. MACS uses LLMs for language-facing tasks such as interpreting user requests, eliciting preferences, and generating responses, while correctness-critical operations, including product retrieval, hard-constraint filtering, brand exclusion, and progressive relaxation, are executed deterministically by the merchant agent. A session-persistent preference layer tracks constraints across turns, enabling consistent handling of budget overwrites and exclusion reversals. On a 140-query single-turn benchmark, MACS achieves the highest pass rate (87.1%) and perfect brand compliance (1.000). On a 10-scenario multi-turn benchmark, MACS achieves the strongest macro Pass@5 (72% vs. 56% GPT+Catalog / 52% Gemini+Catalog) with zero constraint drift. The advantage is sharpest on exclusion reversal (100% vs. 20% / 0%) and constraint accumulation (100% vs. 60% / 40%). Mean judged response quality is similar across systems (0.751 vs. 0.736). These results suggest that hybrid architectures combining deterministic constraint enforcement with session-persistent preference tracking provide stronger reliability-oriented performance than catalog-bound prompt-only baselines in the fixed-catalog merchant setting.

AI.tldr: MACS（Multi-Agent Commerce System）是一种混合多智能体框架，用于固定商品目录下的可靠对话式电商推荐。它通过将LLM负责的自然语言交互任务与确定性执行的硬约束过滤操作在架构层面解耦，显著优于纯提示词驱动的基线方法在可靠性关键指标上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现实电商部署中存在严格的可靠性要求：推荐只能来自商家固定商品目录、不能进行网页搜索、不能虚构产品声明。LLM在此场景下表现出三大不可靠性：(1) 编造目录中不存在的商品规格；(2) 在多轮交互中遗忘早期品牌排除等用户偏好；(3) 不一致地应用预算过滤。这些问题使得基于纯LLM的提示工程方案在约束正确性方面存在根本缺陷，需要在架构层面而非提示层面解决可靠性问题。
AI.method: MACS采用"购物智能体 + 商家智能体"双智能体架构：(1) 购物智能体基于LLM处理自然语言意图、偏好引导和响应生成；(2) 商家智能体以确定性方式执行SQL约束过滤、品牌排除、渐进式约束放宽和知识图谱遍历（Cypher查询）。两者通过结构化商业协议（UCP/ACP/MCP）通信。核心机制包括：会话持久化偏好槽位字典（跨轮次跟踪约束、支持预算覆盖和排除反转）、查询重写与意图路由、确定性SQL WHERE子句执行硬约束、双重品牌排除机制（SQL层+标题后过滤）、渐进式约束放宽策略（按优先级依次放宽可选约束，永不降低价格上限和品牌排除），以及加权最佳价值评分函数（按用例调整权重）。评估框架将确定性约束正确性（SQL验证）与响应质量（G-Eval LLM评分）分离。
AI.result: 单轮评估（140查询）：MACS通过率87.1%，品牌合规率1.000，过滤合规率0.970；GPT+Catalog通过率72.1%，Gemini+Catalog通过率68.6%。扩展基准（225查询，MACS）：平均分0.681，通过率85.3%。多轮评估（10场景，Pass@5）：MACS 72% vs GPT+Catalog 56% vs Gemini+Catalog 52%；漂移率MACS 0.000、Gemini 0.014。在排除反转场景：MACS 100% vs GPT 20% vs Gemini 0%；在约束累积场景：MACS 100% vs 60%/40%。披露能力（不可满足查询）：MACS 0.925 vs GPT 0.588 vs Gemini 0.550。会话状态消融：去除持久化槽位字典后，约束累积和预算覆盖场景从100%降至0%；SQL强制消融：去除SQL WHERE子句后品牌合规率从1.000降至0.684。三系统均响应质量相近（MACS 0.751 vs GPT 0.736）。LLM推理占总延迟85-92%，缓存命中可降低~12倍延迟。
AI.conclusion: 在固定商品目录的对话式商务场景中，将语言交互（LLM）与正确性关键操作（SQL约束执行、会话状态管理）在架构层面分离，是提高可靠性而不牺牲响应质量的实用且有效的方法。混合架构通过确定性约束强制执行和会话持久化偏好跟踪，可提供比目录绑定纯提示词基线更强的可靠性导向性能，尤其在需要跨轮次约束跟踪和显式披露不可满足需求的场景中优势最大。该框架主要适用于消费电子领域，泛化性有待跨域验证；未来工作包括τ-Bench标准化基准评估、独立人工评估、跨域扩展等。

title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: this https URL
summary: When forecasting hourly returns for 1,000 US equities, we observe an unexpected phenomenon: predictions become nearly flat and show poor stock ranking, as measured by cross-sectional correlation. We call this forecast collapse. Surprisingly, the phenomenon largely disappears when forecasting trading volume under the same setting. We investigate forecast collapse across time-series foundation models (TSFMs), twelve deep-learning forecasting models, and 97 public benchmark configurations, and find that it is closely tied to target predictability. We identify two distinct reasons behind it: low predictability limits the amplitude of calibrated point forecasts, while per-series objectives leave cross-series structure unidentified. These findings reveal a calibration-ranking tradeoff: optimizing squared error leads to flat predictions, whereas directly optimizing cross-sectional correlation improves ranking but can inflate forecast amplitude by more than an order of magnitude. To address this tradeoff, we introduce CalibRank, a simple objective that balances calibration and ranking. On Finance1K, CalibRank nearly triples cross-sectional correlation while keeping amplitude close to the target, and improves correlation on all tested models. Our results reveal a blind spot in conventional time-series evaluation: per-series metrics can hide failures in cross-series structure needed by downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文发现并系统研究了"预测坍缩"（forecast collapse）现象：在预测1,000只美股的每小时收益率时，多种时序预测模型（包括时序基础模型TSFMs、12种深度学习模型及97个公开基准）的预测值变得近乎平坦且股票排序能力极差（截面相关性低），而同一设置下预测交易量则无此问题。作者将成因归结为低预测性限制了点预测幅度以及逐序列目标未捕捉序列间结构，并提出CalibRank损失函数以平衡校准与排序。
AI.motivation: 传统时序评估主要依赖逐序列（per-series）指标，但实际下游决策（如投资组合构建）更依赖跨序列（截面）的排序与区分能力。作者发现现有模型在预测股票收益率时出现系统性"坍缩"，表明常规评估方法存在盲区，无法揭示排序能力的失败。
AI.method: 1) 在1,000只美股小时级数据上对比收益率预测与交易量预测；2) 跨多类模型（TSFMs、12种深度学习模型、97个公开基准配置）系统评估预测坍缩；3) 分析预测性、幅度（amplitude）与截面相关性（rank）的相互作用；4) 提出CalibRank损失函数，通过在MSE损失中加入基于预测符号一致性的排序项来平衡校准与排序。
AI.result: 在Finance1K基准上，CalibRank将近乎平坦的预测的截面相关性提升近3倍，同时保持预测幅度接近真实目标，并在所有测试模型上一致改善相关性。论文揭示了"校准-排序权衡"：最小化平方误差导致平坦预测，而直接优化截面相关性虽改善排序但会过度放大预测幅度超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 预测坍缩是低预测性与逐序列训练目标共同导致的普遍现象；常规逐序列评估指标会掩盖截面排序能力的缺陷；CalibRank作为一种简单有效的损失函数，为平衡预测校准与跨序列排序提供了实用方案，对金融预测及其他需要排序决策的下游任务具有重要启示。

title: From Fixed Grids to Moving Particles:A Transferable Latent Operator for Fluid Dynamics
comment: 8 pages, 5 this http URL
summary: Lagrangian modeling is vital to fluid dynamics, as it characterizes particle transport and complements the Eulerian this http URL , Lagrangian trajectories are less commonly available than Eulerian fields, while most neural operators are trained and evaluated primarily in the Eulerian representation. This mismatch motivates a new learning problem: can a model trained solely on Eulerian observations generalize zero-shot from Eulerian field prediction to Lagrangian particle rollout, without Lagrangian supervision or task-specific adaptation? To address this problem, we propose the Transferable Latent Operator (TLO), which learns a unified flow representation shared by Eulerian field prediction and Lagrangian particle rollout. TLO decouples latent flow evolution from coordinate-dependent decoding: querying the evolving latent representation at fixed spatial coordinates yields Eulerian fields, whereas querying velocities at particle positions and recursively updating these positions enables Lagrangian rollout. Across five fluid-dynamics benchmarks, TLO consistently outperforms existing neural operators in both Eulerian field prediction and zero-shot Lagrangian rollout, with further gains from limited Lagrangian fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可迁移潜在算子（TLO），通过解耦潜在流场演化与坐标相关解码，仅使用欧拉场监督训练，便可零样本迁移至拉格朗日粒子推演。在五个欧拉场预测基准和三个粒子推演基准上均优于现有神经算子，且支持粒子逸出网格后的继续推演。
AI.motivation: 流体动力学中，拉格朗日粒子轨迹数据稀缺且生成成本高，而欧拉场数据相对丰富。现有神经算子主要在欧拉表示下训练和评估，二者之间存在表征鸿沟。因此提出核心问题：仅用欧拉场监督训练的模型能否零样本迁移到闭合拉格朗日粒子推演，无需粒子坐标、粒子速度或轨迹标签，也无需参数适应。
AI.method: TLO 采用编码-处理-解码架构，三大组件协同实现坐标无关的潜在动力学学习与坐标相关的场读取：(1) 分块编码器（Patch Encoder）通过交叉注意力将局部子区域与全局域的观测聚合为位置-物理特征，生成固定大小的潜在标记；(2) 潜在处理器（Latent Processor）基于 Transolver 切片注意力机制，在纯潜在空间中推进流场演化，与输出查询坐标完全解耦；(3) 查询解码器（Query Decoder）利用坐标条件交叉注意力从潜在状态在任意坐标处读取场值。设置查询为固定欧拉网格即得场预报，查询为递归平移的粒子位置即得拉格朗日推演。理论方面通过命题证明速度误差到轨迹误差的递推关系，强调闭合推演中查询位移的反馈放大效应。
AI.result: 在五个欧拉基准（DAM2D、NS2D、TGV3D、Burgers3D、SEA）上，TLO 在所有基准均取得最低 MSE；在三个拉格朗日基准上，TLO 在 Ref（参考轨迹速度）和 Path（闭合轨迹位置）误差上均优于 UPT、LNO 等基线。在 DAM2D 上，TLO-DA（仅微调解码器）在 Ref 和 Path 上均优于原生拉格朗日模型 GNS，且内存占用更低（35.94 vs 47.94 MiB）、推理更快（7.26 vs 8.68 ms/step）。消融实验证实局部+全局标记设计优于单一尺度，且在网格支持外，直接解码仍可推演而插值失效。
AI.conclusion: TLO 验证了仅用固定网格欧拉监督即可学习可迁移的流场动力学，并支持闭合拉格朗日粒子推演。潜在动力学与坐标条件解码的解耦是关键，使同一训练模型可同时处理固定网格预报与移动粒子查询，并能在粒子离开网格后继续评估。Ref 与 Path 之间的差距表明，闭合移动查询是检验迁移能力的更严格测试。稀疏解码器微调可进一步提升精度，展示了欧拉潜在表示在拉格朗日任务上的潜力。

title: Overcoming Shortcut Learning in Graph Neural Networks through Active Explanation Guidance
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can solve prediction tasks by unintentionally exploiting shortcuts---that is, edges, nodes, and features that correlate with but are not causal for the prediction---which compromise their reliability in out-of-distribution tasks. We introduce XIGL, an architecture-agnostic human-in-the-loop strategy for removing such shortcuts from GNNs. Our key insight is twofold. On the one hand, reliance on shortcuts can be detected by inspecting GNN explanations. On the other hand, once made aware of such shortcuts, sufficiently expert users can provide tailored corrective feedback, which helps deconfound the model. XIGL supports any query strategy; however, since corrective feedback can be expensive to acquire, we develop an active learning strategy for prioritizing explanations that are more likely to display shortcut behavior, lowering annotation and cognitive costs. We showcase the effectiveness of XIGL, including both existing and proposed explanation-based strategies, on several GNN architectures. Our implementation is available online.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XIGL（eXplanatory Interactive Graph shortcut unLearning），一种架构无关的人机交互策略，通过主动学习与GNN解释引导来消除图神经网络中的捷径学习问题，降低标注成本并提升模型在分布外任务中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）在图分类任务中容易利用与标签相关但非因果的捷径（如水印、元数据、简单统计特征），导致在分布外（OOD）任务中泛化能力差。现有捷径去除方法依赖多领域样本等不易获取的数据，且基于解释的去混杂方法需要为整个训练集提供解释监督，成本过高。本文旨在通过结合GNN解释检测与专家纠正反馈，并利用主动学习策略降低标注与认知成本。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 使用输入梯度作为解释器检测捷径依赖；(2) 设计端到端可微的损失函数 L = L_ce + λL_e，通过最小化不相关节点输入梯度占比来去除捷径依赖（加入归一化分母避免梯度坍缩）；(3) 提出主动学习查询策略——最大/最小解释熵（MaEE/MiEE），基于神经网络的简单性偏差选择最可能暴露捷径行为的实例进行专家标注与纠正。同时支持随机采样和最大分类熵（MaCE）等基线策略。在ER-color（合成）和CPatchMNIST（真实）数据集上评估了GCN、GIN、GraphSAGE和GAT四种架构。
AI.result: 在被动解释监督下，XIGL在两个数据集上均显著提升OOD测试准确率（如GIN在CPatchMNIST上从0.20%提升至33.38%）。主动学习策略中，MiEE（最小解释熵）整体表现最为稳定，解释驱动策略在CPatchMNIST上一致优于预测驱动策略。随机采样在部分设置下也表现出色。值得注意的是，主动学习仅使用不到20%的训练数据即可达到与被动学习相近的性能。
AI.conclusion: XIGL通过利用专家对模型解释的纠正反馈有效去除GNN中的捷径依赖，同时通过主动查询策略显著降低标注成本。未来工作将扩展到更多数据集与架构、自解释GNN，并研究解释忠实度对去偏效果的作用。

title: Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network for Traffic Flow Prediction
summary: Deep spatiotemporal models integrating graph convolutions and attention mechanisms have demonstrated excellent performance in network-level traffic flow prediction, owing to their exceptional ability to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies. Despite their predictive success, deployment of such models in safety-critical urban systems remains constrained by their inherent lack of transparency. Existing post-hoc diagnostic methods often struggle with spurious correlations and fail to unveil the intrinsic decision-making mechanisms governing traffic dynamics, resulting in suboptimal interpretability and limited operational trustworthiness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes the Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network (SGSAN). Departing from traditional architectures that rely on unconstrained adaptive graphs, SGSAN explicitly learns a static Directed Dependency Graph (DDG) to identify the invariant macroscopic propagation paths of traffic states. We further introduce an InfoNCE-based soft-coupling mechanism that anchors the model's dynamic spatiotemporal attention to this structural prior, offering a mechanistic account of the model's decision-making process while ensuring robust forecasting by aligning attention-based reasoning with identified macroscopic dependencies and preventing over-reliance on ephemeral local noise. Furthermore, a decoupled two-stage optimization framework is developed to resolve the fundamental conflict between structural discovery and predictive error minimization. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that SGSAN achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy while providing built-in interpretability that organically aligns with the physical logic of traffic networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGSAN（Structure-Guided Spatiotemporal Attention Graph Neural Network），通过显式学习静态有向依赖图（DDG）作为结构先验，并采用InfoNCE软耦合机制将动态时空注意力锚定到该结构上，结合两阶段解耦优化框架，在保持预测精度的同时实现内置可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度时空模型在城市路网交通流预测中虽取得高精度，但其"黑箱"特性限制了在安全关键系统中的部署。现有的事后诊断方法（如LIME、SHAP）仅近似模型外部行为，无法揭示内在决策机制；而传统注意力机制本质上是数据驱动、相关性驱动的，容易捕获虚假相关（如局部暴雨导致两个地理无关区域同时拥堵的统计关联），缺乏对路网宏观拓扑结构的约束，难以提供工程信任所需的可解释性。同时，将结构发现与预测误差最小化联合优化会导致梯度干扰，使学习到的依赖图被短期噪声扭曲。
AI.method: SGSAN包含四大模块：①嵌入模块（时间注意力子模块提取时序特征并生成节点嵌入）；②结构发现模块（基于DAG-GNN变分自编码器架构，将DDG学习转化为连续优化问题，结合NOTEARS迹指数惩罚保证有向无环结构、L1正则保证稀疏性）；③时空注意力模块（两层空间注意力+一层时间注意力，生成动态注意力图）；④输出模块。采用两阶段解耦训练：Stage I仅优化结构发现模块（损失=预测损失+γ_D·DAG损失+γ_S·稀疏损失），Stage II冻结DDG后通过InfoNCE对比学习软对齐时空注意力与结构表示（损失=预测损失+γ_I·InfoNCE损失）。在线推理时结构发现模块被旁路，仅使用稀疏DDG掩码引导注意力，复杂度从O(T·N²·D)降至O(T·|E|·D)。
AI.result: 在PeMS03、PeMS07、PeMS08、PeMS-Bay四个真实数据集上的15/30/60分钟三个预测时 horizon 上，SGSAN均达到最优预测精度（MAE、MAPE、RMSE三项指标领先）。训练效率较联合训练框架（SGSAN-Joint）平均提升31.7%（最高39.2%）；在线推理延迟低至0.096 ms/sample，显著优于PSTCGCN（0.434 ms）和STTN（0.513 ms）。消融实验验证了DDG结构发现、两阶段框架及InfoNCE耦合机制的必要性（联合训练在PeMS07 60分钟时MAE飙升至70.26）。可解释性方面，新提出的ASC/SPC/APC一致性指标显示：学习到的DDG与真实物理路网拓扑对齐度达88%，注意力图与物理网络一致性达85%，且注意力机制继承了DDG的有向非对称特性，避免了虚假双向统计关联。
AI.conclusion: SGSAN成功将交通流预测从不可解释的统计关联建模转变为基于有向结构依赖的可信赖建模框架。通过显式解耦结构发现与表征学习，以时间不变的有向依赖图（DDG）作为宏观结构先验，结合InfoNCE软耦合机制实现结构稳定性与时序灵活性的平衡，在不牺牲预测精度的前提下提供了与物理路网拓扑自然对齐的内置可解释性，为安全关键的城市交通管理系统提供了高准确、高效率、可部署且可信赖的建模方案。

title: How Much Do Legal RAG Systems Still Hallucinate?
summary: Hallucination is a major challenge for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in the legal domain, where ungrounded answers can lead to serious consequences. To better understand this problem, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucination behavior in eight legal RAG systems across two legal corpora, the GDPR (in English) and a national civil law (in French). Using claim-level and answer-level evaluation, we report on hallucination density and severity, analyze performance across question categories and user personas, and validate our findings on an independent set of 142 legal-expert-authored questions. Our results show that hallucinations remain pervasive, ranging from less than 10% of responses for the best-performing systems to nearly half in the worst case. We further find that false-premise questions, containing incorrect assumptions that must be rejected, produce high hallucination rates on the manually-drafted questions.

AI.tldr: 本文对8个法律RAG系统在两个法律语料库（GDPR英语语料和法国CIVIL民法语料）上的幻觉行为进行了细粒度分析。研究采用声明级（claim-level）和答案级（answer-level）评估指标，结果表明幻觉问题仍然普遍存在，最佳系统的幻觉率低于10%，而最差系统的幻觉率接近50%。研究发现错误前提（false-premise）类问题尤其容易产生幻觉，且通过142道法律专家手写问题的外部验证证实了这些发现的普适性。
AI.motivation: 在法律领域，AI系统的幻觉可能导致严重的财务和社会后果（如AI生成虚构判例被引用导致司法制裁）。现有法律RAG基准测试主要关注聚合性幻觉指标，缺乏对不同问题类型和用户角色下幻觉行为变化的深入分析，且未验证发现的普适性。因此需要系统性地研究法律RAG系统中幻觉的密度、严重性、分布及其在不同问题类别和用户角色间的差异。
AI.method: 基于ClaimRAG-LAW基准（含317个专家验证的问答对，覆盖GDPR英语语料149个和CIVIL法语语料168个），评估2种检索器（BM25、E5）与4种生成器（GPT-4、GPT-5、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mixtral-8x7B）组合而成的8个RAG系统。定义两类指标：声明级幻觉率（CL，衡量幻觉密度）和答案级幻觉率（AL，衡量幻觉频率），以及对应的严格版本（仅计明确矛盾的声明）。分析涵盖四类问题（通用法律研究GR、事实回忆FR、错误前提FP、管辖/时效JT）和三类用户角色（法律专家LE、公务员CO、公民CI）。此外通过142道法律专家独立撰写的问题进行外部验证。
AI.result: 1. **幻觉率差异显著**：BM25+GPT-5表现最佳（GDPR AL=20.1%，CIVIL AL=8.33%），Llama3-8B系列最差（GDPR AL最高48.3%，CIVIL AL最高45.8%）；2. **幻觉严重性**：多数幻觉为孤立单声明错误（H1为主导类别），但严重的多声明幻觉即使在顶级系统中仍偶有出现（如E5+GPT-5曾产生含8-9个不支持声明的答案）；3. **问题类型影响**：FP类问题最具挑战性（如BM25+Mixtral-8x7B在CIVIL上AL达100%），许多系统会隐式接受错误前提；4. **用户角色影响**：法律专家（LE）问题产生幻觉率较低，公民（CI）和公务员（CO）问题更具挑战性（部分开源模型AL超过70%）；5. **外部验证一致**：GPT系列幻觉率最低，Llama3-8B系列最高，FP类问题仍是最困难类别，证实发现具有普适性。
AI.conclusion: 法律RAG系统中的幻觉仍然是持续性挑战。幻觉更多表现为孤立的单声明错误而非弥漫性错误，幻觉行为在不同问题类型和用户角色间差异显著。GPT-5在保持低幻觉率方面最稳健，尤其在避免严重矛盾性幻觉方面优于GPT-4。提升检索质量不足以缓解幻觉问题，未来研究应同时关注检索效果、对检索证据的忠实度以及前提验证能力（特别是针对含误导性假设的问题）。研究将扩展到法律专用评估指标和更多诊断研究，以支持更可靠的AI辅助法律应用开发。

title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models
comment: Spotlight paper at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
summary: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as leading methods for tabular predictive tasks, leveraging in-context learning to predict on new data without task-specific training. Despite the increased use of TFMs in high-stakes decision-making, their fairness properties remain largely unexplored. In this work, we incorporate fairness constraints directly into TFM training, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass. Our approach addresses two key challenges: limited access to sensitive attributes in training data, and the incompatibility of existing fairness techniques with the in-context learning paradigm. We propose FairTFM, a scalable training strategy based on synthetic fairness tasks and a fairness-aware architecture using a gradient reversal layer, which encourages the model to learn representations invariant to sensitive attributes. Experiments on 132 fairness tasks show consistent improvements in fairness while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FairTFM——首个将统计群体公平性（如人口统计均等、机会均等、校准均等）直接融入预训练过程的表格基础模型（TFM）。通过合成公平任务采样与梯度反转层（GRL）架构，在保留上下文学习（ICL）单次前向推理能力的同时，仅以 2–11% 的准确率代价换取 32–75% 的公平性提升。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）如 TabPFN、TabDPT、TabICL 等虽在医疗、金融等高风险决策任务中表现优异，但其公平性属性几乎未被探索。已有研究表明 TFMs 同样会产生偏见性预测输出，而传统的公平性方法（预处理/训练中/后处理）均假设可对模型进行任务特定的训练或输出校准，与 TFM 所依赖的、冻结模型的单次前向 ICL 范式存在根本性冲突。此外，训练数据中敏感属性的标注稀缺也制约了公平性建模。因此，亟需一种在预训练阶段即可学习公平表征、且推理时无需任何任务特定调整的 TFM 训练框架。
AI.method: FairTFM 包含两个核心组件：（1）基于"随机指定特征为敏感属性"的合成公平任务采样策略——从采样数据集中随机移除一个特征作为敏感属性 s，并通过基于 Beta 分布与狄利克雷过程的"stick-breaking"分箱方法将其离散化，从而自监督地构造多样化公平任务，无需任何标注的敏感属性；（2）公平性感知的 Transformer 架构——在 nanoTabPFN 轻量骨干基础上扩展一个敏感属性编码器，并添加一个通过梯度反转层（GRL）连接到共享 Transformer 的辅助预测头。训练目标为联合交叉熵损失 L = CE(ŷ_qy, y_qy) + λ·CE(ŝ_qy, s_qy)，其中 GRL 对 s 头的梯度乘以 -1，迫使编码器学习对 s 条件性不变（in-context invariant）的表征。推理时 s_qy 被替换为可学习参数，无需接触真实敏感属性，通过 λ 调节公平-精度权衡。
AI.result: 在基于 ACS PUMS 衍生的 120 个真实公平任务（5 种预测任务 × 3 种敏感属性 × 8 个州）及 12 个跨数据集（Adult、COMPAS、German Credit、Diabetes、Law School、CelebA）任务上：（1）相比最强 TFM 基线 TabPFNv2.5，FairTFM 在人口统计均等差异（DP）、均等化机会差异（EOD）、均等机会差异（EOP）上改善 32–75%，准确率代价仅 2–11%；（2）在非 ACS 任务上，FairTFM-25 相对基线公平性提升高达 82–89%，AUCROC 仍维持在 0.737 以上；（3）线性探针实验验证了表征学习的针对性——敏感属性 AUC 从原始 0.783 降至 0.542（λ=25），而标签 AUC 仅从 0.834 微降至 0.787；（4）与 Exponentiated Gradient 等任务特定经典公平方法相比，FairTFM 在保持高 AUCROC（0.803 vs. EG 的 0.70）的同时实现更优或相当的公平-精度帕累托前沿；（5）作为公平表征学习器使用时，FairTFM 的单次前向嵌入即能提供与 fairlearn 中 LFR、Correlation Remover 等任务特定预处理方法相媲美的下游分类器帕累托前沿，且无需任务特定优化。
AI.conclusion: FairTFM 是在不破坏 TFM 关键推理属性（单次前向 ICL、无任务特定再训练）的前提下，首次将统计群体公平性作为一等目标融入 TFM 预训练的方法。该工作开辟了公平感知预训练的研究方向：合成公平任务先验、对 λ 参数化权衡控制的进一步研究，以及将该框架扩展至更大规模 TFM 骨干（如 TabPFNv2.5、TabICLv2）均可带来更强的公平-精度权衡。局限性在于目前依赖 TabICL 的合成先验，可能无法完全捕获真实敏感属性的语义与社会结构，且未在每个数据集与每个指标上完全支配专用公平基线。

title: Meteorology-driven Causal Nowcasting of Fugitive Landfill Emissions Enables Proactive Public Health Response
summary: Fugitive emissions from waste sites increasingly expose communities to toxic and odorous gases, yet public-health responses remain largely retrospective, with episodes investigated only after residents have been exposed. Here we show that the meteorological drivers of elevated hydrogen sulphide (HS) at a long-monitored European landfill, and the timescales over which they act, can be identified directly from routine monitoring data. We introduce CAIRN (Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting), a machine-learning framework whose internal memory is matched to these measured timescales: a fast component tracking hour-scale wind-borne transport and a slow component tracking multi-hour weather changes. Trained to predict gas measurements, CAIRN operates using only routine weather variables and the calendar, without hand-engineered features. Its behaviour is consistent with the identified transport mechanisms, and the framework transfers unchanged to a second monitoring station and to co-emitted methane. Combining four such nowcasters produces a site-level, tiered alert aligned with WHO odour guidance that closely reproduces the alert generated by a direct sensor network and tracks an independent record of community odour complaints. Weather-driven nowcasting can therefore estimate community impact as an emission episode unfolds, providing public-health authorities with a validated, graded trigger for intervention and enabling exposure to be reduced during events rather than after them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAIRN框架，仅利用常规气象数据和日历信息，通过因果锚定的双通路状态空间模型对垃圾填埋场逸散性H₂S排放进行近实时预报（nowcasting），并经独立社区投诉记录外部验证，可作为前瞻性公共卫生干预的触发机制。
AI.motivation: 当前对垃圾填埋场等逸散性有毒/恶臭气体的公共卫生响应多为回顾性的，即社区已暴露后才启动调查。弥合"暴露发生"与"响应启动"之间时间差的关键科学缺口有三：(1)气象变量与受体暴露之间的经验因果链路尚未从数据中显式识别；(2)驱动因子在分钟到天的时间尺度上多尺度非线性耦合，典型边界层物理时间常数未被观测恢复并用作模型先验；(3)学得的暴露模型从未在真实场景中以独立的社区影响记录进行外部验证。
AI.method: 1) 环境表征：对欧洲某长期监测填埋场主受体（MMF9）34,015条15分钟记录进行条件概率函数玫瑰图、H₂S–CH₄相关与幂律拟合、温度–H₂S日滞回环、日变化剖面、日出对齐混合层崩溃等分析，确证源为厌氧填埋气。2) 因果识别：采用多尺度传递熵（MSTE）对七个候选驱动在10个时间尺度（15 min–96 h）量化定向信息流，并经Benjamini–Hochberg与Benjamini–Yekutieli多重检验校正，确定风向、风速与气压构成多尺度因果核心。3) 模型：构建CAIRN——对角S4D双通路状态空间模型，快通路锚定1小时（平流主导），慢通路锚定6小时（处于气压显著的15 min–12 h带内），仅以四通道常规气象与日历编码为输入，无任何手工滞后/导数/停滞特征。4) 多通道融合：四个独立训练的CAIRN（H₂S与CH₄ × MMF9与MMF2）经Bayesian对数几率累加器融合为四等级（Tier 0–3）预警，切分点与WHO 30分钟恶臭烦恼指南和FIDOL框架对齐。5) 验证：周滚动前推协议、严格的因果卷积、嵌套时间探针、留出一周法重拟合，并以社区每日恶臭投诉记录作为完全外部的终点指标。
AI.result: 1) 因果层级稳健：风向（≤6 h显著）、风速（≤3 h显著）、气压（15 min–12 h全尺度显著，随聚集尺度增至12 h时占比达31.4%）为三大驱动核心；六配置消融与半年劈半重采样均确认层级稳定。2) 物理锚定的S4模型在F₁-High上以0.533（合并）优于XGBoost基准的0.501，端点差+0.032（McNemar p=0.043）；学习式记忆比手工编码记忆多恢复约1.8倍的F₁-High增量（+0.073 vs +0.040，两者Wilcoxon p≤0.027）。3) 多通道融合预警与原始浓度决定性地面真值达成κ_w=0.709（留出一周重拟合0.703），投票计数基线提升+0.070（配对bootstrap p=0.003）。4) 关键外部验证：融合日均等级与社区每日投诉计数在滞后0处达r=0.729（R²=0.532，n=89天），接近原始传感器真值天花板r=0.793的84%解释方差，且唯一全局最大峰位于滞后0，证实为事件发生时的即时近实时预报而非追溯或预报。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，受体尺度H₂S暴露可仅由常规气象条件推断，并通过因果锚定的双通路状态空间模型以近实时方式估计；四通道Bayesian融合产生的分级预警与社区实际影响高度一致，为公共卫生权威提供了经过独立验证的、可分级的前瞻性干预触发器。模型架构无需手工特征工程，可迁移至第二受体几何与共排放CH₄，并通过替换为数值天气预报输入直接转化为预报。该框架将暴露预测从回顾性表征转向前瞻性、数据驱动的干预，对环境正义情境下的社区健康保护具有直接政策意涵；但其训练仍依赖受体H₂S测量，部署需在新型场地重新估计因果层级并周期性再训练。

title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines trained models directly in weight space, offering a compute-efficient alternative to additional fine-tuning. Selecting merge parameters is nevertheless difficult because downstream evaluations are expensive, gradients are unavailable, and source capabilities can conflict. We formulate merge-parameter selection as a black-box multi-objective optimization problem and introduce MOBO-Merge, a merge-operator agnostic framework that uses multi-objective Bayesian optimization to approximate the Pareto front under a limited evaluation budget. We evaluate Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B in two-model instruction-math and three-model instruction-math-code settings using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and block-wise merge operators. On held-out benchmark partitions, MOBO-Merge obtains higher mean hypervolume than random search in 11 of 12 reported comparisons. The gain is small for one-dimensional Linear interpolation but substantially larger for several TIES, block-wise, and three-objective searches. No merge operator is uniformly best: TIES leads in three of four family-setting combinations, whereas Block-Linear 4x is strongest for the Llama three-model merge. These results show that multi-objective Bayesian optimization is valuable as a search layer for expressive merge parameterizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOBO-Merge框架,将模型合并中的权重选择问题建模为黑盒多目标优化问题,使用多目标贝叶斯优化在有限评估预算下逼近帕累托前沿。该方法与合并算子无关,可统一处理全局插值、干扰感知合并和分块参数化等不同策略。
AI.motivation: 模型合并通过权重空间组合多个专用模型,无需额外微调,但面临三大挑战:(1)下游评估昂贵且无梯度;(2)源模型能力相互冲突,需权衡而非单一最优;(3)合并空间维度提高时,随机或网格搜索效率低下。因此需要一种样本高效的优化方法来近似帕累托前沿。
AI.method: 将合并参数选择形式化为:给定合并算子M(θ₁,...,θ_K; x)产生的低维参数空间x∈X⊂R^D,以及M个目标函数f_i(θ(x)),寻找帕累托最优参数集。算法采用独立高斯过程代理模型(SingleTaskGP组合为ModelListGP)建模各目标,使用Noisy Expected Hypervolume Improvement (NEHVI)采集函数,基于BoTorch顺序优化,每次迭代选择使期望超体积增量最大的合并配置进行评估。涵盖四种合并算子:Linear(1维)、SLERP(仅两模型)、TIES(4维)、Block-Linear 4x(分块线性插值,AB中4维、ABC中8维)。在Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B上进行两模型(指令-数学)和三模型(指令-数学-代码)实验,基准为30%优化集+70%保留集划分。
AI.result: 在12组家族-目标集-算子对比中,MOBO-Merge在11组上获得更高的保留集平均超体积,唯一反例为Qwen AB+Linear(差距仅0.0005)。关键发现:(1)一维Linear搜索中增益很小,随机搜索已具竞争力;(2)高维TIES、Block-Linear及三目标搜索中增益显著,如Llama ABC中TIES从0.0055提升至0.0429,Block-Linear 4x从0.0289提升至0.0634;(3)无统一最优算子——TIES在4组家族-设置组合中3组领先,Block-Linear 4x在Llama三模型合并中最强;(4)Llama TIES对无引导参数选择特别敏感;(5)Qwen帕累托前沿存在同时超过两源检查点的合并配置,而Llama呈现明确的能力权衡。
AI.conclusion: MOBO-Merge为模型合并提供了一种原则性的、样本高效的优化框架,显式表征能力间的可控权衡。核心结论是:多目标贝叶斯优化作为搜索层对表达性强的合并参数化(TIES、分块、多目标)价值最大,而对一维线性插值收益有限;合并算子与搜索策略需联合考量,TIES虽强大但对参数选择敏感,Block-Linear 4x兼具简单可解释性与强性能。未来方向包括自适应合并参数化、多保真评估策略及扩展到更高维合并空间。

title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student models. To handle tokenizer differences, we perform OPD in a shared text space and align only tokens that occupy identical text spans under the student and teacher tokenizers. To mitigate the problem of excessive generation length and frequent truncation, we introduce a student reference KL loss and mask the advantages of special termination tokens such as </think> and <|im_end|>. This strategy constrains the student from drifting excessively from its initial policy, thereby mitigating the teacher-student distribution mismatch problem and fostering steady length growth. Experiments on both same-family and different-family student models, including Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Intern-S2, GLM-4.7, Gemma-4, show consistent gains in mathematical reasoning, especially natural-language math proving. Notably, Intern-S2-Preview improves by 21.2 points on ProofBench, reaching 55.2 and surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro. It also improves on science benchmarks such as HLE and HiPhO, suggesting that OPD transfers reasoning capabilities that generalize beyond the mathematical training domain.

AI.tldr: SimpleOPD提出了一种与分词器无关的在线策略蒸馏框架，通过在共享文本空间中对齐师生模型相同文本跨度的token，将长上下文推理教师模型（SU-01）的证明推理能力迁移到短上下文学生模型，并针对训练过程中的长度爆炸和截断问题引入终止token掩码和学生参考KL损失两项稳定化技术。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）研究主要局限于同模型族、共享词表的师生设置，将长上下文推理教师的能力迁移到短上下文学生（尤其是跨模型族、跨分词器）的研究尚属空白。同时，直接进行跨上下文长度的OPD会导致响应长度爆炸、频繁截断和训练不稳定，亟需针对长上下文到短上下文蒸馏的实用解决方案。
AI.method: （1）在共享文本空间进行OPD：学生生成响应文本后，用教师原生分词器和对话模板重新编码该文本，仅在师生分词器产生相同文本跨度的token位置施加教师监督（通过双指针线性扫描实现一对一对齐）；（3）提出终止token优势掩码：屏蔽`</think>`和`<|im_end|>`等结构化token的OPD梯度，避免教师监督压制学生终止行为；（4）引入学生参考KL损失：以初始学生策略为参考约束策略漂移，缓解长度爆炸和截断；（5）整体采用PPO裁剪目标完成多步策略更新。
AI.result: SimpleOPD在Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Intern-S2-Preview、GLM-4.7-Flash和Gemma-4-26B-A4B等跨同/异族学生模型上一致提升数学推理能力，特别是自然语言证明任务：Intern-S2-Preview在ProofBench上提升21.2点（34.0→55.2，Gemini-2.5-Pro判定），超越Gemini-2.5-Pro；并以DeepSeek-V4-Flash为教师在6k长度下也获得稳定提升（ProofBench +18.01）。同时在HLE、HiPhO等科学基准上表现出领域外泛化增益（HiPhO 38.6→41.1），证明能力迁移突破了数学训练域。消融实验表明：终止token掩码与学生参考KL损失对稳定训练缺一不可；KL系数过大或过小均会损害性能（GLM上最佳为1.0）；蒸馏长度从6k增至32k在长上下文证明任务上带来稳定增益；SimpleOPD在四个基准上整体优于EOPD和G-OPD。
AI.conclusion: SimpleOPD验证了跨分词器在线策略蒸馏的可行性：通过共享文本空间对齐、终止token掩码与学生参考KL正则化三者的组合，可在不要求师生共享词表的前提下，将长上下文推理教师的能力高效、稳定地迁移到短上下文学生，并跨模型族泛化；该方法为推理能力的轻量化跨模型传递提供了一条无需教师轨迹SFT的实用路径。

title: Mind the Long Tail: Understanding the Difficulty of Delay Detection in Business Processes
comment: Business Process Management Conference
summary: The early detection of delayed cases in business processes is a critical capability for organizations. Predictive process monitoring (PPM) supports this task by using historical event logs to predict the remaining time of ongoing cases, enabling timely interventions to avoid missed deadlines and service level violations. Although remaining time prediction has advanced considerably through sophisticated deep learning architectures, little is known about the intrinsic difficulty of delay detection itself. Since performance is typically assessed using aggregate metrics, prior work provides limited insight into how models perform across the target distribution, especially on the operationally most critical cases with large delays. In this paper, we address this gap by analyzing the difficulty of delay detection. Across 14 event logs, we show that remaining times are typically strongly right-skewed, with only a small fraction of cases exhibiting large delays. Existing models capture the mode of this distribution well but perform poorly on high-delay cases. We further uncover pronounced heteroscedasticity, showing that predictive uncertainty increases with delay magnitude. Based on these findings, we evaluate approaches to mitigate the imbalance problem, but find only limited benefits, suggesting that the key underlying problem may not be imbalance but higher uncertainty associated with delayed cases. We show that this correlation can be exploited to substantially improve the identification of delayed cases. Overall, our work provides new insights into the sources of difficulty in delay detection and identifies uncertainty-aware modeling as a promising direction for future PPM research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了业务流程管理中剩余时间预测（Remaining Time Prediction, RPP）任务中"延迟检测"（Delay Detection）的内在困难。通过14个公开事件日志的实验，揭示了剩余时间分布普遍呈强右偏（长尾分布），现有模型对分布众数（正常案例）预测良好，但对高延迟案例表现差；进一步发现预测不确定性随延迟幅度增加而显著上升（异方差性）。文章评估了多种不平衡回归方法（数据级SMOGN重采样、算法级CSW/BMSE/EAL/SERA加权），效果有限；但利用不确定性估计（基于生存分析的模型）显著提升了延迟案例的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 业务流程执行延迟会导致SLA违约、成本上升和客户满意度下降，因此早期识别延迟案例具有重要运营价值。现有PPM研究主要通过深度学习架构（LSTM、Transformer、GNN）提升剩余时间预测的聚合指标（如MAE），但对模型在不同目标分布区域（特别是稀少但关键的高延迟案例）上的表现知之甚少。论文旨在回答两个核心问题：（1）延迟检测的内在困难来源是什么？是目标不平衡还是数据噪声？（2）如何有效提升对高延迟案例的识别能力？
AI.method:
论文采用实证分析方法，分为三部分：
1. **难度分析**：在14个事件日志上，使用Fisher偏度系数衡量剩余时间分布的右偏程度，使用Spearman相关系数衡量预测绝对误差和生存模型预测区间宽度与真实剩余时间的相关性，证实异方差性。
2. **不平衡回归方法评估**：
   - 数据级：适配SMOGN算法到事件前缀编码空间，按前缀长度分组后进行插值/噪声过采样+欠采样；
   - 算法级：包括Cost-Sensitive Weighting (CSW)、Balanced MSE (BMSE)、Error-Aware Loss (EAL/Focal-R)、SERA relevance-based loss。
